docs.title: Hướng dẫn setup Video Import (Google Drive OAuth)
docs.text:
Hướng dẫn bật tính năng Admin → Import Video (ADR-0019) trên server production: tạo OAuth client, lấy refresh token, cấu hình server và test.

Làm 1 lần. Thời gian khoảng 15 phút.

docs.title: 1. Vì sao cần OAuth khi đã có googlekey.json?
docs.text:
googlekey.json là key của Service Account. Service Account đọc được folder Drive đã share (cronjob sync đang dùng), nhưng không upload được:

list folder    : 200                       ✅ đọc được
canAddChildren : true                      ✅ có quyền ghi
upload         : 403 storageQuotaExceeded  ❌

Trên Google Drive, file thuộc về người tạo và tính vào dung lượng của người đó. Từ 2024 Service Account có 0 byte storage quota, nên mọi upload đều bị từ chối. Share folder chỉ cấp quyền, không cấp dung lượng.

→ Upload dùng OAuth refresh token của chính tài khoản Gmail sở hữu folder (file thuộc về bạn, dùng 15 GB của bạn).

Credential Dùng cho Ở đâu Service Account (googlekey.json) Cronjob đọc Drive (syncDriveVideos) GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL_PATH (giữ nguyên) OAuth refresh token Video Import upload lên Drive GOOGLE_OAUTH_* trong .env

Các cách khác (Shared Drive, domain-wide delegation) đều cần Google Workspace trả phí.

docs.title: 2. Tạo OAuth client trên Google Cloud Console
docs.text:
Mở https://console.cloud.google.com → kiểm tra project ở góc trên bên trái là project của Service Account (canh-test).

Menu → Google Auth Platform (hoặc APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, sẽ tự chuyển sang Google Auth Platform).

docs.title: 2.1 Get started (nếu project chưa cấu hình)
docs.text: Bước Giá trị App information → App name Funny App Uploader App information → User support email email của bạn Audience External Contact information email của bạn Finish Tick đồng ý → Continue → Create

docs.title: 2.2 Audience → Publish app ⚠️ quan trọng
docs.text:
• Publishing status đang Testing → bấm Publish app → Confirm.
  • Status phải là In production.
  • Google có thể nhắc verification → bỏ qua. App chưa verify vẫn dùng được cho chính tài khoản của bạn.

❗ Nếu để Testing, refresh token hết hạn sau 7 ngày → import lỗi DRIVE_NOT_CONFIGURED / invalid_grant.

docs.title: 2.3 Data Access
docs.text:
Bỏ qua. Script sẽ xin scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive lúc consent.

Không dùng scope drive.file: scope này không cho app thêm file vào folder mà app không tự tạo.

docs.title: 2.4 Clients → Create client
docs.text:
Field Giá trị Application type Desktop app Name funny-uploader

Bấm Create → Download JSON → lưu thành client_secret.json.

Console mới chỉ cho tải client secret lúc tạo. Lỡ đóng thì tạo client mới.

docs.title: 2.5 Kiểm tra Google Drive API
docs.text: APIs & Services → Enabled APIs & services → phải có Google Drive API. Chưa có → + Enable APIs and services → tìm "Google Drive API" → Enable.

docs.title: 3. Lấy refresh token (trên máy cá nhân)
docs.text:
Yêu cầu: Python 3 (chỉ dùng standard library), trình duyệt, port 8765 trống.

cd D:\DO\assessment
python scripts/google/get-drive-refresh-token.py D:\path\to\client_secret.json
  1. Trình duyệt mở trang đăng nhập Google → chọn tài khoản Gmail sở hữu folder Drive (folder mà cronjob đang sync).
  2. Màn hình "Google hasn't verified this app" → Advanced → Go to Funny App Uploader (unsafe).
  3. Màn hình xin quyền Drive → Continue / Allow.
  4. Tab hiện OK - you can close this tab.; terminal hiện: 
    Saved to drive-oauth.env (not printed). Copy into the server .env, then delete this file.

File drive-oauth.env gồm 3 dòng:

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=...
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=...
GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN=...

🔒 Đây là secret: không commit (đã có trong .gitignore), không dán vào chat/issue. Sau khi chép lên server thì xoá drive-oauth.env và client_secret.json trên máy.

docs.title: Lỗi thường gặp
docs.text: Lỗi Cách xử lý client_secret.json must be an OAuth client (Desktop app) Tải nhầm key Service Account → tải JSON của OAuth client (bước 2.4) No refresh_token returned Vào https://myaccount.google.com/permissions → xoá quyền "Funny App Uploader" → chạy lại script Consent failed: access_denied Bấm Cancel ở màn hình consent, hoặc app còn Testing mà tài khoản không nằm trong Test users → Publish app (2.2) redirect_uri_mismatch Client không phải Desktop app → tạo lại đúng loại Address already in use Port 8765 đang bị dùng → tắt chương trình đó rồi chạy lại

docs.title: 4.3 yt-dlp và ffmpeg
docs.text:
yt-dlp --version
ffmpeg -version | head -1

Chưa có thì cài:

sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y ffmpeg
sudo curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp
sudo chmod a+rx /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp

Cài deno (JS runtime, yt-dlp bản mới cần để giải JS challenge của YouTube; thiếu thì mất format / 403):

command -v unzip || sudo apt install -y unzip
curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sudo DENO_INSTALL=/opt/deno sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path
sudo ln -sf /opt/deno/bin/deno /usr/local/bin/deno
deno --version

Không cần restart app — mỗi job gọi process yt-dlp mới, tự tìm deno trong PATH.

Tự update hằng ngày (YouTube/Facebook đổi liên tục):

echo '0 3 * * * root /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp -U >/dev/null 2>&1' | sudo tee /etc/cron.d/yt-dlp-update

docs.title: 4.4 Cookies (YouTube bắt buộc trên VM cloud, Facebook tuỳ chọn)
docs.text:
YouTube chặn IP datacenter (DigitalOcean, AWS, GCP…): mọi video, kể cả public, đều lỗi Sign in to confirm you're not a bot → app báo LOGIN_REQUIRED. Máy local (IP residential) không bị. Cách xử lý: cho yt-dlp dùng cookies của một tài khoản đã đăng nhập.

  1. Dùng tài khoản Google phụ (có rủi ro bị YouTube khoá).
  2. Mở cửa sổ ẩn danh → đăng nhập YouTube → export cookies định dạng Netscape (extension "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY") → đóng cửa sổ ẩn danh, không logout (logout làm cookies mất hiệu lực).
  3. Cần cả Facebook thì nối cookies Facebook vào cùng file — app chỉ đọc 1 file.
sudo cp cookies.txt /opt/funnyapp/cookies.txt
sudo chown <user-chạy-app> /opt/funnyapp/cookies.txt
sudo chmod 600 /opt/funnyapp/cookies.txt
# .env
VIDEO_IMPORT_COOKIES_PATH=/opt/funnyapp/cookies.txt

Kiểm tra trên server:

yt-dlp --cookies /opt/funnyapp/cookies.txt -J --skip-download -- "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw" >/dev/null && echo OK

Cookies chứa phiên đăng nhập, coi như mật khẩu. Cookies hết hạn sau vài tuần → lại LOGIN_REQUIRED → export lại.

  3. Bảng job: Đang tải về → Đang upload lên Drive → DONE / Chờ đồng bộ (≤15 phút).
  4. Mở folder Google Drive → thấy file {tiêu đề}.mp4, owner là tài khoản của bạn.

docs.title: Plan A: Trello Webhook → Claude Code File-Based Hooks
Overview
docs.text:
Approach: File-based trigger system where Trello webhooks write task files that Claude Code monitors and auto-processes.

Philosophy: "Don't call Claude, let Claude discover the work"

docs.title: Pros ✅
docs.text:
1. Decoupled: Spring Boot doesn't need to know about Claude Code internals
  2. Reliable: File system is persistent, survives crashes
  3. Observable: Easy to debug - just check task files
  4. Extensible: Multiple sources can write tasks (Trello, Jira, Slack, etc.)
  5. Queueing: Natural queue system via file system
  6. Status tracking: Can mark files as processing/done
  7. Full context: Claude Code has complete codebase access
  8. Auto git operations: Claude Code handles branch, commit, PR

docs.title: Cons ⚠️
docs.text:
1. Server setup: Requires Claude Code CLI installed on server
  2. Daemon process: Need a background watcher process
  3. File system overhead: Disk I/O for each task
  4. Polling latency: Small delay (1-5 seconds) between write and detection

docs.title: 1. Task File Format
docs.text:
Location: ~/.claude/tasks/pending/

File naming: {timestamp}_{trello_card_id}.json

Schema: 

{
  "id": "trello_card_123",
  "source": "trello",
  "title": "Implement user authentication",
  "description": "Add JWT-based authentication to the API endpoints...",
  "priority": "high",
  "labels": ["backend", "security"],
  "createdAt": "2026-02-08T10:30:00Z",
  "metadata": {
    "trelloCardUrl": "https://trello.com/c/abc123",
    "requestedBy": "user@example.com"
  }
}

docs.title: 2. Spring Boot Service
docs.text:
File: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/service/impl/TaskFileServiceImpl.java

@Service
@Slf4j
public class TaskFileServiceImpl implements TaskFileService {

    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    @Override
    @Async
    public void createTaskFile(String cardId, String title, String description, Map<String, Object> metadata) {
        try {
            // 1. Create task DTO
            TaskFileDTO task = TaskFileDTO.builder()
                    .id(cardId)
                    .source("trello")
                    .title(title)
                    .description(description)
                    .priority("normal")
                    .createdAt(Instant.now().toString())
                    .metadata(metadata)
                    .build();

            // 2. Generate filename
            String timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
            String filename = String.format("%d_%s.json", timestamp, cardId);

            // 3. Write to pending directory
            Path taskDir = Paths.get(appProperties.getClaudeTasksDir(), "pending");
            Files.createDirectories(taskDir);

            Path taskFile = taskDir.resolve(filename);
            objectMapper.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter()
                    .writeValue(taskFile.toFile(), task);

            log.info("Created task file: {}", taskFile);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to create task file for card {}: {}", cardId, e.getMessage(), e);
            throw new CustomException("Failed to create task file");
        }
    }
}

Webhook Integration:

public class TrelloWebhookServiceImpl implements TrelloWebhookService {

    private final TaskFileService taskFileService;

    @Override

docs.title: 3. Claude Code File Watcher Hook
docs.text:
Location: ~/.claude/hooks/on-startup.sh

Implementation: 

#!/bin/bash
# Claude Code startup hook - watches for new task files

TASKS_DIR="$HOME/.claude/tasks/pending"
PROCESSING_DIR="$HOME/.claude/tasks/processing"
COMPLETED_DIR="$HOME/.claude/tasks/completed"

mkdir -p "$TASKS_DIR" "$PROCESSING_DIR" "$COMPLETED_DIR"

# Start file watcher in background
while true; do
    # Find new task files
    for task_file in "$TASKS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [ -e "$task_file" ] || continue  # No files found

        echo "Found new task: $task_file"

        # Move to processing
        filename=$(basename "$task_file")
        mv "$task_file" "$PROCESSING_DIR/$filename"

        # Extract task info
        task_id=$(jq -r '.id' "$PROCESSING_DIR/$filename")
        task_title=$(jq -r '.title' "$PROCESSING_DIR/$filename")
        task_desc=$(jq -r '.description' "$PROCESSING_DIR/$filename")

        # Spawn Claude Code CLI
        echo "Spawning claude-code for task: $task_title"

        cd "$HOME/projects/assessment" || exit

        claude-code --non-interactive <<EOF
Implement the following task:

Title: $task_title

Description:
$task_desc

Follow existing code patterns in the codebase.
Create a feature branch, implement the code, write tests, commit, and create a PR.

Task ID: $task_id
EOF

        # Mark as completed
        mv "$PROCESSING_DIR/$filename" "$COMPLETED_DIR/$filename"
        echo "Completed task: $task_title"
    done

    # Wait 5 seconds before next check
    sleep 5
done

Alternative: Using inotify (Linux) for instant detection: 

#!/bin/bash
# More efficient - triggers immediately on file creation

TASKS_DIR="$HOME/.claude/tasks/pending"

inotifywait -m -e create "$TASKS_DIR" --format '%f' | while read filename; do
    if [[ $filename == *.json ]]; then
        echo "New task detected: $filename"
        # ... process task ...
    fi
done

docs.title: Failed Tasks
docs.text:
Retry logic in hook: 

max_attempts=3
current_attempt=$(jq -r '.attempts // 0' "$task_file")

if [ "$current_attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]; then
    # Increment attempt counter
    jq '.attempts += 1' "$task_file" > "$task_file.tmp"
    mv "$task_file.tmp" "$task_file"

    # Move back to pending for retry
    mv "$task_file" "$TASKS_DIR/"
else
    # Max attempts reached, mark as failed
    jq '.status = "failed" | .lastError = "Max attempts reached"' "$task_file" > "$FAILED_DIR/$filename"
fi

docs.title: Stuck Tasks
docs.text:
Cleanup script: 

#!/bin/bash
# Remove tasks stuck in processing > 1 hour

find ~/.claude/tasks/processing -name "*.json" -mmin +60 | while read task; do
    echo "Found stuck task: $task"
    filename=$(basename "$task")
    mv "$task" ~/.claude/tasks/failed/
done

Cron job: 

# Run cleanup every hour
0 * * * * /home/appuser/scripts/cleanup-stuck-tasks.sh

docs.title: Security Considerations
docs.text:
1. File permissions: 

    chmod 700 ~/.claude/tasks/
chmod 600 ~/.claude/tasks/*/*.json

  2. Input validation:

    • Sanitize task descriptions (prevent code injection)
    • Validate JSON schema before processing
    • Limit file size (max 100KB per task)

  3. Rate limiting:

    • Max 10 tasks per minute
    • Max 100 tasks per hour

  4. Isolation:

    • Run watcher as dedicated user
    • Use Docker container for Claude Code execution

docs.title: Single Server
docs.text:
• Throughput: ~10-20 tasks/hour (depends on task complexity)
  • Queue size: File system limited (~1000s of files)
  • Bottleneck: Claude Code processing time

docs.title: Multi-Server (Future)
docs.text:
Use Redis + queue system: 

Trello → Spring Boot → Redis Queue → Multiple Workers → Claude Code

docs.title: Cost Estimation
docs.text:
Assumptions:

  • 10 tasks/day
  • Average 2000 tokens input + 4000 tokens output per task
  • Claude Sonnet 4.5 pricing

Monthly cost: ~$5-10

docs.title: Alternative: Polling Instead of File Watching
docs.text:
If file watching is complex, use polling from Spring Boot:

@Scheduled(fixedRate = 30000) // Every 30 seconds
public void processTaskQueue() {
    Path pendingDir = Paths.get(appProperties.getClaudeTasksDir(), "pending");

    try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(pendingDir)) {
        files.filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".json"))
             .forEach(this::spawnClaudeCode);
    }
}

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
Best for:

  • ✅ Production systems with high reliability needs
  • ✅ Multiple task sources (Trello, Jira, Slack, etc.)
  • ✅ Audit trail and status tracking required
  • ✅ Decoupled architecture

Not ideal for:

  • ❌ Simple use cases (overkill)
  • ❌ Instant response needed (<1 second)
  • ❌ Serverless environments

docs.title: Plan: Admin Comment Moderation (Content Manager → Comments)
Overview
docs.text: Status: Draft Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-02 Related: ADR-0007 Admin Dashboard, ADR-0015 Bitwise Permissions, plan-admin-dashboard Decision class: Two-Way Door — additive nullable/defaulted columns on video_comments, new admin endpoints, new FE tab. No ADR; decisions recorded below.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Admins can review every comment in the Content Manager and remove comments that violate the community policy (with a reason), and restore them if removed by mistake. Removed comments disappear from the public feed immediately, but the record is kept for audit.

docs.title: In Scope
docs.text:
• New COMMENTS tab in AdminView (CONTENT_MANAGER)
  • List all comments (newest first, paginated) with filters: status, keyword, video
  • Remove (soft) with a policy reason + optional note; Restore
  • Public comment API hides removed comments
  • Audit: @AuditLog + moderated_by / moderated_at on the row
  • Stats card: removed comments count

docs.title: Out of Scope (follow-ups)
docs.text:
• User "Report comment" button / report queue
  • Auto-moderation (ChatGPT / keyword filter)
  • Banning or muting the comment author
  • Bulk actions
  • Hiding author email in the public comments API (separate privacy fix)

docs.title: Policy Reasons
docs.text:
Stored as enum CommentModerationReason:

Code Meaning SPAM Spam, ads, repeated links HARASSMENT Insults, bullying, personal attacks HATE_SPEECH Hate based on race, religion, gender… SEXUAL Sexual / NSFW content VIOLENCE Threats, incitement to violence PERSONAL_INFO Doxxing, phone numbers, addresses OTHER Anything else — note required

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
[AdminView → COMMENTS tab → AdminCommentTable]
        ↓ useAdminComments / useModerateComment
[api/admin.js]
  GET   /v1/funny-app/admin/comments?status=&q=&videoId=&page=&size=
  PATCH /v1/funny-app/admin/comments/{id}/moderation   {action: REMOVE|RESTORE, reason?, note?}
  GET   /v1/funny-app/admin/stats                       (+ removedComments)
        ↓ Spring Boot (class-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"))
[AdminController] → [AdminCommentService / Impl] → [VideoCommentRepository, VideoSourceRepository]
        ↓
[PostgreSQL: video_comments (+ status, moderation_* columns)]

docs.title: Key Decisions
docs.text: Decision Choice Rationale Removal type Soft remove (status = REMOVED) Reversible, keeps evidence for disputes/audit; hard delete stays only for owner self-delete Replies of a removed comment Public tree shows placeholder "Bình luận đã bị gỡ do vi phạm chính sách" (no author/content) if it has visible replies; otherwise omitted Keeps thread structure without leaking removed content Who can moderate ADMIN role (class-level, existing) + @HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN) Same as other admin endpoints; no new permission bit until a content-manager role is needed Paging Spring Pageable, ResultObjectInfo<Page<AdminCommentDto>>, default size 20 sort createdAt DESC Matches GET /admin/videos Filtering JPA Specification (status, content ILIKE %q%, videoId) Optional combinable filters without query explosion Video title in list Batch lookup: collect videoIds on the page → VideoSourceRepository.findAllById → map video_id is VARCHAR without FK; avoids N+1 Audit @AuditLog("moderateComment") + persisted moderated_by (admin email), moderated_at, moderation_reason, moderation_note Who/when/why visible in UI and logs Owner delete of a removed comment Still allowed (hard delete) Owner's right to erase own data

docs.title: Schema change
docs.text:
ALTER TABLE video_comments
    ADD COLUMN status            VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VISIBLE',
    ADD COLUMN moderation_reason VARCHAR(30),
    ADD COLUMN moderation_note   VARCHAR(500),
    ADD COLUMN moderated_by      VARCHAR(255),
    ADD COLUMN moderated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ;

ALTER TABLE video_comments
    ADD CONSTRAINT chk_video_comments_status CHECK (status IN ('VISIBLE', 'REMOVED'));

CREATE INDEX idx_video_comments_status_created ON video_comments (status, created_at DESC);

ADD COLUMN … DEFAULT <constant> is metadata-only on PostgreSQL 11+, so no table rewrite.

docs.title: Plan: Admin Drive Force Sync (Google Drive ↔ local ↔ DB)
Overview
docs.text:
Status: In Review (FS-1..FS-4 implemented 2026-10-11; FS-5 prod E2E pending) Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-11 Size: Small (~2.5 d) → plan only, no PRD/ADR (decision below is a Two-Way Door except the unique index, gated by FS-0)

Admin tab DRIVE_SYNC shows every video in the Drive folder next to its local file and DB row. ADMIN can view the tab (states + run progress). Only SUPER_ADMIN can select files and click Force Sync: the server downloads them like the cron does, but always re-downloads and upserts the video_sources row instead of skipping existing ones.

docs.title: Verified Facts (exploration 2026-10-11)
docs.text: Area Fact Impact Cron AppScheduler.syncDriveVideos every 15 min, window createdTime >= now-60m Files older than the window are never retried → the reason force sync is needed Download VideoStorageServiceImpl.downloadFileFromFolder writes directly to video-cache/{id}.full, skips if the file exists A crash mid-download leaves a partial file the cron skips forever → move to temp + atomic rename DB save saveInfo skips when existsBySourceId Force needs an upsert path Uniqueness video_sources.source_id has no unique constraint (202506220101-create-source-stream.sql) ON CONFLICT needs UNIQUE (source_type, source_id) → prod duplicate check first (FS-0) Source type Only "google_drive" is written Index on (source_type, source_id) Drive scope Service Account, DriveScopes.DRIVE (full) Request ids must be checked against the folder listing (else any Drive file the SA can read could be pulled) Caches VideoCache / ChunkIndexCache hold chunks by fileId Re-downloaded file → evict that file's chunks + chunk index Roles UserRole + RoleHierarchy (SA ⊃ ADMIN); controllers use class-level hasRole('ADMIN') Class-level hasRole('ADMIN') (SA inherits) for reads; method-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')") on the POST Admin FE AdminView TABS, polling via refetchInterval in useAdmin.js, isAdminRole in utils/roles.js Same pattern; add isSuperAdmin Lock No per-file lock between jobs; synchronized prohibited (tech-strategy) ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet() claim, shared by cron + force sync

docs.title: Sync state per Drive file (GET listing)
docs.text:
State Local .full DB row Meaning SYNCED ✅ size == Drive size ✅ Nothing to do MISSING_LOCAL ❌ ✅ App shows it but cannot stream MISSING_DB ✅ ❌ Downloaded, not on app MISSING_BOTH ❌ ❌ Cron window missed it SIZE_MISMATCH ✅ size ≠ Drive size any Partial/old download SYNCING — — Currently held by cron or a force run

DB rows whose file is no longer on Drive are listed as ORPHAN (read-only, no action in this scope).

docs.title: Force sync run
docs.text:
• POST /admin/drive-sync/runs {fileIds: [...]} → 202 + run snapshot. Max 50 ids, each must be in the current folder listing (else 400 NOT_IN_FOLDER).
  • One run at a time (AtomicReference<RunState>.compareAndSet), 409 SYNC_RUNNING otherwise.
  • Executes on a virtual thread, files sequentially (same disk/bandwidth profile as the importer).
  • Per file: claim lock (DriveFileLocks, shared with the cron; held → status SKIPPED_BUSY) → disk guard (Drive size + minFreeDisk) → download to {id}.full.part with a counting stream (progress bytes) → atomic Files.move(REPLACE_EXISTING, ATOMIC_MOVE) → evict VideoCache/ChunkIndexCache for that id → thumbnail (ffmpeg) → upsert → release lock, delete .part in finally.
  • Progress is in-memory (run id, per-file QUEUED/DOWNLOADING/SAVING/DONE/FAILED/SKIPPED_BUSY, bytes/total, error code). Polling GET /admin/drive-sync/runs/current every 2 s while active. Lost on restart by design; startup deletes stale *.part.

docs.title: Upsert (native, VideoSourceRepository.upsertDriveSource)
docs.text:
INSERT INTO video_sources (video_id, source_type, source_id, title, description, credentials_ref,
                           thumbnail_path, is_hide, status, priority, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (:videoId, 'google_drive', :sourceId, :title, :desc, '', :thumb, false, 'PUBLISHED', 0, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) DO UPDATE
   SET title          = EXCLUDED.title,
       thumbnail_path = EXCLUDED.thumbnail_path,
       description    = COALESCE(video_sources.description, EXCLUDED.description),
       updated_at     = now();
Kept on update (owner decision 2026-10-11): video_id, status, priority, is_hide, view_count, an existing description. The ChatGPT poem is only requested when the row has no description (makeDesc fallback stays).

docs.title: Security
docs.text:
• Reads (GET /files, GET /runs/current): class-level hasRole('ADMIN') → ADMIN and SA (role hierarchy).
  • Write (POST /runs): method-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')") + @AuditLog + @RateLimited(permit = 5); ADMIN → 403.
  • Folder-membership check (above) prevents pulling arbitrary Drive files (CWE-639).
  • FE shows the tab to every admin role; checkboxes and FORCE_SYNC are disabled for ADMIN with a tooltip ("Chỉ SUPER_ADMIN được force sync"), same pattern as AdminAccountTable lockReason. BE is the enforcement.

docs.title: Owner Decisions (2026-10-11)
docs.text:
1. Force on SYNCED files: always re-download from Drive (replace local file, evict chunk caches, upsert).
  2. Moderation fields: upsert keeps is_hide / status / priority (a hidden video stays hidden).
  3. Title: always overwritten with the Drive file name (Drive name is the title source of truth).
  4. Access: ADMIN can view (file states, run progress); only SUPER_ADMIN can start a force sync.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Status: Done 2026-10-19 · first run issue #26 → PR #27 merged (b0a2d7a1) Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-19 ADR: ADR-0022 (gates on GitHub, owner-only triggers, least privilege) Related plan: plan-autopilot (the local skill this extends) Size: Small (~half a day)

docs.title: Objective
docs.text:
Start /autopilot from GitHub and approve it there, without a terminal:

  1. Start: the owner adds the label autopilot to an issue.
  2. Plan: a draft PR opens with the plan.
  3. Gate 1: the owner comments /approve.
  4. Build: the PR gets the code, tests and report.
  5. Gate 2: the owner merges, which deploys through the normal CI.

Build job triggers on /approve. Both require sender == owner. Only numbers and ids reach prompt and run:. Only CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is referenced. 60 min timeout, concurrency 1 done AH-3 SKILL.md headless mode The three --headless forms. Untrusted-input rules and path denylist. Gates mapped to draft PR / merge. No push to main done AH-4 Guide vi/en: headless section How to set up, how to run, what is refused done AH-5 (owner) Setup Run claude setup-token, then gh secret set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; create the autopilot label done AH-QA-1 (owner) First run on a tiny issue Label → draft PR with plan → /approve → PR ready with report → merge → CI green done: #26 → #27. It took 3 plan runs and needed 3 workflow fixes

docs.title: Plan: /autopilot Skill (Plan → Review → Build → QA → Land)
Overview
docs.text: Status: Built 2026-10-19 · AU-1, AU-3 f8fa31ce; AU-2, AU-4, AU-5 d52f6b2e; QA-1 first run 2026-10-19 → report Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-19 ADR: none. This is dev tooling inside .claude/, it changes no app code or stored data, and deleting the skill folder undoes it (swarm-plan Artifact Requirements). The existing skills, agents, and the "ask before push" rule stay as they are. Size: Small feature (~1 day), so this plan is the only artifact (no PRD).

docs.title: Objective
docs.text:
One user-invoked skill, /autopilot <feature request>, runs the whole workflow as a chain. A human is needed at only three gates:

Start ─▶ Plan ⇄ Plan review ─▶ [GATE 1: you approve plan] ─▶ Implement ⇄ Code review
      ─▶ Local QA (tests ×2) ⇄ Fix ─▶ Commit on main ─▶ [GATE 2: you approve push] ─▶ CI + smoke ─▶ Done
  • Each loop (⇄) has a cap of 3 rounds. When a loop reaches the cap, the run stops with status: blocked and asks the user. It never loops forever.
  • Reviews return a verdict with blocking / advisory counts. Only a blocking finding sends the work back.
  • QA runs the affected tests twice:
    • Fails once, passes once → flaky. Logged, does not block.
    • Fails both times → fail, goes to Fix.
  • Every step is recorded in a run ledger: turns, duration, tokens. At the end the run prints a summary table like the Autopilot screenshot.
  • The final step is a commit on main, not a draft PR (core-directives: trunk-based, CI deploys from main). The push still needs the user's go-ahead.

docs.title: Verified Facts (exploration 2026-10-19)
docs.text: Area Fact Impact Skills 15 skills had disable-model-invocation: true; the 5 autopilot uses were switched to false on 2026-10-19 (owner may flip back any time) Primary path calls them via the Skill tool; fallback (D1) runs a worker that reads the SKILL.md when the flag is true again Workers worker-builder sonnet/90 turns, worker-reviewer sonnet/60, worker-explorer haiku/30, worker-architect opus/40. None has Agent in its tools The orchestrator is the main session, so there is no nesting (agent-constraints). Model tiering stays in the agent frontmatter Verdict swarm-review has an Approve / Request Changes framework but no machine-readable output Add a small verdict contract that the orchestrator can parse (D2) Landing AGENTS.md "Landing the Plane": quality gates → commit → ask → push → CI → smoke (./api/mock-test.sh) Autopilot Gate 2 = this protocol, reused unchanged Tracking session.txt rules (.claude/rules/session-file.md), TASKS.md per-feature section Autopilot writes both after each stage, so /task-resume can continue a stopped run Cost data Agent completion results report tool uses, tokens and duration. There is no $ figure The ledger records turns, minutes and tokens. $ is an estimate from tokens × the model price table, labelled "≈"

docs.title: Design Decisions
docs.text:
• D1 — Call skills directly, fall back to workers. On 2026-10-19 five skills were set to disable-model-invocation: false so the orchestrator can call them with the Skill tool: swarm-plan, swarm-review, swarm-execute, qa-engineer, land-the-plane.

    Stage Primary: Skill tool Fallback: worker reads the SKILL.md Plan swarm-plan worker-architect (opus) if an ADR is needed, otherwise worker-builder Plan review / code review swarm-review worker-reviewer Implement / Fix swarm-execute worker-builder Local QA specs qa-engineer worker-builder (+ testing skill) Land land-the-plane Orchestrator follows AGENTS.md "Landing the Plane" itself

    Fallback rule. The fallback is used for a stage when its skill is unavailable:

    • the owner set the flag back to true;
    • the Skill tool refuses the call;
    • the skill is missing.

    The fallback worker gets "Read .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follow its method" plus the stage input, and must end with the same verdict contract (D2). The run ledger records which path each stage used (skill / fallback), so flipping the flag never breaks a run. Either way, the rules stay in one place (DRY).

  • D2 — Verdict contract. Every review worker ends its reply with a fenced block, and the orchestrator parses only that block: 

    VERDICT: approve | revise
BLOCKING: <n>
ADVISORY: <n>
- [B] file:line — finding
- [A] file:line — finding
    revise with BLOCKING: 0 is treated as approve. Advisories go into the ledger and the summary but never trigger a loop.

  • D3 — Round caps. Plan⇄review ≤ 3, implement⇄review ≤ 3, QA⇄fix ≤ 3. Going over a cap means blocked, with a summary of what failed.

  • D4 — Flaky detection script. scripts/qa-twice.sh takes the backend test classes and webapp test files to run.
    • It runs each set twice: mvn -q test -Dtest=… and npx vitest run ….
    • It prints pass / flaky / fail per test.
    • The full gates (mvn verify, npm run test, npm run lint) still run once before the commit.
  • D5 — Ledger. The ledger lives at scratchpad/autopilot/<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>-<slug>.md (ephemeral) and holds one row per worker run: stage, round, verdict, turns, min, tokens, ≈$. The run report (results + ledger + cost) goes to docs/reports/autopilot-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md, so a durable record stays in docs/. The plan artifact is not edited for it (owner, 2026-10-19).
  • D6 — Scope guard. Autopilot refuses tasks that need a PR-FAQ or PRD (Medium/Large features per swarm-plan) and points to /scope. It targets small features and fixes.
  • D8 — Plan mode (added 2026-10-19). /autopilot docs/plans/plan-<x>.md runs on an existing plan, e.g. one made by /swarm-plan.
    • Skipped: only the Plan stage.
    • Kept: Plan review (that plan has not been through a reviewer yet) and Gate 1. Without them, autopilot would just be /swarm-execute.
    • Scope: only tasks still [ ] in TASKS.md. Owner-only QA/prod checks are not counted or run.
    • Refused (→ /swarm-execute): more than 8 open tasks (6 until 2026-10-24), any task [~], or the plan's Status is Done.
  • D9 — Exact cost (added 2026-10-19). scripts/claude-cost.mjs prices every API request found in the session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl + subagents/*.jsonl). It dedupes by message.id and uses the cache write 5m/1h split, the Haiku long-prompt tier, fast mode and US-geo. Prices come from scripts/claude-pricing.json (pricing page, read 2026-10-19). It replaces the ≈$ estimate, which was too low because Agent result token totals miss repeated cache reads.
  • D7 — Gates are never skipped. Gate 1 (plan) and Gate 2 (push) always use AskUserQuestion. There is no --yes flag. This follows the standing "ask before every push" rule. Amended by ADR-0028 (2026-10-22): opt-in --auto / --auto-push typed in the command.

docs.title: Tasks
docs.text:
ID Task Acceptance criteria Depends on AU-1 .claude/skills/autopilot/SKILL.md: stages, gates, round caps, worker prompt templates, scope guard disable-model-invocation: true; every stage names its worker + referenced skill; caps = 3; both gates use AskUserQuestion; no rule text copied from other skills — AU-2 .claude/skills/autopilot/resources/verdict.md: verdict contract + parsing rules; review prompts include it A sample reviewer reply parses to {verdict, blocking, advisory}; revise + 0 blocking → approve AU-1 AU-3 scripts/qa-twice.sh Runs given BE classes / FE files twice; exit 0 on pass or flaky-only, 1 on any double fail; prints a per-test status table; no secrets or prod calls — AU-4 Ledger + tracking: ledger file format, session.txt update after each stage, TASKS.md section, summary appended to the plan After a stage, session.txt shows the stage in doing/done; final summary table has rows per run + total AU-1 AU-5 Docs: list /autopilot in CLAUDE.md user-invoked skills, AGENTS.md pointer that Gate 2 = Landing the Plane Both files mention the skill; nothing else changes AU-1 QA-1 Dry run on a real small task: code-health finding #6 (CommentPanel useQuery) Run reaches Gate 2 with a ledger + summary; at least one review verdict parsed; owner approves or rejects the push AU-1..AU-4

Order: AU-1 and AU-3 can run in parallel → AU-2, AU-4 → AU-5 → QA-1.

docs.title: Risks
docs.text: Risk Mitigation Reviewer forgets the verdict block The parser treats a missing block as revise with a note and re-asks once. Missing it twice → blocked Cost overrun on a long run The ledger total is shown at each gate. The run stops at the round caps mvn test ×2 is slow Only affected test classes run twice. The full suite runs once Orchestrator context grows over many stages Workers return only a summary + verdict. The plan file and ledger are re-read after each stage (Stale Context Check)

docs.title: Plan B: Trello Webhook → Direct Claude Code CLI Spawn
Overview
docs.text:
Approach: Direct process spawning where Spring Boot immediately executes Claude Code CLI when webhook is received.

Philosophy: "Immediate execution, simple pipeline"

docs.title: Pros ✅
docs.text:
1. Simple: Minimal moving parts, direct execution
  2. Fast: No file I/O, no polling delay
  3. Synchronous option: Can wait for result if needed
  4. Less infrastructure: No daemon/watcher needed
  5. Easy debugging: Direct logs from Claude Code
  6. Full context: Claude Code has complete codebase access
  7. Built-in features: Auto git operations, testing, PR creation

docs.title: Cons ⚠️
docs.text:
1. Process management: Need to handle long-running processes
  2. Server setup: Requires Claude Code CLI installed
  3. Resource intensive: Each request spawns new process
  4. Error handling: Process failures harder to recover
  5. No queue: Tasks execute immediately (no backpressure)
  6. Blocking: Webhook response delayed if synchronous

docs.title: 1. Claude Code Service
docs.text:
File: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/service/impl/ClaudeCodeServiceImpl.java

@Service
@Slf4j
public class ClaudeCodeServiceImpl implements ClaudeCodeService {

    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final ExecutorService executorService;

    public ClaudeCodeServiceImpl(AppProperties appProperties) {
        this.appProperties = appProperties;
        // Thread pool for async process execution
        this.executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(5);
    }

    @Override
    @Async
    public void implementTask(String taskId, String title, String description) {
        executorService.submit(() -> {
            try {
                log.info("Starting implementation for task: {}", title);

                // Build task prompt
                String prompt = buildPrompt(taskId, title, description);

                // Spawn Claude Code CLI
                ProcessResult result = spawnClaudeCode(prompt);

                if (result.exitCode == 0) {
                    log.info("Task {} completed successfully", taskId);
                    notifySuccess(taskId, result);
                } else {
                    log.error("Task {} failed with exit code {}", taskId, result.exitCode);
                    notifyFailure(taskId, result);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Failed to execute task {}: {}", taskId, e.getMessage(), e);
                notifyFailure(taskId, e.getMessage());
            }
        });
    }

    private ProcessResult spawnClaudeCode(String prompt) throws Exception {
        // 1. Create temporary prompt file
        Path promptFile = Files.createTempFile("claude-prompt-", ".txt");
        Files.writeString(promptFile, prompt);

        // 2. Build command
        List<String> command = List.of(
            "claude-code",
            "--non-interactive",
            "--input", promptFile.toString(),
            "--project", appProperties.getProjectPath()
        );

        // 3. Configure process
        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(command);
        pb.directory(new File(appProperties.getProjectPath()));
        pb.redirectErrorStream(true);

        // Set environment variables
        Map<String, String> env = pb.environment();
        env.put("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", appProperties.getAnthropicApiKey());

        // 4. Start process
        Process process = pb.start();

        // 5. Capture output
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                new InputStreamReader(process.getInputStream()))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                output.append(line).append("\n");
                log.debug("Claude Code: {}", line);
            }
        }

        // 6. Wait for completion (with timeout)
        boolean finished = process.waitFor(30, TimeUnit.MINUTES);

        if (!finished) {
            process.destroyForcibly();
            throw new TimeoutException("Claude Code execution timeout");
        }

        // 7. Cleanup
        Files.deleteIfExists(promptFile);

        return new ProcessResult(process.exitValue(), output.toString());
    }

    private String buildPrompt(String taskId, String title, String description) {
        return String.format("""
            You are a Java Spring Boot expert working on the Funny Movies project.

            Implement the following task:

            Task ID: %s
            Title: %s

            Description:
            %s

            Requirements:
            1. Follow existing code patterns in the codebase (see CLAUDE.md)
            2. Create a feature branch: feature/%s
            3. Implement the code following SOLID principles
            4. Write unit tests with proper coverage
            5. Commit changes with descriptive message
            6. Create a pull request

            Use the project structure:
            - Controllers: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/web/
            - Services: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/service/
            - Repositories: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/repo/
            - DTOs: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/dto/

            Follow the tech stack: Java 24, Spring Boot 3.x, PostgreSQL, Virtual Threads
            """,
            taskId,
            title,
            description,
            taskId.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9-]", "-").toLowerCase()
        );
    }

    private void notifySuccess(String taskId, ProcessResult result) {
        // Extract PR URL from output
        String prUrl = extractPrUrl(result.output);
        log.info("Task {} completed. PR: {}", taskId, prUrl);

        // TODO: Post comment back to Trello card with PR link
        // TODO: Send Slack notification
    }

    private void notifyFailure(String taskId, ProcessResult result) {
        log.error("Task {} failed. Output:\n{}", taskId, result.output);

        // TODO: Post error comment to Trello card
        // TODO: Send alert
    }

    private String extractPrUrl(String output) {
        // Parse Claude Code output for PR URL
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("https://github\\.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/\\d+");
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(output);
        if (matcher.find()) {
            return matcher.group();
        }
        return null;
    }

    @PreDestroy
    public void shutdown() {
        executorService.shutdown();
        try {
            if (!executorService.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                executorService.shutdownNow();
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            executorService.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Data
    @AllArgsConstructor
    private static class ProcessResult {
        private int exitCode;
        private String output;
    }
}

docs.text:
File: api/src/main/java/com/canhlabs/funnyapp/service/impl/TrelloWebhookServiceImpl.java

@Service
@Slf4j
public class TrelloWebhookServiceImpl implements TrelloWebhookService {

    private final ClaudeCodeService claudeCodeService;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @Override
    @Async
    public void processWebhook(TrelloWebhookDTO payload, String signature) {
        // 1. Verify signature
        if (!verifySignature(payload, signature)) {
            log.warn("Invalid Trello webhook signature");
            return;
        }

        // 2. Parse action type
        String actionType = payload.getAction().getType();
        if (!"addLabelToCard".equals(actionType)) {
            log.debug("Ignoring action type: {}", actionType);
            return;
        }

        // 3. Check label name
        String labelName = payload.getAction().getData().getLabel().getName();
        if (!"doing".equalsIgnoreCase(labelName)) {
            log.debug("Ignoring label: {}", labelName);
            return;
        }

        // 4. Extract card details
        TrelloWebhookDTO.Card card = payload.getAction().getData().getCard();
        String cardId = card.getId();
        String cardName = card.getName();
        String cardDesc = card.getDesc();

        log.info("Triggering implementation for Trello card: {} ({})", cardName, cardId);

        // 5. Trigger Claude Code
        claudeCodeService.implementTask(cardId, cardName, cardDesc);
    }

    private boolean verifySignature(TrelloWebhookDTO payload, String signature) {
        try {
            String callbackUrl = appProperties.getTrelloCallbackUrl();
            String secret = appProperties.getTrelloWebhookSecret();

            ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
            String body = mapper.writeValueAsString(payload);
            String content = body + callbackUrl;

            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA1");
            SecretKeySpec secretKey = new SecretKeySpec(secret.getBytes(), "HmacSHA1");
            mac.init(secretKey);

            byte[] hash = mac.doFinal(content.getBytes());
            String computed = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(hash);

            return computed.equals(signature);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Signature verification failed", e);
            return false;
        }
    }
}

@RestController
@RequestMapping(AppConstant.API.BASE_URL + "/webhook")
@Slf4j
public class TrelloWebhookController extends BaseController {

    private final TrelloWebhookService webhookService;

    public TrelloWebhookController(TrelloWebhookService webhookService) {
        this.webhookService = webhookService;
    }

    /**
     * Trello webhook verification endpoint
     */
    @RequestMapping(value = "/trello", method = RequestMethod.HEAD)
    public ResponseEntity<Void> verifyWebhook() {
        log.info("Trello webhook verification request");
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    /**
     * Trello webhook callback endpoint
     */
    @PostMapping("/trello")
    public ResponseEntity<ResultObjectInfo<String>> handleWebhook(
            @RequestBody TrelloWebhookDTO payload,
            @RequestHeader(value = "X-Trello-Webhook", required = false) String signature) {

        log.info("Received Trello webhook: action={}, cardId={}",
                payload.getAction().getType(),
                payload.getAction().getData().getCard().getId());

        // Process asynchronously - don't block webhook response
        webhookService.processWebhook(payload, signature);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(ResultObjectInfo.<String>builder()
                .status(ResultStatus.SUCCESS)
                .message("Webhook received")
                .data("OK")
                .build());
    }

    /**
     * Health check endpoint
     */
    @GetMapping("/trello/health")
    public ResponseEntity<ResultObjectInfo<Map<String, Object>>> health() {
        Map<String, Object> status = Map.of(
            "status", "up",
            "timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis(),
            "claudeCode", checkClaudeCodeInstalled()
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(ResultObjectInfo.<Map<String, Object>>builder()
                .status(ResultStatus.SUCCESS)
                .data(status)
                .build());
    }

    private boolean checkClaudeCodeInstalled() {
        try {
            Process process = new ProcessBuilder("claude-code", "--version").start();
            return process.waitFor(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) && process.exitValue() == 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 6. Enhanced Version: Background Process Management
docs.text:
For better control over Claude Code processes:

@Service
@Slf4j
public class ClaudeCodeProcessManager {

    private final Map<String, Process> runningProcesses = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, ProcessStatus> processStatuses = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public CompletableFuture<ProcessResult> executeTask(String taskId, String prompt) {
        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
            try {
                // Mark as running
                processStatuses.put(taskId, ProcessStatus.RUNNING);

                // Spawn process
                Process process = startClaudeCode(prompt);
                runningProcesses.put(taskId, process);

                // Wait for completion
                ProcessResult result = waitForCompletion(process, taskId);

                // Update status
                processStatuses.put(taskId,
                    result.exitCode == 0 ? ProcessStatus.SUCCESS : ProcessStatus.FAILED);

                return result;

            } catch (Exception e) {
                processStatuses.put(taskId, ProcessStatus.FAILED);
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            } finally {
                runningProcesses.remove(taskId);
            }
        });
    }

    public void cancelTask(String taskId) {
        Process process = runningProcesses.get(taskId);
        if (process != null && process.isAlive()) {
            process.destroyForcibly();
            processStatuses.put(taskId, ProcessStatus.CANCELLED);
            log.info("Cancelled task: {}", taskId);
        }
    }

    public ProcessStatus getStatus(String taskId) {
        return processStatuses.getOrDefault(taskId, ProcessStatus.UNKNOWN);
    }

    public List<String> getRunningTasks() {
        return new ArrayList<>(runningProcesses.keySet());
    }

    public enum ProcessStatus {
        PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELLED, UNKNOWN
    }
}

@Component
public class ClaudeCodeMetrics {

    private final Counter tasksStarted;
    private final Counter tasksCompleted;

docs.title: Retry Logic
docs.text:
public void implementTaskWithRetry(String taskId, String title, String description) {
    int maxRetries = 3;
    int attempt = 0;

    while (attempt < maxRetries) {
        try {
            implementTask(taskId, title, description);
            return; // Success
        } catch (Exception e) {
            attempt++;
            log.warn("Task {} failed on attempt {}/{}: {}",
                    taskId, attempt, maxRetries, e.getMessage());

            if (attempt >= maxRetries) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Task failed after " + maxRetries + " attempts", e);
            }

            // Exponential backoff
            Thread.sleep(1000L * (1 << attempt));
        }
    }
}

docs.title: Security Considerations
docs.text:
1. Signature Verification: Always verify Trello webhook signatures
  2. Input Sanitization: Sanitize task descriptions to prevent injection
  3. Rate Limiting: Limit concurrent Claude Code processes (max 5)
  4. Resource Limits: Set CPU/memory limits for spawned processes
  5. API Key Protection: Store ANTHROPIC_API_KEY securely (env vars, not in code)
  6. Process Isolation: Consider running Claude Code in Docker container

docs.title: Cost Estimation
docs.text:
Assumptions:

  • 10 tasks/day
  • Average 2000 tokens input + 4000 tokens output per task
  • Claude Sonnet 4.5 pricing: $3/M input, $15/M output

Monthly cost:

  • Input: 10 tasks × 2000 tokens × 30 days = 600k tokens = $1.80
  • Output: 10 tasks × 4000 tokens × 30 days = 1.2M tokens = $18.00
  • Total: ~$20/month

docs.title: Comparison with Plan A (File-Based)
docs.text: Feature Plan A (File-Based) Plan B (Direct Spawn) Complexity Medium (daemon + files) Low (direct execution) Latency 1-5 seconds (polling) <1 second Reliability High (persistent queue) Medium (in-memory) Scalability Easy (add workers) Limited (thread pool) Debugging Easy (file audit trail) Medium (process logs) Infrastructure More (daemon + watcher) Less (just Spring Boot) Recovery Easy (reprocess files) Hard (lost if crash)

docs.title: When to Use Plan B
docs.text:
Best for:

  • ✅ Simple use cases with low volume (<20 tasks/day)
  • ✅ Fast prototyping and MVP
  • ✅ Teams comfortable with process management
  • ✅ Single server deployments

Not ideal for:

  • ❌ High-volume production systems
  • ❌ Distributed/multi-server setups
  • ❌ Need for audit trail and recovery
  • ❌ Serverless or containerized environments

docs.title: Migration Path
docs.text:
Start with Plan B for simplicity, then migrate to Plan A when:

  1. Task volume exceeds 50/day
  2. Need better reliability and recovery
  3. Adding multiple task sources
  4. Require detailed audit trails

docs.title: Summary
docs.text: Plan B offers the simplest implementation path with direct Claude Code CLI spawning. It's perfect for small-to-medium deployments where immediate execution and low infrastructure overhead are priorities. The trade-off is reduced reliability and scalability compared to the queue-based Plan A approach.

docs.title: Key Decisions (from ADR-0012)
docs.text: Decision Choice Rationale Bookmark state delivery GET /bookmarks/ids at page load, client-side Set.has() Preserves Guava LRU cache; max ~4 KB payload at 500-cap FK strategy Actual DB FK constraints with @ManyToOne Bookmarks require referential integrity; no guest-user flexibility needed ON DELETE video_id SET NULL + source_video_id immutable column Maintains unique constraint after video deletion Toggle API POST (idempotent) + DELETE ?videoId=X Video-centric; client never manages internal bookmark IDs ID type UUID (matches VideoComment) Most recent pattern; no sequential ID leakage No service interface @Service directly on impl Matches VideoComment/existing codebase pattern

docs.title: Schema Refinement (vs ADR sketch)
docs.text:
The ADR proposed UNIQUE(user_id, video_id) but video_id can become NULL via ON DELETE SET NULL, breaking the constraint. Solution: add source_video_id BIGINT NOT NULL — an immutable copy of the original video ID used for uniqueness. The FK video_id can go null; source_video_id never changes.

bookmarks (
  id              UUID    PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id         BIGINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  video_id        BIGINT           REFERENCES video_sources(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_video_id BIGINT  NOT NULL,   -- immutable; used for uniqueness
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_bookmark_user_video UNIQUE (user_id, source_video_id)
)

    import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { bookmarksApi } from '../api/bookmarks'

// Returns a Set<number> of bookmarked video IDs — O(1) per-card lookup
export function useBookmarkedIds() {
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['bookmarks', 'ids'],
    queryFn: () => bookmarksApi.ids(),
    staleTime: Infinity,           // only invalidated by mutations
    enabled: !!localStorage.getItem('jwt'),
  })
  return new Set(data?.videoIds ?? [])
}

export function useBookmarksList() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['bookmarks', 'list'],
    queryFn: () => bookmarksApi.list(),
    enabled: !!localStorage.getItem('jwt'),
  })
}

export function useCollections() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['bookmarks', 'collections'],
    queryFn: () => bookmarksApi.collections.list(),
    enabled: !!localStorage.getItem('jwt'),
  })
}

docs.title: Plan: Reorder Videos in a Collection (drag & drop)
Overview
docs.text: Status: Done Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-18 Related plan: plan-library-collections (listed drag & drop reordering as out of scope) Related ADR: ADR-0012 (collections design). No new ADR: the schema change is additive (one column + index) and can be undone in one migration. Size: Small feature (1–3 days): plan only, per swarm-plan.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: A user who manages a collection (owner of a private one, or any admin for a public one) can drag & drop videos to set the viewing order. "Phát" and the in-collection swiper then play videos in that order.

docs.title: Decisions (agreed 2026-10-18)
docs.text: # Decision Why D1 FE uses @dnd-kit/core 6.x + @dnd-kit/sortable 10.x + @dnd-kit/utilities 3.x Works with touch (mobile is the main client) and keyboard, with screen-reader announcements. HTML5 DnD does not work on touch. The owner approved this deviation from tech-strategy; FE-2 records it in tech-strategy.md D2 New videos go to the top (position = MIN − 1) Matches today's newest-first order, so existing collections look the same after the backfill D3 Order is stored as an integer position on video_collection_items; a move renumbers the whole collection 0..n−1 in one UPDATE … FROM unnest(...) WITH ORDINALITY A collection is capped at 500 items, so a full renumber is cheap and leaves no gaps. Gap or fractional ranking would be premature D4 API is relative: PATCH /collections/{id}/videos/{videoId} with body { "afterVideoId": Long \| null } (null = move to the top) Hidden or unpublished items are not shown to the client, so an absolute index over visible items would be wrong. A neighbour id is not. PATCH is already in the CORS allow-list (WebSecurityConfig:139) D5 Reordering happens in a "Sắp xếp" mode that loads the whole list (useCollectionPlaylist, at most 500 items). The normal 24-per-page grid stays as it is A video cannot be dragged across pages, and a tile cannot be both click-to-play and draggable without conflicts D6 Cover = first visible video in the user's order (it was the newest one) Works like a playlist. Because of D2, unsorted collections keep the same cover D7 A move does not bump updated_at (no touch). It still evicts the public cache when the collection is public Reordering is not new content, so it should not push a public collection up the "recently updated" list. The cover can change, so the cache has to be evicted D8 The default "Xem sau" collection can be reordered It is a normal list. Only rename and delete are blocked for it

docs.text:

  • Repo: addItem inserts at the top. findVisibleVideos and findCovers order by position, video_id. New findOrderedVideoIds and renumber
  • Service moveVideo(id, videoId, afterVideoId) + MoveVideoRequest DTO + controller endpoint + i18n error keys (vi/en)
  • FE: collectionsApi.moveVideo, useMoveCollectionItem (optimistic update + rollback), "Sắp xếp" mode with a sortable grid, drag handle, keyboard support, vi/en strings

docs.text:
PATCH /v1/funny-app/collections/{id}/videos/{videoId}
Body: { "afterVideoId": 123 }   // or null → move to top
204 No Content                  // also when the video is already in that place
400 error.collection.moveInvalid      // afterVideoId == videoId
404 error.collection.notFound         // not manageable (same rule as add/remove)
404 error.collection.itemNotFound     // videoId or afterVideoId is not in the collection
401 error.auth.required
@RateLimited(permit = 60) · @AuditLog("moveVideoInCollection")

GET /collections/{id}/videos keeps its shape. Only the order changes (position ASC, video_id ASC).

docs.title: Move Algorithm (service)
docs.text:
1. requireManageable(id, user, admin): takes the FOR UPDATE row lock, so concurrent moves on one collection run one after another
  2. ids = itemRepository.findOrderedVideoIds(cid): all items, visible or not, ORDER BY position, video_id
  3. Validate: videoId is in ids (otherwise 404 itemNotFound). afterVideoId is null or in ids (otherwise 404) and is not videoId (otherwise 400 moveInvalid)
  4. Remove videoId, then insert it at index 0 (when afterVideoId is null) or right after afterVideoId
  5. If the order did not change, return. Otherwise run itemRepository.renumber(cid, newIds) and then evictPublicIf(collection)

Hidden items keep their place relative to their neighbours, because the client only names visible neighbours.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Status: Draft Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-02 Related: plan-admin-comment-moderation, Trello #6/#7 (comments, parent_id) Decision class: Two-Way Door — reuses existing parent_id column; one CHECK-constraint change (status gains DELETED). No ADR; decisions recorded below.

docs.title: Problem
docs.text:
The backend already stores parent_id and returns a nested tree (CommentNode.replies), but:

  1. FE (CommentPanel.jsx) renders a flat list of root comments, never reads replies, and has no "Reply" action — replies are invisible.
  2. parentId is not validated — a reply can point to a non-existent comment, a comment on another video, or a removed comment.
  3. Owner delete cascades — deleting a parent hard-deletes other users' replies (deleteRecursively).
  4. No length limit on content (TEXT, no @Size).

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Logged-in users can reply to any visible comment. Replies show under their thread (2-level layout like YouTube/Facebook), threads collapse when long, and deleting or moderating a parent never destroys other people's replies.

docs.title: In Scope
docs.text:
• Reply action + inline reply box in CommentPanel
  • 2-level threaded rendering, collapse "Xem N phản hồi"
  • BE validation of parentId, normalization to the root, content length limit
  • Author delete of a comment with replies → "deleted" placeholder instead of cascade
  • Admin table: reply indicator + DELETED status

docs.title: Out of Scope (follow-ups)
docs.text:
• Notifications ("X replied to you")
  • Editing comments
  • Likes on comments
  • Guest replies (FE only allows logged-in commenting today)
  • Hiding author email in public API (separate privacy fix)

docs.title: Key Decisions
docs.text: Decision Choice Rationale Thread depth 2 levels: root + replies. Replying to a reply attaches to the root (BE normalizes parentId to the top-level ancestor); FE prefills @name Readable on a 360 px panel; no deep indentation; same as YouTube Legacy deeper data FE flattens all descendants of a root, sorted by createdAt ASC Works even if old rows are nested deeper Parent validation Parent must exist (404), same videoId (400), status VISIBLE (400) Prevents orphan/cross-video/removed-thread replies Content limit @Size(max = 2000) on CreateCommentRequest.content (roots and replies) Abuse guard; DB stays TEXT Author deletes comment with replies Soft: status = DELETED, content = ''; public tree shows placeholder "Bình luận đã bị xoá" Keeps other users' replies; author's text is erased Author deletes comment without replies (or a reply) Hard delete (unchanged) Nothing to preserve Placeholder pruning Existing pruneRemoved treats DELETED like REMOVED (leaf → omitted; with visible replies → placeholder) One code path CommentNode Add deleted: boolean (next to removed) FE picks placeholder text Admin restore of DELETED Rejected 400 ("Deleted by author") Author's decision; not a moderation state Ordering Roots as returned by API (createdAt ASC, unchanged); replies createdAt ASC Conversation reads top-down

docs.title: API changes
docs.text:
POST /v1/funny-app/videos/{videoId}/comments
  body: { content: string (1..2000), parentId?: uuid }
  400 parent on another video / parent not VISIBLE / content too long
  404 parent not found
  stored parentId = root of the thread

GET /v1/funny-app/videos/{videoId}/comments
  CommentNode += deleted: boolean   (placeholder: content/userId/guestName null)

DELETE /v1/funny-app/videos/{videoId}/comments/{id}
  has replies → soft DELETED, else hard delete (same auth rules)

docs.title: Schema change
docs.text:
ALTER TABLE video_comments DROP CONSTRAINT chk_video_comments_status;
ALTER TABLE video_comments
    ADD CONSTRAINT chk_video_comments_status CHECK (status IN ('VISIBLE', 'REMOVED', 'DELETED'));

docs.title: FE layout (CommentPanel)
docs.text:
(A) alice · 2h
    Great video!
    Trả lời · Xoá
    ├─ (B) bob · 1h         @alice agree
    │      Trả lời
    ├─ (C) carol · 30m      lol
    └─ Xem thêm 3 phản hồi ▾
    [ @bob |               ] [Gửi]   ← inline reply box (one open at a time)
  • Replies indented 40 px, smaller avatar (24 px)
  • Show first 2 replies; "Xem thêm N phản hồi" expands; expanded state kept after posting
  • Header count = visible comments including replies
  • Reply box: Esc closes, Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline; prefilled @{name} when replying to a reply
  • Placeholders: removed → "Bình luận đã bị gỡ do vi phạm chính sách", deleted → "Bình luận đã bị xoá"; no Reply/Delete on placeholders

  • [ ] components/comments/CommentItem.jsx (one row: avatar, name, time, content, actions) — extract from CommentPanel

  • [ ] Update docs/tracking.md, Trello

docs.text:
RC-1 ──► RC-2 ──► RC-4 ──┐
                         ├──► RC-5
RC-3 (contract-first) ───┘

Estimate: ~2.75 days (≈1.5 days critical path with BE/FE in parallel).

docs.title: Risks
docs.text: Risk Mitigation Behaviour change: owner delete no longer removes others' replies Intended; covered by tests; placeholder explains Constraint change during rolling deploy Drop+add on a small table; old pods never write DELETED Spam via replies Same @RateLimited(permit = 5) + 2000-char limit + admin moderation/bulk remove Very long threads on mobile Collapse after 2 replies Cycle in legacy parent_id data Bounded root walk (50 hops)

docs.title: Plan: Contributor Role and Autopilot Permissions for Reports
Overview
docs.text: Status: Done (2026-10-23, autopilot run 2026-10-23-contributor-autopilot-permissions) Date: 2026-10-23 PRD: PRD-contributor-autopilot-permissions ADR: ADR-0030 Spec: spec-contributor-autopilot-permissions (rules are cited as BR-n / FR-n / EC-n) Sequence: sequence-contributor-autopilot-permissions Size: Medium. 6 tasks: 3 backend, 3 frontend, about 1,300 LOC including tests.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Add the CONTRIBUTOR role (Report only) and two SUPER_ADMIN-granted bits, so that the holder can put autopilot:auto-merge or autopilot:auto on a report. Every check is in the server and reads the DB.

docs.title: In Scope
docs.text:
• Backend: role, bits, security matchers, account rules, report label and cap rules, one Liquibase changeset
  • Frontend: role helpers, auth state, navigation and notifications, report form, account table
  • Tests for every BR, EC and acceptance criterion in the spec that can be automated

docs.title: Out of Scope
docs.text:
• Everything listed as out of scope in the PRD (grant history UI, self sign-up, notifications on grant, auto-revoke)
  • Any change to .github/, the autopilot scripts or ADR-0025

docs.title: Architecture Changes
docs.text:
See the spec's API and Frontend sections and the sequence diagrams (flows 1–7). There is no new table, endpoint or cache. The changes are:

  • one enum value (UserRole.CONTRIBUTOR);
  • two enum bits (Permission.AUTOPILOT_*);
  • one security matcher placed before /admin/**;
  • service rules in AdminAccountServiceImpl and ReportServiceImpl;
  • one partial-index changeset.

docs.title: Key Decisions
docs.text:
All recorded in ADR-0030 (D1–D6) and the spec's Open Questions (owner decisions of 2026-10-23):

  • @HasPermission(ADMIN) is dropped from the report endpoints;
  • ALL_BITS stays 31;
  • a retry downgrades the label instead of refusing.

Explorer findings that shape the tasks:

  • Liquibase uses includeAll: sql/ (db.changelog-master.yaml:1-4), so a new .sql file is picked up without a master entry.
  • @WebMvcTest permission tests import AdminControllerPermissionTest.TestSecurity, not WebSecurityConfig. So the real /admin/reports/** vs /admin/** matcher order needs its own test (CA-1).
  • AdminAccountTable.jsx:11-12,68,81 would rank CONTRIBUTOR as 0 (like USER), promote it straight to ADMIN and badge it as a user. CA-6 must fix all three.
  • AuthContext.jsx:51 copies only role from /user/me, and permissions is not stored anywhere. CA-4 must add it, or the report form cannot know the caller's bits after a reload.
  • The backend does not filter the notification ADMIN category by role (NotificationServiceImpl.java:37-42), so BR-14 is frontend only.

docs.title: Implementation Steps
docs.text:
Every task lands on main on its own. The order in the dependency graph is the merge order.

ID Task Files Acceptance criteria Est. LOC (main + tests) CA-1 BE: role, bits, security matchers, report controller enums/UserRole.java, enums/Permission.java, filter/WebSecurityConfig.java:54, web/AdminReportController.java:32,43,51,59; tests WebSecurityConfigRoleHierarchyTest, AdminReportControllerPermissionTest, new WebSecurityConfigAdminMatcherTest (1) UserRole = USER, CONTRIBUTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN; CONTRIBUTOR.defaultPermissions()==0; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN still 31 (BR-1). (2) Permission adds 32/64, ALL_BITS==31, AUTOPILOT_BITS==96, allowsAutoLabel(mask,label) per BR-8 (FR-4). (3) roleHierarchy() reaches CONTRIBUTOR from ADMIN; adminImpliesUserOnly updated. (4) Matcher /v1/funny-app/admin/reports/** → CONTRIBUTOR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN, before /admin/** (FR-2). The new test boots the real filter chain and checks that a CONTRIBUTOR gets 200 on /admin/reports and 403 on each EC-8 path. (5) Controller hasRole('CONTRIBUTOR'), no @HasPermission on the 3 methods (FR-3). A CONTRIBUTOR with mask 0 gets 200 with the flag on and off; USER still 403 ~90 + ~180 CA-2 BE: account rules for CONTRIBUTOR and autopilot bits service/impl/AdminAccountServiceImpl.java:41-58,73-89; AdminAccountServiceImplTest (1) Mask outside 127 → 400 (literal 32 test moves to 128). (2) Non-SA changing the autopilot bits → 403 "Only the SUPER_ADMIN can change autopilot permissions"; an ADMIN changing only the other bits of a CONTRIBUTOR is accepted (BR-5, EC-4). (3) Autopilot bit on a USER target → 400 (BR-6, EC-5). (4) updateRole: keep the autopilot bits for CONTRIBUTOR/ADMIN, clear them for USER (BR-7, EC-5, EC-6). (5) ADMIN may set USER ⇄ CONTRIBUTOR, cannot set ADMIN (BR-3). (5) Checks hold with the Harness flag off (EC-7; the service never calls FeatureFlagService). (6) Migration replaces idx_app_report_autopilot_cap with the new predicate; the migration test asserts it. (7) Message text EN/VI updated ~80 + ~220 CA-4 FE: role helpers, auth permissions, nav and notifications utils/roles.js, utils/permissions.js, contexts/AuthContext.jsx:45-93, components/layout/AppShell.jsx:46,103,139,160-161,314,331,343,380-383, components/notifications/NotificationDropdown.jsx:18-22, utils/notificationText.js:31-35; tests AuthContext.test.jsx, AppShell.report.test.jsx, notificationText.test.js, NotificationBell.test.jsx, new roles.test.js, permissions.test.js (1) canReport(role) true for CONTRIBUTOR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN. (2) AUTOPILOT_PERMISSIONS (32, 64) and allowedAutoLabels(role, mask) per BR-8. (3) AuthContext keeps permissions from login and /user/me and exposes canReport. (4) CONTRIBUTOR sees Report (desktop + mobile) and no Admin; USER sees neither. (5) CONTRIBUTOR's dropdown has the Admin tab; REPORT_CLOSED opens Report (BR-14) ~60 + ~150 CA-5 FE: report form autopilot options by bits components/report/ReportPage.jsx:10-12,52-56,88,113,173-180, i18n/locales/{en,vi}/report.json; test ReportPage.test.jsx (1) The select lists exactly allowedAutoLabels(user.role, user.permissions) plus "No auto"; hidden when empty (FR-10). (2) The payload sends only an allowed value. (3) Existing tests "ADMIN has no autopilot select" and "SUPER_ADMIN sees the autopilot select" still pass; new: CONTRIBUTOR mask 32 sees [No auto, Auto-merge], mask 64 sees both. (4) CONTRIBUTOR can retry own FAILED row (reporter rule unchanged) ~25 + ~80 CA-6 FE: account table CONTRIBUTOR + autopilot toggles components/admin/AdminAccountTable.jsx:11-12,67-75,81-122, src/index.css:1658-1691, i18n/locales/{en,vi}/admin.json; test AdminAccountTable.test.jsx, badgeContrast.test.js if the new badge is covered (1) ROLE_RANK USER 0, CONTRIBUTOR 1, ADMIN 2, SUPER_ADMIN 3. (2) Role control: SUPER_ADMIN gets a select USER/CONTRIBUTOR/ADMIN (ADMIN keeps the grant-admin confirm); an ADMIN viewer gets USER ⇄ CONTRIBUTOR only (spec assumption). (3) admin-badge-contributor style + roleContributor label. (4) Two "Autopilot" toggles (bits 32/64) shown only to the SUPER_ADMIN on CONTRIBUTOR/ADMIN rows; toggling sends the new mask; the existing 5 chips are unchanged. (5) en/vi keys added ~90 + ~140

docs.title: Dependency graph
docs.text:
CA-1 ──┬──> CA-2
       └──> CA-3
CA-4 ──┬──> CA-5
       └──> CA-6   (also after CA-2)
  • CA-1 and CA-4 can start in parallel (separate backend and frontend files).
  • CA-2 and CA-3 touch different services. They depend on CA-1's enums, so they run in parallel after CA-1 lands.
  • CA-5 and CA-6 depend on CA-4's helpers, and run in parallel after it. CA-6 also lands after CA-2: its role select sends CONTRIBUTOR and its toggles send masks 32/64, which the backend rejects with 400 before CA-1/CA-2.
  • CA-4 and CA-5 can land before the backend: they only read a role and bits that no account has yet.
  • Rollout rule: no account is given CONTRIBUTOR until CA-3 is merged and deployed. Between CA-1 and CA-3, a contributor's reports would not count toward the cap (ReportServiceImpl.java:197 counts ADMIN only), and the issue body would say "an ADMIN" (ReportIssueContent.java:45).

docs.title: Plan: Time Filter on the Admin Drive Sync Tab
Overview
docs.text: Status: Done 2026-10-18 · BE-1 cc7f8f2b, FE-1 ad0adc82, FE-2 31f01e86; deployed (prod-82), QA-1 prod smoke verified by owner Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-18 Related plan: plan-admin-drive-force-sync (the DRIVE_SYNC tab this extends) ADR: none. Two optional query params on an existing admin endpoint follow the existing pattern; nothing is stored and the change is easy to undo (swarm-plan Artifact Requirements). Size: Small feature (~1 day), so this plan is the only artifact (no PRD).

docs.title: Objective
docs.text:
On the admin DRIVE_SYNC tab, the file table shows only files whose Drive created time falls in a chosen range, and the server does the filtering:

  • Default: the last 12 hours. The tab no longer loads the whole folder when it opens
  • Relative time: presets 1 h / 12 h / 24 h / 7 d / 30 d, counted back from the moment of the request
  • Specific time: a from/to range picked with date-time inputs (Vietnam time, like the rest of the admin)
  • All: the whole folder, as today. Orphans are listed only in this mode
  • Every filter change calls GET /admin/drive-sync/files again with the new range

docs.title: Verified Facts (exploration 2026-10-18)
docs.text: Area Fact Impact Listing GET /admin/drive-sync/files (AdminDriveSyncController.java:37) takes no params. DriveSyncServiceImpl.listFolder() (:87) lists every Drive page ('<folder>' in parents and trashed = false, pageSize 1000), then loads every google_drive row (findAllBySourceType) Both the Drive call and the DB load grow with the folder. A range cuts both States stateOf() (:201) works per Drive file: lock → SYNCING; no local file → MISSING_LOCAL / MISSING_BOTH; size differs → SIZE_MISMATCH; else SYNCED / MISSING_DB States stay correct on a filtered list: each file only needs its own DB row and local file Orphans Orphans = DB rows left over after matching all folder files (:107) With a range, every older row would look like an orphan → compute orphans only when no range is given (D3) Run check startRun checks requested ids against a full listing (:130) Must keep calling the unfiltered listing Time field DriveSyncFileDto.createdAt = Drive createdTime, the "Created" column (DriveSyncPanel.jsx:175) The range applies to createdTime. Drive's q supports createdTime >= '<RFC 3339>' FE data flow getDriveSyncFiles() (api/admin.js:66) sends no params; useDriveSyncFiles() (useAdmin.js:137) key ['admin','drive-sync','files']; refresh and run completion invalidate ['admin','drive-sync'] Add the filter to the key; prefix invalidation keeps working. Reuse buildUrl/cleanParams (admin.js:28,47) like getComments Time zone localToIso (utils/importUtils.js:51) turns a datetime-local value (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh) into ISO UTC; ImportForm.jsx:101 already uses that input Reuse both; no date library needed Prior art No admin endpoint takes a time range yet; admin lists take enum/text filters + paging First Instant request params: use @DateTimeFormat(iso = DATE_TIME) Tests DriveSyncServiceImplTest stubs the exact setQ string (:79); AdminDriveSyncControllerPermissionTest is @WebMvcTest; DriveSyncPanel.test.jsx mocks api/admin.js Update the stub; add range cases in all three

docs.title: Decisions
docs.text: # Decision Why D1 Filter on the server: GET /files?from=<ISO>&to=<ISO>, both optional. The range goes into the Drive q Owner's choice (2026-10-18): the tab should not load the whole folder by default D2 Dropdown: 1 h / 12 h (default) / 24 h / 7 d / 30 d, All, Custom (from/to) Owner's choice (2026-10-18) D3 Orphans are computed only when no range is sent (All). With a range the response has orphans: [] and orphansChecked: false; the panel shows "Chọn Tất cả để xem orphan" Owner's choice (2026-10-18). Orphans need the full folder; a range would report every older row as an orphan D4 With a range, the DB lookup loads only rows whose source_id is in the listed file ids (findAllBySourceTypeAndSourceIdIn, in chunks of 1 000) Matches the smaller Drive listing; no full-table load for a 12 h view D5 Relative presets are resolved to from = now − preset inside the query function, at fetch time. The query key holds the preset, not the timestamp The key stays stable, and refresh or run completion refetches a fresh "last 12 h" window D6 Custom range: from and to each optional; to includes its whole minute (FE sends to + 1 min, server treats to as exclusive). From > to shows an inline error and does not call the server. The server also rejects from > to with 400 No wasted request; the API is safe for other callers too D7 Changing the filter clears the selection The new list may not contain the selected files; the confirm modal lists files from the current list, so keeping hidden ids would make the count and the modal disagree D8 Keep the previous rows on screen while the new range loads (placeholderData: keepPreviousData) with a small loading state on the table Avoids the table flashing empty on every change D9 startRun keeps validating ids against the unfiltered listing The folder-membership check is a security control (plan-admin-drive-force-sync)

docs.text:
• BE: from/to params, Drive q with createdTime, filtered DB lookup, orphansChecked flag, 400 on from > to, tests
  • FE: getDriveSyncFiles(params), useDriveSyncFiles(filter), utils/timeRange.js, DriveTimeFilter control, panel wiring, orphan note, vi/en strings, tests

docs.title: Out of Scope
docs.text:
• Paging of the file table
  • Filtering by modified time or sync time
  • Remembering the filter across reloads (it resets to 12 h)
  • Changing the cron (AppScheduler.syncDriveVideos) or the force-sync run

docs.title: API Contract (FE-1 can start from this before BE-1 lands)
docs.text:
GET /v1/funny-app/admin/drive-sync/files?from=2026-10-18T00:00:00Z&to=2026-10-18T12:01:00Z
  from, to: optional ISO-8601 instants (UTC). from inclusive, to exclusive.
  No params → whole folder + orphans (today's behaviour).
200 ResultObjectInfo<DriveSyncListingDto>
    { files: [...], orphans: [...], orphansChecked: true|false, maxBatch: 50 }
    orphansChecked = false and orphans = [] whenever from or to is given
400 when from > to, or a param is not a valid ISO instant
502 DRIVE_UNAVAILABLE (unchanged)
hasRole('ADMIN') (unchanged)

Drive query built by the server (values come from typed Instants, formatted as RFC 3339 in UTC, so no user text reaches the q string):

'<folder>' in parents and trashed = false and createdTime >= '2026-10-18T00:00:00Z' and createdTime < '2026-10-18T12:01:00Z'

docs.title: FE util contract
docs.text:
// filter: { mode: 'all' }
//       | { mode: 'relative', preset: '1h' | '12h' | '24h' | '7d' | '30d' }    // default { mode: 'relative', preset: '12h' }
//       | { mode: 'custom', from: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' | '', to: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' | '' }   // datetime-local, VN time
toRangeParams(filter, now = Date.now())
// → { params: { from?: ISO, to?: ISO }, error: '' }
// → { params: null, error: 'admin:timeRangeInvalid' } when custom from > to
// mode 'all', or custom with both empty → { params: {}, error: '' }
