docs.title: 4. Open a collection and play it (including the ?l= deep link)
docs.text:
A shared link ?l=<collectionId> is read once by AppShell, stripped from the address bar and opens LibraryView on that collection. Guests can read public collections. A private collection of another user answers 404 so ids cannot be probed.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User or Guest
    participant FE as Browser (AppShell.jsx, LibraryView.jsx)
    participant F as JWTAuthenticationFilter
    participant API as VideoCollectionController
    participant S as VideoCollectionServiceImpl
    participant R as VideoCollectionItemRepository

    U->>FE: open link with ?l=collectionId
    FE->>FE: initialLink read once, URL stripped, activeNav = library
    FE->>F: GET /collections/{id}/videos?page=0&size=24 (JWT optional)
    alt no token or invalid token
        F->>API: continue as guest (OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATH)
    else valid token
        F->>API: continue with user in SecurityContext
    end
    API->>S: getVideos(id, page, size)
    S->>S: findById then PUBLIC or owner check
    alt not public and not the owner
        S-->>API: CustomException 404 error.collection.notFound
        API-->>FE: 404 ResultErrorInfo
        FE-->>U: error state
    else visible
        S->>R: findVisibleVideos(collectionId, page clamped to size 1-50)
        R-->>S: Page of VideoSource (hidden and unpublished excluded)
        S-->>API: Page of VideoDto
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of Page of VideoDto
        FE-->>U: tile grid, Play loads the whole list in pages of 50 (useCollectionPlaylist)
    end

docs.title: 5. Reorder items by drag and drop (managers only)
docs.text:
An owner (or an admin for a PUBLIC collection) drags a tile in LibraryView. The cache is reordered optimistically and rolled back if the call fails.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Owner or Admin
    participant FE as Browser (LibraryView.jsx, useMoveCollectionItem)
    participant API as VideoCollectionController
    participant S as VideoCollectionServiceImpl
    participant R as VideoCollectionItemRepository

    U->>FE: drop tile after another tile
    FE->>FE: onMutate moveAfter on cache key collections, id, videos, all
    FE->>API: PATCH /collections/{id}/videos/{videoId} (body afterVideoId or null)
    API->>S: moveVideo(id, videoId, afterVideoId)
    S->>S: requireManageable (row lock)
    alt videoId equals afterVideoId
        API-->>FE: 400 error.collection.moveInvalid
    else video not in collection
        API-->>FE: 404 error.collection.itemNotFound
    else same order
        API-->>FE: 204 No Content (no write)
    else new order
        S->>R: findOrderedVideoIds then renumber(collectionId, ids)
        S->>S: evictPublicIf(collection)
        API-->>FE: 204 No Content
    end
    alt error
        FE->>FE: onError restores previous cache
    end
    FE->>FE: onSettled refetch paged queries and both lists (cover may change)

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Contributor Role and Autopilot Permissions for Reports
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-contributor-autopilot-permissions
  • ADR: 0030-contributor-autopilot-permissions
  • Spec: spec-contributor-autopilot-permissions
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-23)

docs.title: 1. SUPER_ADMIN grants an autopilot bit
docs.text:
The owner gives a contributor AUTOPILOT_AUTO_MERGE (bit 32) in the account table. Spec BR-5, BR-6.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor SA as SUPER_ADMIN
    participant FE as Browser (AdminAccountTable.jsx)
    participant API as AdminController
    participant S as AdminAccountServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (users)
    participant C as credentialsVersionCache

    SA->>FE: toggle "Autopilot: auto-merge" on a CONTRIBUTOR row
    FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/admin/accounts/{id}/permissions {permissions: 32}
    API->>S: updatePermissions(id, actorId, 32)
    S->>S: mask ⊆ ALL_BITS | AUTOPILOT_BITS (127)
    S->>DB: SELECT role of actor, target
    DB-->>S: actor SUPER_ADMIN, target CONTRIBUTOR
    S->>S: autopilot bits changed → actor is SUPER_ADMIN ✔ (BR-5)<br/>target role is CONTRIBUTOR or ADMIN ✔ (BR-6)
    S->>DB: UPDATE users SET permissions = 32, credentials_version + 1
    S->>C: evict(id)
    S-->>API: AdminAccountDto
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<AdminAccountDto>
    FE-->>SA: row shows the toggle on, admin accounts query invalidated

docs.title: 2. ADMIN tries to change an autopilot bit
docs.text:
Spec BR-5, EC-4.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor A as ADMIN
    participant API as AdminController
    participant S as AdminAccountServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (users)

    A->>API: PATCH /admin/accounts/{id}/permissions {permissions: 64}
    API->>S: updatePermissions(id, actorId, 64)
    S->>DB: SELECT actor, target
    DB-->>S: actor ADMIN, target CONTRIBUTOR (current mask 0)
    S->>S: autopilot bits differ (0 → 64) and actor ≠ SUPER_ADMIN
    S-->>API: CustomException 403 "Only the SUPER_ADMIN can change autopilot permissions"
    API-->>A: 403 ResultErrorInfo (nothing saved)

docs.title: 3. Contributor sends a report with "Auto-merge" (happy path)
docs.text:
Spec BR-8, BR-11, FR-2, FR-3, FR-6.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as CONTRIBUTOR (mask 32)
    participant FE as Browser (ReportPage.jsx)
    participant SEC as WebSecurityConfig
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant GH as GitHub REST API
    participant WF as autopilot.yml (headless)

    U->>FE: open Report, select shows No auto + Auto-merge (allowedAutoLabels)
    U->>FE: Send, autoLabel = AUTO_MERGE
    FE->>SEC: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports (JWT)
    SEC->>SEC: /admin/reports/** → hasAnyRole(CONTRIBUTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN) ✔
    SEC->>API: create(request)
    API->>API: @PreAuthorize hasRole('CONTRIBUTOR') ✔, @RateLimited 5/h, @AuditLog
    API->>S: create(request)
    S->>DB: load current user (role, permissions)
    DB-->>S: CONTRIBUTOR, 32
    S->>S: allowsAutoLabel(32, AUTO_MERGE) ✔ (BR-8)
    S->>DB: INSERT app_report (FAILED, 'pending', auto_label AUTO_MERGE)
    S->>DB: COUNT CREATED autopilot reports, role IN (ADMIN, CONTRIBUTOR), last 24 h
    DB-->>S: 4 (< 10, not capped)
    S->>GH: POST /issues labels [autopilot, autopilot:auto-merge, bug]<br/>body "…Reported in-app by a CONTRIBUTOR…"
    GH-->>S: issue 71
    S->>DB: UPDATE app_report SET status CREATED, issue 71, labels
    S-->>API: ReportDto
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>
    FE-->>U: Issue 71 created
    GH-)WF: issues.labeled autopilot (sender = owner PAT)
    WF-)WF: plan → Gate 1 owner /approve → build → Gate 2 auto-merge (ADR-0025)

docs.title: 4. Contributor asks for a label above the grant
docs.text:
Spec BR-9.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as CONTRIBUTOR (mask 32)
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>API: POST /admin/reports {autoLabel: AUTO} (crafted request, the UI never offers it)
    API->>S: create(request)
    S->>DB: load current user
    DB-->>S: CONTRIBUTOR, 32
    S->>S: allowsAutoLabel(32, AUTO) ✘
    S-->>API: 403 error.report.autoLabelForbidden
    API-->>U: 403 ResultErrorInfo (no row saved, no GitHub call)

docs.title: 5. Retry after a partial revoke (label downgrade)
docs.text:
Spec BR-10, EC-1.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as CONTRIBUTOR
    actor SA as SUPER_ADMIN
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant GH as GitHub REST API

    Note over U,GH: Report R was saved FAILED with auto_label AUTO while U held mask 64
    SA->>DB: (flow 1) permissions 64 → 32, credentials_version + 1
    U->>API: POST /admin/reports/{R}/retry (new JWT after re-login)
    API->>S: retry(R)
    S->>DB: load current user, load R with reporter
    DB-->>S: CONTRIBUTOR mask 32, R FAILED, auto_label AUTO, reporter = U
    S->>S: reporter = caller ✔, cap AUTO to what 32 allows → AUTO_MERGE
    S->>GH: POST /issues labels [autopilot, autopilot:auto-merge, bug]
    GH-->>S: issue 72
    S->>DB: UPDATE R: CREATED, issue 72 (auto_label stays AUTO)
    S-->>API: ReportDto
    API-->>U: 200

docs.title: 6. Contributor on another admin endpoint
docs.text:
Spec BR-2, EC-8.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as CONTRIBUTOR
    participant SEC as WebSecurityConfig
    participant API as AdminController

    U->>SEC: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/accounts (JWT)
    SEC->>SEC: not /admin/reports/** → /admin/** needs ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN ✘
    SEC-->>U: 403 (controller never reached)

docs.title: 7. Role change keeps or clears the bits
docs.text:
Spec BR-7, EC-5, EC-6.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor X as SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN
    participant API as AdminController
    participant S as AdminAccountServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (users)

    X->>API: PATCH /admin/accounts/{id}/role {role}
    API->>S: updateRole(id, actorId, role)
    S->>DB: SELECT actor, target
    S->>S: actor outranks old and new role
    alt role = ADMIN or CONTRIBUTOR
        S->>S: mask = role.defaultPermissions() | (old & AUTOPILOT_BITS)
    else role = USER
        S->>S: mask = 0 (autopilot bits cleared)
    end
    S->>DB: UPDATE users SET role, permissions = mask, credentials_version + 1
    S-->>API: ok
    API-->>X: 200 "Role updated"

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: HLS Streaming for Selected Videos
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-hls-streaming
  • ADR: 0031-hls-streaming
  • Spec: spec-hls-streaming
  • Status: Draft

docs.title: 1. SUPER_ADMIN turns HLS on, worker transcodes (happy path)
docs.text:
The SUPER_ADMIN toggles HLS on in the admin table. The worker stream-copies the .full file and publishes the rendition atomically (spec FR-2, FR-3, BR-3..BR-7).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor SA as SUPER_ADMIN
    participant FE as Browser (AdminVideoTable.jsx)
    participant API as AdminController
    participant S as AdminVideoServiceImpl
    participant W as HlsTranscodeWorker
    participant L as DriveFileLocks
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources)
    participant FF as ffprobe / ffmpeg
    participant FS as Disk (video-cache)

    SA->>FE: toggle HLS on
    FE->>API: PUT /v1/funny-app/admin/videos/42/hls
    API->>S: enableHls(42)
    S->>DB: status NONE or ERROR to PENDING, clear hls_error
    S->>W: wakeUp() on a virtual thread
    API-->>FE: 200 hlsStatus PENDING
    W->>L: tryClaim(fileId)
    L-->>W: true
    W->>DB: UPDATE set PROCESSING where hls_status is PENDING
    W->>FS: check fileId.full exists
    W->>FF: ffprobe streams (argument list)
    FF-->>W: video h264, audio aac
    W->>FS: usable space vs size of .full plus 1 GB
    W->>FF: ffmpeg -c copy -f hls -hls_time 6 into hls/fileId.tmp
    FF-->>W: exit 0, playlist.m3u8 written
    W->>DB: re-read status (still PROCESSING)
    W->>FS: rename hls/fileId.tmp to hls/fileId
    W->>DB: status READY
    W->>L: release(fileId)
    loop every 5 s while PENDING or PROCESSING
        FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/videos
        API-->>FE: hlsStatus READY
    end

docs.title: 2. Transcode failures
docs.text:
Each check fails fast and leaves Range untouched (spec BR-9, EC-1, EC-15).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant W as HlsTranscodeWorker
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources)
    participant FF as ffprobe / ffmpeg
    participant FS as Disk (video-cache)

    W->>DB: claim job, status PROCESSING
    alt .full missing
        W->>DB: ERROR SOURCE_MISSING
    else ffprobe or ffmpeg cannot start
        W->>DB: ERROR FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND
    else codec is not h264 plus aac or mp3
        FF-->>W: video hevc
        W->>DB: ERROR UNSUPPORTED_CODEC
    else free disk below size plus reserve
        W->>DB: ERROR DISK_FULL (ffmpeg never started)
    else ffmpeg runs longer than app.hls.timeout
        W->>FF: destroyForcibly()
        W->>FS: delete hls/fileId.tmp
        W->>DB: ERROR TIMEOUT
    else non-zero exit or no playlist
        W->>FS: delete hls/fileId.tmp
        W->>DB: ERROR FFMPEG_FAILED
    end
    Note over W,DB: the file lock is released in a finally block, and the next PENDING job is taken

docs.title: 3. Viewer plays an HLS video (flag on)
docs.text:
The server offers hlsUrl only when the flag is on and the rendition is READY. The player attaches HLS to its single video element (spec BR-8, BR-13, FR-9).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor V as Viewer (guest or signed in)
    participant FE as Browser (VideoPlayer.jsx + useHlsSource)
    participant API as VideoStreamController
    participant S as StreamVideoServiceImpl
    participant FF as FeatureFlagService (Harness)
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources)
    participant FS as Disk (video-cache/hls)

    V->>FE: open feed
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/video-stream/list
    API->>S: getVideosToStream()
    S->>FF: isEnabled(hls_streaming_enabled, false), once per request
    FF-->>S: true
    S->>DB: published, visible videos
    S-->>API: VideoDto list, hlsUrl set where hls_status is READY
    API-->>FE: 200 list
    alt Safari or iOS (native HLS)
        FE->>FE: video.src = hlsUrl
    else other browsers
        FE->>FE: import hls.js, attach to the video element
    end
    FE->>API: GET /video-stream/hls/fileId/playlist.m3u8
    API->>DB: READY and PUBLISHED and not hidden
    API->>FS: read playlist.m3u8
    API-->>FE: 200 application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, no-cache
    loop each segment
        FE->>API: GET /video-stream/hls/fileId/seg_N.ts
        API->>FS: FileSystemResource (no DB)
        API-->>FE: 200 video/mp2t, immutable
    end
    FE->>FE: resume at startAt, report views and progress as today

docs.title: 4. Fallback to Range
docs.text:
The player falls back on any HLS problem, and the flag off sends everyone to Range (spec EC-2, EC-10, EC-11, EC-12).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (VideoPlayer.jsx + useHlsSource)
    participant API as VideoStreamController
    participant S as StreamVideoServiceImpl
    participant FF as FeatureFlagService (Harness)

    alt flag off or Harness unreachable
        FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/video-stream/list
        S->>FF: isEnabled(hls_streaming_enabled, false)
        FF-->>S: false (default when unreachable)
        API-->>FE: every hlsUrl is null
        FE->>API: GET /video-stream/stream/fileId with Range header
        API-->>FE: 206 video/mp4
    else fatal HLS error or playlist 404
        FE->>FE: save currentTime, destroy the hls instance
        FE->>API: GET /video-stream/stream/fileId with Range header
        API-->>FE: 206 video/mp4
        FE->>FE: on loadedmetadata restore currentTime and play state
    end

docs.title: 5. Turn HLS off or delete the video during a job
docs.text:
DELETE wins over a running job: the worker re-reads the status before publishing (spec FR-4, BR-12, EC-6, EC-16).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor SA as SUPER_ADMIN
    participant API as AdminController
    participant S as AdminVideoServiceImpl
    participant W as HlsTranscodeWorker
    participant L as DriveFileLocks
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources)
    participant FS as Disk (video-cache)

    Note over W: job running for fileId, holds the file lock
    SA->>API: DELETE /v1/funny-app/admin/videos/42/hls
    API->>S: disableHls(42)
    S->>DB: status NONE, hls_error null
    S->>L: tryClaim(fileId)
    alt lock held (running job or download)
        L-->>S: false
        Note over S: the lock holder cleans up, no 409
    else lock free
        L-->>S: true
        S->>FS: delete hls/fileId
        S->>L: release(fileId)
    end
    API-->>SA: 200 hlsStatus NONE
    W->>DB: re-read status after ffmpeg exits
    DB-->>W: NONE (not PROCESSING)
    W->>FS: delete hls/fileId.tmp, do not publish
    W->>L: release(fileId)

DELETE never returns 409. If a running job holds the lock, it discards its output (FR-4). If a download holds it, the downloader deletes the directory (BR-10). Anything still left is removed by the startup orphan sweep (BR-11).

docs.title: 6. Startup recovery and a replaced source
docs.text:
Recovery on startup, and a re-download that invalidates the rendition (spec BR-10, BR-11, EC-4, EC-9).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant App as Spring (ApplicationReadyEvent)
    participant W as HlsTranscodeWorker
    participant D as DriveVideoDownloaderImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources)
    participant FS as Disk (video-cache)

    App->>W: onApplicationReady()
    W->>DB: PROCESSING to PENDING
    W->>FS: delete every hls/*.tmp
    W->>FS: check the directory of each READY row
    W->>DB: missing directory to ERROR OUTPUT_MISSING
    W->>FS: delete orphan hls directories (row missing or not READY)
    W->>W: wakeUp(), drain PENDING one by one

    Note over D: scheduler or admin force sync downloads fileId again
    D->>FS: move the new .full into place
    D->>FS: delete hls/fileId if it exists
    D->>DB: read hls_status for fileId
    alt READY or ERROR
        D->>DB: status PENDING, hls_error null
        D->>W: wakeUp()
    else NONE, PENDING or PROCESSING
        Note over D: no change
    end

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Hot Video Priority and Trending Feed
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-hot-video-priority
  • ADR: 0011-hot-video-priority
  • Spec: — (see plan-hot-video-priority and plan-vid2-hot-score-migration)
  • Status: Draft (the hot score is NOT implemented. Flows 1-3 are as-built, flow 4 is planned only)

Planned vs built.

  • Built: manual priority column (0-9999) on video_sources, set by an admin and used for feed ordering. The VideoAccessStats entity and repo, the VideoAccessService.recordAccess(String) signature, and a cleanUpOldVideos job whose delete step is commented out.
  • Not built: recordAccess() body (commented out with a TODO), the Liquibase migration for hot_score, is_hot, hot_rank, HotVideoService / HotVideoServiceImpl, HotVideoProperties (app.hot-video.*), the recomputeHotScores() job, GET /videos/trending, sort=hot, cache pre-warming, and the frontend "Trending Now" section and Hot badge. A grep for hotScore / hot_score in api/src returns nothing.
  • PRD vs code. The PRD uses paths /api/videos, /api/videos/trending. The real feed endpoint is GET /v1/funny-app/video-stream/list, and there is no /videos list endpoint. recordAccess is called only inside getFileRangeFromDisk, so even once implemented it would count cache misses, not every stream request as the PRD (FR-1) intends. The web client (useVideos) re-sorts the list by upvotes descending, which can override the server order except for ties.

docs.title: 1. Stream a video chunk (access recording is a no-op today)
docs.text:
The browser requests byte ranges. A chunk-cache hit never touches disk. On a miss the service reads the file, records a cache miss in StatsCache, and calls recordAccess, which does nothing yet.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (VideoPlayer.jsx)
    participant API as VideoStreamController
    participant S as StreamVideoServiceImpl
    participant C as VideoCache (Guava LRU)
    participant ST as VideoStorageServiceImpl
    participant SC as StatsCache
    participant VA as VideoAccessServiceImpl

    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/video-stream/stream/{fileId} (Range header)
    API->>S: getFileSize(fileId)
    API->>S: getPartialFileUsingRAF(fileId, start, end)
    S->>C: getChunkStream(fileId, start, end, loader)
    alt chunk cached
        C-->>S: InputStream from memory
    else cache miss
        C->>ST: getFileRangeFromDisk(fileId, start, end)
        ST->>SC: recordMiss(fileId)
        ST-)VA: recordAccess(fileId) (@Async)
        Note over VA: body is commented out (TODO)<br/>no DB write, no hit count
        ST-->>C: bytes via RandomAccessFile
    end
    API-->>FE: 206 Partial Content (video/mp4, Content-Range)

docs.title: 2. Home feed ordering (manual priority, then newest)
docs.text:
The feed is ordered by the priority column, not by a hot score. There is no sort parameter.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Viewer
    participant FE as Browser (useVideos.js, VideoFeed.jsx)
    participant API as VideoStreamController
    participant S as StreamVideoServiceImpl
    participant R as VideoSourceRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: open Home
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/video-stream/list
    API->>S: getVideosToStream()
    S->>R: findAllByIsHideAndStatusOrderByPriorityDescCreatedAtDesc(false, PUBLISHED)
    R->>DB: SELECT ... ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
    DB-->>R: rows
    S-->>API: List of VideoDto (Converter.toVideoDto, no hotScore field)
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultListInfo of VideoDto
    FE->>FE: mapApiVideo then sort by upvotes desc (client side)
    FE-->>U: swipe feed

docs.title: 3. Admin pins a video with a manual priority
docs.text:
This is the only "hot" lever that exists. An admin edits the priority cell in the video table.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor A as Admin
    participant FE as Browser (AdminVideoTable.jsx, useUpdateVideoPriority)
    participant API as AdminController (hasRole ADMIN)
    participant S as AdminVideoServiceImpl
    participant R as VideoSourceRepository

    A->>FE: type priority and blur the input
    FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/admin/videos/{id}/priority (JWT, body priority)
    API->>S: updatePriority(id, priority)
    alt priority outside 0..9999
        S-->>API: Contract.require fails
        API-->>FE: error ResultErrorInfo
    else unknown id
        S-->>API: IllegalArgumentException Video not found
        API-->>FE: error ResultErrorInfo
    else ok
        S->>R: save(source with new priority)
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo "Priority updated" (@AuditLog updateVideoPriority)
    end
    FE-->>A: SaveIndicator, admin videos query refreshed

docs.title: 4. PLANNED: scheduled hot score recompute and trending read
docs.text:
Not implemented. Drawn from PRD FR-2 to FR-8, ADR-0011 and plan-hot-video-priority. Names such as HotVideoServiceImpl and recomputeHotScores are the planned names and do not exist in the code.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant J as AppScheduler.recomputeHotScores (PLANNED, every 30 min)
    participant H as HotVideoServiceImpl (PLANNED)
    participant AS as VideoAccessStatsRepo
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (video_sources, share_link)
    participant SC as StatsCache
    participant VC as VideoCache
    actor U as Viewer
    participant FE as Browser (PLANNED Trending Now section)
    participant API as Video controller (PLANNED GET trending)

    J->>H: recompute()
    H->>AS: hits per video in 24h window
    H->>DB: share counts per video
    H->>H: hotScore = 0.60 hits + 0.25 shares + 0.15 recency (min-max normalised)
    H->>DB: UPDATE hot_score, is_hot, hot_rank (new columns, migration missing)
    H->>SC: put top N trending list (TTL 30 min)
    H->>VC: preWarm top 10 videos
    U->>FE: open Home
    FE->>API: GET trending?limit=5
    API->>SC: read cached list
    SC-->>API: List of VideoDto with hotScore, isHot, rank
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultListInfo of VideoDto
    FE-->>U: Trending Now row and Hot badge on cards

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Vietnamese + English language support (i18n)
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-i18n
  • ADR: 0020-i18n-vietnamese-english
  • Spec: —
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

All endpoints are under /v1/funny-app. Supported languages are vi and en (SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES in webapp/src/i18n/index.js, I18nConfig.SUPPORTED in the API).

docs.title: 1. First visit and language switch (browser only)
docs.text:
i18n/index.js bundles every locales/lng/namespace.json and detects the language in the order localStorage key lang, then navigator. Unsupported languages fall back to en. LanguageSwitcher.jsx calls setLanguage(code), which stores the choice in localStorage (detector cache) and updates <html lang>.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant M as Browser (main.jsx)
    participant I as i18n/index.js (i18next)
    participant LS as localStorage
    participant LSW as LanguageSwitcher.jsx
    participant DOM as document.documentElement

    U->>M: opens the site
    M->>I: import i18n (init with bundled resources, initImmediate false)
    I->>LS: read key lang
    alt lang stored and supported
        LS-->>I: vi or en
    else nothing stored
        I->>I: navigator.language (vi-* maps to vi, other maps to fallback en)
    end
    I->>DOM: syncHtmlLang sets lang attribute
    I-->>M: ready before first render
    U->>LSW: clicks VI or EN
    LSW->>I: setLanguage(code) = changeLanguage
    I->>LS: cache lang
    I->>DOM: languageChanged event, syncHtmlLang
    I-->>LSW: React components re-render via react-i18next

docs.title: 2. Every API call carries the language and errors come back localized
docs.text:
api/client.js adds Accept-Language from i18n.language to every request. On the server, AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver (restricted to vi and en, default en) sets the locale and RestExceptionHandler resolves the message key from messages.properties or messages_vi.properties. The key is also returned as error.code.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (api/client.js)
    participant LR as AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver (I18nConfig)
    participant C as Any controller or service
    participant H as RestExceptionHandler
    participant MS as MessageSource (i18n/messages)

    FE->>LR: any request with header Accept-Language vi or en
    LR->>LR: locale = vi or en, otherwise default en
    LR->>C: handler runs
    C-->>H: CustomException.of(status, subCode, messageKey)
    H->>MS: getMessage(key, args, fallback, LocaleContextHolder.getLocale())
    MS-->>H: localized text (vi or en)
    H-->>FE: ResultErrorInfo with message and code = key (for example 403 error.account.deactivated)
    FE->>FE: throws message, status, code - UI shows the localized message

docs.title: 3. Logged-in user: locale persisted and applied across devices
docs.text:
useLocaleSync() runs in AppShell.jsx. Once per login the stored server locale wins over the local one. If the server has none, the current UI language is saved. Any later change is sent once as PATCH /user/settings with locale. knownServerLocale prevents a PATCH loop.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (useLocaleSync.js)
    participant I as i18next
    participant API as UserSettingsController
    participant S as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/user/settings (useSettings, enabled when logged in)
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo with UserSettingsDto (locale may be null)
    alt server locale is vi or en
        FE->>FE: knownServerLocale = locale
        FE->>I: changeLanguage(locale) if different from UI language (no PATCH back)
    else no stored locale
        FE->>FE: knownServerLocale = current UI language
        FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/user/settings with locale (rate limit 20)
        API->>S: updateSettings(request)
        S->>S: validate locale in vi or en
        S->>DB: UPDATE user_settings SET locale
        API-->>FE: 200 UserSettingsDto
    end

    U->>I: later switches language in header or Settings
    I-->>FE: languageChanged event
    alt new language differs from knownServerLocale
        FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/user/settings with locale
        alt locale not vi or en
            S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.settings.invalidLocale
            API-->>FE: 400 ResultErrorInfo
        else valid
            API-->>FE: 200 UserSettingsDto
        end
    end
    Note over FE: on logout the refs reset so the next login applies the server locale again

docs.title: 4. Localized emails (magic link, security notice, digest)
docs.text:
Emails are sent without a browser, so the locale is resolved on the calling thread by EmailLocaleResolver and passed on as a plain Locale (ADR-0020 D6): stored user_settings.locale, else the request locale (only inside a web request), else English. The magic link send is @Async, the notification digest runs from a job.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User or Scheduler
    participant API as UserController
    participant INV as InviteServiceImpl
    participant EL as EmailLocaleResolver
    participant SR as UserSettingsRepository
    participant MAIL as MailServiceImpl
    participant SMTP as SMTP (Gmail)

    U->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/user/join (email, header Accept-Language)
    API->>INV: inviteUser(email, null)
    INV->>EL: forEmail(email)
    EL->>SR: findById(userId) - stored locale
    alt stored locale vi or en
        SR-->>EL: locale
    else new address or no locale
        EL->>EL: forRequest() = LocaleContextHolder locale, English outside a request
    end
    EL-->>INV: Locale
    INV->>MAIL: sendInvitation(to, username, magicLink, locale) - async
    MAIL->>MAIL: subject from MessageSource mail.invite.subject, templateFor(locale) invite html vi or en
    MAIL->>SMTP: send HTML mail
    API-->>U: 200 ResultObjectInfo action INVITED_SEND

    Note over INV,SMTP: Same pattern elsewhere
    Note over INV,SMTP: PasswordLoginServiceImpl.sendSecurityEmail uses forUser(userId) and mail.security.* keys
    Note over INV,SMTP: NotificationDigestService.sendDigest uses forUser(userId) in the job thread (no request, so stored locale or English)

docs.title: Notes: PRD vs code
docs.text:
• PRD requirement 1 says the Settings switcher is logged in only. As built, SettingsPage.jsx embeds the same LanguageSwitcher as the header, and the Settings route itself needs login, so this matches.
  • PRD says the first visit with a vi-* browser shows Vietnamese and anything else English. As built this comes from i18next supportedLngs + nonExplicitSupportedLngs + fallbackLng: en, not from custom code.
  • Accept-Language is sent as the raw i18n.language (it can be vi-VN), and the server resolver matches on language only.
  • Not every backend error is localized: handleHttpMediaTypeNotSupported and handleEntityNotFound in RestExceptionHandler use plain English text, only keyed CustomException and the validation, missing-parameter and rate-limit handlers go through MessageSource.
  • The password set, change and remove notices are plain-text mails localized by messages*.properties keys (not HTML templates). The invite mail is the only HTML template (templateFor).

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: In-App Report
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-in-app-report
  • ADR: 0026-in-app-report
  • Spec: spec-in-app-report (plans: plan-in-app-report, plan-report-webhook-state, plan-report-closed-notify)
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

Notes where the code differs from the PRD:

  • PRD "Out of scope" says there is no in-app notification when an issue is closed. That is superseded: ReportNotificationListener now creates a REPORT_CLOSED notification (ADR-0026 D7).
  • The 429 for rate limits comes from @RateLimited (5 per 3600 s on create and retry, 60 per minute on list). The AOP layer is not drawn in detail.
  • The "global cap of 10 autopilot reports per 24 h" is not a rejection. Over the cap the issue is still created, without the autopilot label, and the DTO reports capReached = true.
  • Retry is allowed for the reporter or a SUPER_ADMIN only (403 otherwise), although the controller is open to ADMIN.

docs.title: 1. Submit a report and create the GitHub issue
docs.text:
An ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN fills the form on the Report page. The service stores the row first as FAILED with error pending, then calls GitHub outside any transaction, then saves the outcome. A GitHub failure does not fail the HTTP call.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Admin
    participant FE as Browser (ReportPage.jsx, useCreateReport)
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant R as AppReportRepository
    participant GH as JdkGitHubIssueClient (api.github.com)
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: submit form (type, title, description, optional autoLabel)
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports (JWT, context page path appVersion userAgent screenWidth)
    API->>API: PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN, RateLimited 5 per hour, AuditLog createReport
    API->>S: create(request)
    S->>S: currentUser, parseType, trimmed title max 120 and description max 5000,<br/>validateContext, parseAutoLabel
    alt validation fails
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 (error.report.invalidType, invalidTitle, invalidDescription, invalidContext, invalidAutoLabel)
        API-->>FE: 400 ResultErrorInfo
    else autoLabel sent by a non SUPER_ADMIN
        S-->>API: CustomException 403 error.report.autoLabelForbidden
        API-->>FE: 403
    else valid
        S->>R: save(AppReport status FAILED, error pending)
        R->>DB: INSERT app_report
        S->>S: callGitHub(row, role): isCapped counts ADMIN autopilot reports in 24 h
        S->>R: countByStatusAndAutopilotTrueAndReporterRoleAndCreatedAtAfter
        S->>GH: create(title, body, labels)
        GH->>GH: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues, 10 s timeout, no redirects
        GH-->>S: CreatedIssue(number, htmlUrl) on HTTP 201
        S->>S: status CREATED, issueNumber, issueUrl, labels, autopilot, error null
        S->>R: save(row)
        R->>DB: UPDATE app_report
        S-->>API: ReportDto (githubState OPEN, capReached when not autopilot)
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>
        FE->>FE: invalidate ['admin','reports']
        FE-->>U: success alert with link to the issue
    end

docs.title: 2. GitHub failure and retry
docs.text:
When GitHub is down, slow or not configured, the row stays FAILED with a short error code and the response is still 200. The user can retry the same stored row.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Reporter or SUPER_ADMIN
    participant FE as Browser (ReportPage.jsx, useRetryReport)
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant R as AppReportRepository
    participant GH as JdkGitHubIssueClient

    Note over S,GH: create() reached callGitHub
    S->>GH: create(title, body, labels)
    alt not configured
        GH-->>S: GitHubException github.notConfigured
    else non 201 response
        GH-->>S: GitHubException github.http.STATUS
    else timeout
        GH-->>S: GitHubException github.timeout
    else IO error or bad JSON
        GH-->>S: GitHubException github.io
    end
    S->>S: markFailed(row, code): status FAILED, issueNumber null, issueUrl null, error code
    S->>R: save(row)
    S-->>API: ReportDto status FAILED, error code
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>
    FE-->>U: error text from errorText(code) and a Retry button

    U->>FE: click Retry
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports/{id}/retry (JWT)
    API->>API: RateLimited 5 per hour, AuditLog retryReport, parseId
    alt id is not a UUID or unknown
        API-->>FE: 404 error.report.notFound
    else caller is neither reporter nor SUPER_ADMIN
        API-->>FE: 403 error.report.retryForbidden
    else row already CREATED
        API-->>FE: 409 error.report.alreadyCreated
    else retryable
        API->>S: retry(id)
        S->>R: findWithReporterById(id)
        S->>GH: create(...) via callGitHub (label and cap follow the caller's current role)
        S-->>API: ReportDto CREATED or FAILED again
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>
        FE->>FE: invalidate ['admin','reports']
    end

docs.title: 3. Recent list with GitHub state resolution
docs.text:
The list is fetched only while the Recent tab is open. For each CREATED row the state comes from the webhook-stored column first, then a 5 minute cache, then a live GitHub call, run in parallel for the missing rows. FAILED rows get no state.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Admin
    participant FE as Browser (ReportPage.jsx, useReports)
    participant API as AdminReportController
    participant S as ReportServiceImpl
    participant R as AppReportRepository
    participant C as GitHubIssueStateCache (Guava, 5 min TTL)
    participant GH as JdkGitHubIssueClient

    U->>FE: open the Recent tab
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/reports?page=0&size=20 (JWT)
    API->>API: PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN, RateLimited 60 per minute
    API->>S: list(page, size)
    alt page below 0 or size outside 1..50
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.report.invalidPage
        API-->>FE: 400
    else valid
        S->>R: findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc(PageRequest) with reporter entity graph
        S->>S: resolveStates(rows)
        loop each row
            alt status is not CREATED
                S->>S: state null
            else githubState stored by webhook
                S->>S: use stored OPEN or CLOSED
            else issueNumber is null
                S->>S: UNKNOWN
            else
                S->>C: get(issueNumber)
                alt cache hit
                    C-->>S: state
                else miss
                    S->>S: queue state lookup
                end
            end
        end
        par missing rows in parallel (TaskUtils.runAllIgnoreError)
            S->>GH: state(number)
            GH->>GH: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}
            GH-->>S: OPEN, CLOSED or UNKNOWN on any failure
        end
        S->>C: put(number, state) (UNKNOWN is never cached)
        S-->>API: Page<ReportDto> with githubState and githubStateReason
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<Page<ReportDto>>
        FE-->>U: table with StateBadge, failed rows show a failed badge and Retry
    end

docs.title: 4. GitHub webhook receives an issue state change
docs.text:
GitHub posts repo webhooks to a public path with no JWT. The HMAC signature is the authentication. /webhooks/github POST is whitelisted in AppConstant. Check order in GitHubWebhookController.receive: 503, 413, 401, 400, 204.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant GH as GitHub (repo webhook)
    participant API as GitHubWebhookController
    participant WS as GitHubWebhookServiceImpl
    participant R as AppReportRepository
    participant EP as ApplicationEventPublisher
    participant L as ReportNotificationListener

    GH->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/webhooks/github<br/>X-GitHub-Event, X-GitHub-Delivery, X-Hub-Signature-256
    API->>WS: isConfigured()
    alt webhook secret not configured
        API-->>GH: 503 (body not read)
    else configured
        API->>API: read at most 1 MiB plus 1 byte
        alt body larger than 1 MiB
            API-->>GH: 413
        else within limit
            API->>WS: verify(signature, body)
            WS->>WS: HMAC SHA-256 of body, MessageDigest.isEqual (constant time)
            alt signature missing, wrong prefix or mismatch
                API-->>GH: 401 (fixed log text only)
            else signature ok
                API->>WS: handle(event, deliveryId, body)
                WS->>WS: parse JSON object
                alt body not JSON or not an object
                    WS-->>API: IllegalArgumentException
                    API-->>GH: 400
                else event is not issues
                    WS-->>API: IGNORED
                    API-->>GH: 204
                else issues event
                    WS->>WS: require issue.number >= 1 and valid updated_at (else IllegalArgumentException, 400)
                    alt action not closed or reopened, state not open or closed, or repo is not ours
                        WS-->>API: IGNORED
                        API-->>GH: 204
                    else relevant
                        WS->>R: applyGithubState(number, state, reason, updated_at)
                        Note over R: UPDATE app_report SET github_state, github_state_reason, github_state_at<br/>WHERE status CREATED AND issue_number = n<br/>AND (github_state_at IS NULL OR github_state_at < updated_at)
                        R-->>WS: rows changed
                        alt changed more than 0
                            Note over WS: outcome APPLIED
                            opt new state is CLOSED
                                WS->>EP: publishEvent(ReportClosedEvent(number, reason))
                                EP-)L: onClosed (see flow 5)
                            end
                        else no row changed
                            WS->>R: existsByStatusAndIssueNumber(CREATED, number)
                            Note over WS: true means STALE (older event), false means UNKNOWN_ISSUE
                        end
                        WS-->>API: Outcome (logged with sanitized delivery id)
                        API-->>GH: 204
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

docs.title: 5. ReportClosedEvent to REPORT_CLOSED notification
docs.text:
The webhook stores state without an outer transaction, so the listener uses fallbackExecution = true and runs on the async executor. It never lets an exception escape. The admin reporter then sees the item under the ADMIN tab of the bell dropdown.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant L as ReportNotificationListener (async)
    participant R as AppReportRepository
    participant NR as NotificationRepository
    participant P as InMemorySsePublisher
    participant FE as Reporter browser (useNotificationStream)
    actor U as Reporter (admin)

    Note over L: @Async @TransactionalEventListener AFTER_COMMIT, fallbackExecution true
    L->>R: findFirstWithReporterByStatusAndIssueNumber(CREATED, issueNumber)
    alt no report for that issue
        L->>L: nothing to do
    else report found
        L->>L: notifyReporter(report, reason)
        alt reporter null or DEACTIVATED
            L->>L: skip
        else active reporter
            L->>NR: upsertGrouped(userId, REPORT_CLOSED, groupKey report:reportId:REPORT_CLOSED,<br/>null, null, null, payload snippet=title and optional reason)
            alt insert fails
                L->>L: log error, return without push
            else stored
                L->>P: unreadChanged(userId)
                P-)FE: SSE event unread data {"unread":N}
            end
        end
    end
    FE->>FE: setQueryData(UNREAD_KEY), invalidate LIST_KEY
    U->>FE: open bell, ADMIN tab
    FE->>FE: GET /v1/funny-app/notifications?category=ADMIN (ADMIN_TYPES contains REPORT_CLOSED)
    U->>FE: click the item
    FE->>FE: PATCH /notifications/{id}/read, then open the Report page (nav key report, admin only)
    Note over L: Failures are only logged. The same notification also appears in the<br/>email digest via NotificationDigestService.describeReportClosed (reason label from mail.digest.reportReason.*).

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Password Login
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-password-login
  • ADR: 0018-password-login-option
  • Spec: — (plan: plan-password-login)
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

Notes (code vs PRD):

  • "Forgot password" in PasswordLoginModal.jsx makes no API call. LoginForm.handleForgot only closes the modal, copies the typed email into the magic-link form and shows the hint "Press Log in to receive a sign-in link by email". The user then submits the normal magic-link form (POST /user/join).
  • All base paths below are relative to /v1/funny-app.

docs.title: 1. Password sign-in (happy path, with and without MFA)
docs.text:
A visitor opens the password dialog from the header LoginForm, submits email and password and gets a JWT. If the account has MFA enabled, UserServiceImpl.completeLogin returns MFA_REQUIRED plus a session token instead, and the SPA opens MFALoginModal to finish with POST /user/mfa/verify.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (LoginForm / PasswordLoginModal / MFALoginModal)
    participant API as UserController
    participant PL as PasswordLoginServiceImpl
    participant LA as LoginAttemptServiceImpl
    participant US as UserServiceImpl
    participant MS as MFASessionStore
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: open login form
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/user/auth-options
    API-->>FE: 200 AuthOptionsDto (passwordLoginAvailable)
    Note over FE: password button shown only when passwordLoginAvailable is true
    U->>FE: enter email and password, submit
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/user/login (RateLimited 10 per IP)
    API->>PL: login(PasswordLoginRequest)
    PL->>PL: requireEnabled() (app password-login-enabled flag)
    PL->>DB: userRepo.findAllByUserName(email)
    DB-->>PL: User
    PL->>PL: usable check (hash set, not DEACTIVATED, not locked, password at most 72 bytes)
    PL->>PL: bCrypt.matches(password, user.password)
    opt failed_login_count or locked_until was set
        PL->>LA: recordSuccess(userId) (REQUIRES_NEW)
        LA->>DB: userRepo.clearLoginFailures(userId)
    end
    PL->>US: completeLogin(user)
    alt user.mfaEnabled is false
        US->>US: issueToken(user) (JWT with cv claim = credentialsVersion)
        US-->>PL: UserInfoDto (jwt)
        PL-->>API: UserInfoDto
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of UserInfoDto
        FE->>FE: LoginForm.handleAuthResult then AuthContext.login(jwt, user)
        FE-->>U: signed in
    else user.mfaEnabled is true
        US->>MS: storeSession(sessionToken, userName)
        US-->>PL: UserInfoDto (action MFA_REQUIRED, sessionToken, no jwt)
        PL-->>API: UserInfoDto
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of UserInfoDto (MFA_REQUIRED)
        FE->>FE: LoginForm.handleAuthResult stores user, calls onMfaRequired (AppShell opens MFALoginModal)
        U->>FE: enter 6-digit OTP
        FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/user/mfa/verify (otp, username, sessionToken)
        API->>US: verifyMfa(MfaRequest)
        US->>MS: getUserId(sessionToken)
        MS-->>US: userName
        US->>DB: userRepo.findAllByUserName(userName)
        US->>US: totp.verify(otp, mfaSecret)
        US-->>API: UserInfoDto (jwt)
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of UserInfoDto
        FE->>FE: AuthContext.login(jwt, user)
        FE-->>U: signed in
    end

docs.title: 2. Password sign-in failure (generic 401, lockout, rate limit)
docs.text:
Every rejection (unknown email, no password set, wrong password, deactivated, locked, over-long password) returns the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, so callers cannot enumerate accounts. A wrong password increments the failure counter in its own transaction. At 5 failures the account is locked for 15 minutes (magic link still works). The IP rate limit answers 429.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (PasswordLoginModal.jsx)
    participant API as UserController
    participant PL as PasswordLoginServiceImpl
    participant LA as LoginAttemptServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: submit email and password
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/user/login
    alt more than 10 requests per minute from the IP
        API-->>FE: 429 (RateLimited aspect)
        FE-->>U: "rateLimited" message
    else within the limit
        API->>PL: login(PasswordLoginRequest)
        PL->>DB: userRepo.findAllByUserName(email)
        DB-->>PL: User or null
        alt unknown email, no hash, DEACTIVATED, locked or password not checkable
            PL->>PL: burnTime(password) (BCrypt against dummyHash, equal timing)
            PL-->>API: CustomException 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
        else password does not match
            PL->>LA: recordFailure(userId) (REQUIRES_NEW)
            LA->>DB: userRepo.incrementFailedLoginCount(userId)
            LA->>DB: userRepo.findAllById(userId)
            opt failedLoginCount reaches MAX_FAILURES (5)
                LA->>DB: userRepo.lockAccount(userId, now plus 15 min)
            end
            PL-->>API: CustomException 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
        end
        API-->>FE: 401 ResultErrorInfo (INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
        FE-->>U: "invalidCredentials" (same text for every cause)
    end

docs.title: 3. Set or change password (authenticated, MFA aware)
docs.text:
A signed-in user sets a first password (no current password needed) or changes an existing one (current password required) in Settings, SignInPanel.jsx. MFA users must also send a 6-digit OTP. Success bumps credentials_version, which revokes every other session, and returns a fresh JWT for the current one. Remove password (DELETE /user/password) follows the same path with removePassword, always requires the current password and sends PASSWORD_REMOVED.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (SignInPanel.jsx)
    participant API as UserController
    participant PL as PasswordLoginServiceImpl
    participant LA as LoginAttemptServiceImpl
    participant CV as CredentialsVersionCache
    participant US as UserServiceImpl
    participant MAIL as MailService
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: fill current (if set), new, confirm, OTP (if mfaEnabled)
    FE->>FE: client checks (required, confirm match, OTP length 6)
    FE->>API: PUT /v1/funny-app/user/password (JWT, RateLimited 5)
    API->>PL: setPassword(SetPasswordRequest)
    PL->>PL: requireEnabled() and currentUser() (AppUtils.getCurrentUser, userRepo.findAllById)
    PL->>PL: PasswordPolicy.validate(newPassword, email)
    opt user already has a password
        PL->>PL: verifyCurrentPassword(user, currentPassword)
        Note over PL,LA: wrong current password calls recordFailure and counts toward lockout
    end
    opt user.mfaEnabled
        PL->>PL: verifyOtpIfMfa() via totp.verify(otp, mfaSecret)
    end
    PL->>PL: bCrypt.encode(newPassword), set passwordSetAt
    PL->>DB: userRepo.save(user) with credentialsVersion plus 1
    PL->>CV: evict(userId)
    PL->>US: issueToken(user) (new cv claim)
    PL->>MAIL: sendSimpleMail(security notice) (failure only logged)
    PL-->>API: UserInfoDto (jwt, action PASSWORD_SET or PASSWORD_CHANGED)
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of UserInfoDto
    FE->>FE: AuthContext.login(newJwt, user) and patch ['settings'] query
    FE-->>U: "passwordUpdated"
    alt policy violation
        PL-->>API: CustomException 400 PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT, PASSWORD_TOO_LONG, PASSWORD_CONTAINS_EMAIL or PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON
    else wrong or uncheckable current password, or account locked
        PL-->>API: CustomException 400 CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID
    else MFA user with missing or wrong OTP
        PL-->>API: CustomException 400 OTP_INVALID
    end
    API-->>FE: 400 ResultErrorInfo (code)
    FE-->>U: mapPasswordError() shows translated errCodes text

docs.title: 4. Session revocation after a credential change
docs.text:
Tokens carry a cv claim. JWTAuthenticationFilter compares it with CredentialsVersionCache.currentVersion(userId) on every request, so a token issued before a set, change or remove is rejected with 401 TOKEN_REVOKED. The SPA then clears local storage and signs the user out.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE2 as Browser (other device, old JWT)
    participant F as JWTAuthenticationFilter
    participant JP as JwtProvider
    participant CV as CredentialsVersionCache
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant AC as Browser (client.js and AuthContext)

    FE2->>F: any protected request with old JWT (cv = n)
    F->>JP: verifyToken(token)
    JP-->>F: UserDetailDto (credentialsVersion = n)
    F->>CV: currentVersion(userId)
    alt cached value present
        CV-->>F: n plus 1
    else cache miss or expired (instances converge within about a minute)
        CV->>DB: read credentials_version
        DB-->>CV: n plus 1
        CV-->>F: n plus 1
    end
    F-->>FE2: 401 TOKEN_REVOKED
    FE2->>AC: client.js removes jwt and user, dispatches AUTH_REVOKED_EVENT
    AC-->>FE2: signed out, login form shown

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: React Frontend Migration (SPA runtime)
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-react-migration
  • ADR: 0008-react-migration
  • Spec: —
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

PRD vs code.

  • The PRD status is Planning but the SPA is live in webapp/ (ADR-0008: Accepted, implemented).
  • PRD says React Router v6 for routing. The code uses react-router-dom v7 but defines no <Route> elements. BrowserRouter only provides useNavigate to MagicLinkHandler, and screens are switched by an activeNav state in AppShell.
  • PRD says react-bootstrap and Font Awesome. The UI uses custom CSS tokens and Material Symbols.
  • PRD lists /private-videos, the private tab and /share-links POST. The private tab was removed and share links are being retired. Only DELETE /share-links/{id} remains in videosApi.
  • webapp/CLAUDE.md mentions Axios, but src/api/client.js uses fetch. The Authorization header carries the raw JWT with no Bearer prefix.
  • There is no global React Query 401 handler. 401 handling lives in client.js (TOKEN_REVOKED only) and AuthContext (the /user/me check at boot).

All API calls go to VITE_API_BASE_URL, default https://canh-labs.com/api/v1/funny-app.

docs.title: 1. App boot and JWT restore
docs.text:
On load, main.jsx renders App, which nests BrowserRouter, QueryClientProvider (retry 1, no refetch on focus), ThemeProvider, AuthProvider, AppShell. AuthProvider reads jwt, user and guestToken from localStorage and, when a JWT exists, validates it with GET /user/me.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant M as Browser (main.jsx, App.jsx)
    participant AP as AuthProvider (AuthContext.jsx)
    participant LS as localStorage
    participant C as api/client.js
    participant API as UserController

    U->>M: load SPA
    M->>AP: mount providers then AppShell
    AP->>LS: readStorage jwt, user, guestToken
    alt no jwt
        AP->>AP: loading = false, guest mode
    else jwt present
        AP->>AP: loading = true, user from cache
        AP->>C: authApi.me()
        C->>API: GET /user/me (Authorization jwt, X-Guest-Token)
        alt 200
            API-->>C: ResultObjectInfo of UserDetailDto
            AP->>LS: store user with role and isAdmin
            AP->>AP: loading = false
        else 401 or 403 (expired or invalid token)
            API-->>C: error
            C-->>AP: throw message, status
            AP->>LS: remove jwt and user
            AP->>AP: jwt = null, user = null, loading = false
        else network or 5xx
            AP->>AP: keep stored session, loading = false
        end
    end
    AP-->>U: AppShell renders (home feed for guests and users)

docs.title: 2. Magic link sign-in (?token= in the URL)
docs.text:
MagicLinkHandler (mounted in AppShell) runs once, strips the token from the address bar and exchanges it for a JWT. Accounts with MFA get an intermediate MFA_REQUIRED answer.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant H as MagicLinkHandler.jsx
    participant AP as AuthProvider
    participant C as api/client.js
    participant API as UserController
    participant SH as AppShell

    U->>H: open email link with ?token=T
    H->>H: history.replaceState (token removed from URL)
    H->>C: authApi.verifyMagic(T)
    C->>API: GET /user/verify-magic?token=T
    alt valid token and no MFA
        API-->>C: 200 ResultObjectInfo (jwt, user)
        H->>AP: login(jwt, user)
        AP->>AP: localStorage jwt and user, isLoggedIn = true
        H->>H: navigate to root (replace)
    else MFA enabled
        API-->>C: 200 action MFA_REQUIRED
        H->>SH: onMfaRequired(data) opens MFALoginModal
        SH->>API: POST /user/mfa/verify (otp, username, sessionToken)
        API-->>SH: jwt and user then login()
    else invalid or expired
        API-->>C: error
        H->>SH: onError(message) shows toast for 5 seconds
    end

docs.title: 3. Screen guard (no router routes)
docs.text:
There are no protected routes. AppShell picks the screen from activeNav and renders admin screens only when user.isAdmin is true. The server is the real gate: AdminController is @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") and JWTAuthenticationFilter rejects bad tokens with 401.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant SH as AppShell.jsx
    participant AU as useAuth (AuthContext)
    participant AV as AdminView.jsx
    participant C as api/client.js
    participant F as JWTAuthenticationFilter
    participant API as AdminController

    U->>SH: click Admin nav or notification link
    SH->>AU: read user.isAdmin, isLoggedIn
    SH->>SH: goNav('admin') sets activeNav
    alt activeNav is admin and user.isAdmin
        SH->>AV: render AdminView
        AV->>C: GET /admin/videos (JWT)
        C->>F: request
        F->>F: verifyToken and credentials version check
        F->>API: pass with ROLE from token
        API-->>AV: 200 page of AdminVideoDto
    else activeNav is admin and not admin
        SH->>SH: falls through to ComingSoon page (no API call)
    else settings and not logged in
        SH->>SH: render ComingSoon page=settings
    end
    opt forged client state or demoted admin
        C->>F: GET /admin/videos with non-admin JWT
        F->>API: pass
        API-->>C: 403 from PreAuthorize
    end

docs.title: 4. React Query data fetch with 401 handling
docs.text:
A hook such as useVideos or useMyCollections calls api.get. client.js adds Authorization, X-Guest-Token and Accept-Language. Only a TOKEN_REVOKED 401 triggers a global logout through the auth:revoked window event. Any other failure is thrown as { message, status, code } to React Query, which retries once (retry: 1) and then exposes error to the component.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant CP as Component (VideoFeed.jsx, LibraryView.jsx)
    participant Q as React Query (useVideos, useMyCollections)
    participant C as api/client.js request()
    participant F as JWTAuthenticationFilter
    participant API as Controller
    participant AP as AuthProvider
    participant SH as AppShell

    CP->>Q: useQuery(['videos', category])
    Q->>C: videosApi.list() GET /video-stream/list
    C->>API: fetch with headers (public path, no JWT check)
    API-->>C: 200 ResultListInfo of VideoDto
    C-->>Q: data
    Q-->>CP: videos (staleTime 5 min, mapApiVideo, sorted by upvotes)

    CP->>Q: useQuery(['collections','mine'])
    Q->>C: api.get('/collections')
    C->>F: GET /collections (Authorization jwt)
    alt token valid
        F->>API: continue
        API-->>C: 200 ResultListInfo
        C-->>Q: data
    else token revoked (password changed elsewhere)
        F-->>C: 401 error.message TOKEN_REVOKED
        C->>C: remove jwt and user from localStorage
        C-)AP: window event auth:revoked
        AP->>AP: jwt = null, user = null, sessionNotice set
        AP-->>SH: sessionNotice
        SH->>SH: toast sessionRevoked for 5 seconds
        C-->>Q: throw message, status 401
        Q->>Q: retry once then error state
    else other 401 (expired token)
        F-->>C: 401 ResultErrorInfo
        C-->>Q: throw message, status 401
        Q-->>CP: error shown inline, session cleared at next boot via /user/me
    end

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: User Notifications
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-user-notifications
  • ADR: 0017-user-notifications
  • Spec: — (plan: plan-user-notifications)
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

Notes where the code differs from the PRD:

  • The SSE event is named unread with data {"unread":N} (the server-side publisher method is NotificationPublisher.unreadChanged(userId)).
  • The PRD predates REPORT_CLOSED and the category filter. NotificationType.ADMIN_TYPES is {REPORT_CLOSED}. GET /notifications?category=GENERAL|ADMIN is accepted from any logged-in user, because the controller and service do no admin check. Only the React dropdown limits the two tabs to admins (user.isAdmin).
  • Emitters are held in memory per JVM (InMemorySsePublisher), at most 5 per user, 30 minute timeout.

docs.title: 1. Event to notification row to SSE unread push
docs.text:
A comment reply is committed, an async listener upserts one grouped notification row per recipient, then pushes the new unread count to the recipient's open tabs. CommentRemovedEvent follows the same path through onCommentRemoved. ReportClosedEvent uses ReportNotificationListener (see the in-app-report diagrams).

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor A as Replying user
    participant API as CommentController
    participant CS as VideoCommentServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant L as NotificationEventListener (async)
    participant NR as NotificationRepository
    participant P as InMemorySsePublisher
    participant FE as Recipient browser (useNotificationStream)

    A->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/videos/{videoId}/comments
    API->>CS: createComment(videoId, req) @Transactional
    CS->>DB: INSERT video_comment
    CS->>CS: publishEvent(CommentRepliedEvent)
    CS-->>API: CreateCommentResponse
    API-->>A: 200 ResultObjectInfo
    Note over CS,L: AFTER_COMMIT, @Async virtual thread
    CS-)L: onCommentReplied(event)
    L->>L: replyRecipients: root author + parent author<br/>minus actor, guests, duplicates
    loop each recipient email
        L->>L: deliver(email, COMMENT_REPLY, groupKey REPLY:rootId, ...)
        L->>DB: userRepo.findAllByUserName(email)
        alt user missing or DEACTIVATED
            L->>L: skip
        else active user
            L->>NR: upsertGrouped(userId, type, groupKey, videoId, commentId, actorDisplay, payload)
            NR->>DB: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (user_id, group_key) WHERE read_at IS NULL<br/>DO UPDATE actor_count + 1, updated_at now, emailed_at NULL
            L->>P: unreadChanged(userId)
            P->>NR: countByUserIdAndReadAtIsNull(userId)
            loop each open emitter of the user
                P-)FE: SSE event unread data {"unread":N}
            end
            FE->>FE: setQueryData(UNREAD_KEY, count N)<br/>invalidateQueries(LIST_KEY)
        end
    end
    Note over L: any exception is logged, never rethrown

docs.title: 2. SSE stream connect, heartbeat and reconnect
docs.text:
The logged-in browser opens one fetch based stream (JWT in the Authorization header, never in the URL). The hook is mounted once in AppShell.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (useNotificationStream in AppShell)
    participant F as JWT filter
    participant API as NotificationController
    participant P as InMemorySsePublisher
    participant NR as NotificationRepository

    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/notifications/stream (Authorization header)
    API->>F: authenticate
    alt no or invalid JWT
        F-->>FE: 401
        FE->>FE: setUp(false), stop reconnecting for good
    else valid JWT
        API->>API: AppUtils.getCurrentUser()
        API->>P: register(userId)
        P->>P: add emitter, evict oldest when more than 5 per user
        P->>NR: countByUserIdAndReadAtIsNull(userId)
        P-)FE: SSE event unread data {"unread":N}
        API-->>FE: 200 text/event-stream, Cache-Control no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering no
        FE->>FE: setUp(true), polling slows to 120 s
    end
    loop every 25 s (HEARTBEAT_MS)
        P-)FE: SSE comment ping
        Note over P: a failed send removes and completes the emitter
    end
    Note over FE: stream ends or errors
    FE->>FE: setUp(false), polling 30 s,<br/>wait backoffDelay(attempt) 1 s to 30 s plus 1 to 5 s jitter
    FE->>API: GET /notifications/stream (retry)
    Note over FE,P: Fallback while the stream is down: GET /notifications/unread-count<br/>every 30 s and on window focus

docs.title: 3. Bell dropdown list with optional category filter
docs.text:
The bell shows the badge from GET /notifications/unread-count. Opening the dropdown loads page 0 (size 20, shows the first 10). Admins get two tabs, GENERAL and ADMIN, each its own query.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (NotificationBell, NotificationDropdown)
    participant API as NotificationController
    participant S as NotificationServiceImpl
    participant R as NotificationRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/notifications/unread-count (JWT)
    API->>S: unreadCount()
    S->>R: countByUserIdAndReadAtIsNull(userId)
    R->>DB: SELECT count
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<UnreadCountDto>
    FE-->>U: badge number

    U->>FE: open the bell dropdown
    alt non admin user
        FE->>API: GET /notifications?page=0&size=20 (no category)
    else admin user
        FE->>API: GET /notifications?page=0&size=20&category=GENERAL
        FE->>API: GET /notifications?page=0&size=20&category=ADMIN
    end
    API->>API: page max 0, size clamped to 1..50
    API->>S: list(category, pageable)
    S->>S: currentUserId() (401 4011 if no user)
    alt category null
        S->>R: findByUserIdOrderByUpdatedAtDesc
    else category ADMIN
        S->>R: findByUserIdAndTypeInOrderByUpdatedAtDesc(ADMIN_TYPES)
    else category GENERAL
        S->>R: findByUserIdAndTypeNotInOrderByUpdatedAtDesc(ADMIN_TYPES)
    end
    R->>DB: SELECT ... ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    S-->>API: Page<NotificationDto>
    API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo<Page<NotificationDto>>
    FE-->>U: list, GENERAL tab by default, red dot on a tab with unread rows

    opt invalid category value
        API-->>FE: 400 (enum conversion error)
    end

docs.title: 4. Mark one read and mark all read
docs.text:
Both calls are optimistic in the browser. The service commits the update first (the service methods are deliberately not transactional), then asks the publisher to push the fresh count to every open tab.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (useMarkRead, useMarkAllRead)
    participant API as NotificationController
    participant S as NotificationServiceImpl
    participant R as NotificationRepository
    participant P as InMemorySsePublisher
    participant T as Other tabs of the user

    U->>FE: click an unread item
    FE->>FE: onMutate: UNREAD_KEY count minus 1
    FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/notifications/{id}/read (JWT)
    API->>S: markRead(id)
    S->>R: findByIdAndUserId(id, userId)
    alt not found or owned by someone else
        S-->>API: CustomException 404 subcode 4041
        API-->>FE: 404
        FE->>FE: onError: restore previous count
    else own row
        S->>R: markRead(id, userId, now) (UPDATE where read_at IS NULL)
        S->>P: unreadChanged(userId)
        P-)T: SSE event unread data {"unread":N}
        API-->>FE: 204
    end
    FE->>FE: onSettled: invalidate UNREAD_KEY and LIST_KEY

    U->>FE: click Mark all read
    FE->>FE: onMutate: UNREAD_KEY count 0
    FE->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/notifications/read-all (JWT)
    API->>S: markAllRead()
    S->>R: markAllRead(userId, now)
    S->>P: unreadChanged(userId)
    P-)T: SSE event unread data {"unread":0}
    API-->>FE: 204
    FE->>FE: onSettled: invalidate UNREAD_KEY and LIST_KEY

docs.title: 5. Email digest and retention scheduled jobs
docs.text:
DynamicJobScheduler reads the scheduled_job table at startup (ApplicationReadyEvent) and runs JobRegistry tasks by cron. Seeded crons from the Liquibase changelog 202610190002-create-scheduled-job.sql: notification-digest is 0 */15 * * * *, notification-retention is 0 30 3 * * * in zone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The PRD says "every 15 min", which matches.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant D as DynamicJobScheduler
    participant J as AppScheduler.notificationDigest
    participant DS as NotificationDigestService
    participant NR as NotificationRepository
    participant UR as UserRepo
    participant EL as EmailCacheLimiter
    participant M as MailService (Gmail SMTP)

    D->>D: cron fires, execute(name, task) with a per-job running guard
    D->>J: run notificationDigest()
    J->>DS: sendDigests()
    DS->>NR: findUserIdsForDigest()
    Note over NR: users with notify_email = true<br/>and unread, not yet emailed rows
    loop each userId
        DS->>EL: getDailyCount(today)
        alt count x 100 >= maxDailyEmails x 50
            DS->>DS: log warn, stop the run (budget protects magic links)
        else budget left
            DS->>UR: findAllById(userId)
            alt missing, DEACTIVATED or blank email
                DS->>DS: skip user
            else active
                DS->>NR: findByUserIdAndReadAtIsNullAndEmailedAtIsNull...OrderByUpdatedAtDesc
                DS->>DS: build subject and body (max 5 items, then "and N more"), locale via EmailLocaleResolver
                DS->>M: sendSimpleMail(userName, subject, body)
                DS->>EL: incrementDailyCount(today)
                DS->>NR: markEmailed(ids, now)
            end
        end
    end
    DS-->>J: number of emails sent
    J->>J: log "Notification digest sent N email(s)"
    Note over DS: A failure for one user is logged, emailed_at stays NULL,<br/>so the next run retries. A later upsertGrouped on the same group<br/>resets emailed_at to NULL.

    D->>D: nightly cron for notification-retention
    D->>DS: AppScheduler.notificationRetention() then purgeOldRead(now)
    DS->>NR: deleteReadOlderThan(now minus 90 days)
    NR-->>DS: deleted rows

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: User Settings
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-user-settings
  • ADR: 0016-user-settings-design
  • Spec: spec-user-settings
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

All endpoints are under /v1/funny-app and need a JWT. UserSettingsController is class-level @AuditLog, so otp and confirmation are masked in audit logs.

docs.title: 1. Open Settings page (GET settings, lazy create)
docs.text:
The user opens /settings. SettingsPage.jsx loads settings through useSettings(). The first call creates a defaults row.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (SettingsPage.jsx)
    participant HK as useSettings.js
    participant API as UserSettingsController
    participant S as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant SR as UserSettingsRepository
    participant UR as UserRepo
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: opens Settings
    FE->>HK: useSettings()
    HK->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/user/settings
    API->>S: getSettings()
    S->>SR: findById(userId)
    alt no row yet
        S->>SR: save(defaults: notify true, quality AUTO, incognito false, private false)
        SR->>DB: INSERT user_settings
    else row exists
        SR-->>S: UserSettings
    end
    S->>UR: findAllById(userId)
    UR-->>S: User (password, mfaEnabled)
    S->>S: buildDto(email, user, settings, flags passwordLoginEnabled and subscriptionStatusEnabled)
    S-->>API: UserSettingsDto
    API-->>HK: 200 ResultObjectInfo with UserSettingsDto
    HK-->>FE: renders Identity, Notifications, Playback, Language, Privacy, Danger zone

docs.title: 2. Change a setting (partial, atomic PATCH)
docs.text:
Each toggle or quality button sends only its own field. The service validates every provided field before writing anything, so one bad field rejects the whole request.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (SettingsPage.jsx)
    participant HK as useUpdateSettings
    participant API as UserSettingsController
    participant S as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant SR as UserSettingsRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: toggles a switch or picks quality
    FE->>HK: updateSettings.mutate with one field (controls disabled while pending)
    HK->>API: PATCH /v1/funny-app/user/settings (rate limit 20)
    API->>S: updateSettings(UpdateUserSettingsRequest)
    alt no field provided
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.settings.emptyUpdate
        API-->>HK: 400 ResultErrorInfo
    else defaultQuality not AUTO, 1080P or 4K
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.settings.invalidQuality
        API-->>HK: 400 ResultErrorInfo
    else locale not vi or en
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.settings.invalidLocale
        API-->>HK: 400 ResultErrorInfo
    else all valid
        S->>SR: findById(userId) or create defaults
        S->>S: apply only the provided fields
        S->>SR: save(settings)
        SR->>DB: UPDATE user_settings (updated_at bumped)
        S-->>API: UserSettingsDto
        API-->>HK: 200 ResultObjectInfo with UserSettingsDto
        HK->>HK: setQueryData settings
        HK-->>FE: UI reflects new value
    end
    opt PATCH failed
        HK-->>FE: onError, patchError alert shown (settings value stays as before)
    end

docs.title: 3. Delete account (step-up verification)
docs.text:
The Danger zone opens DeleteAccountModal.jsx. An MFA user types a 6 digit OTP, other users type their email. The server soft-deletes and anonymizes, then the client logs out.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (DeleteAccountModal.jsx)
    participant API as UserSettingsController
    participant S as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant T as Totp
    participant UR as UserRepo
    participant WR as WatchHistoryRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: clicks Delete my account
    FE->>FE: client check (OTP has 6 digits, or confirmation equals own email)
    FE->>API: DELETE /v1/funny-app/user/account body otp or confirmation (rate limit 3)
    API->>S: deleteAccount(DeleteAccountRequest)
    S->>UR: findAllById(userId)
    alt already DEACTIVATED
        S-->>API: CustomException 409 error.account.alreadyDeactivated
        API-->>FE: 409 ResultErrorInfo
    else MFA enabled
        S->>T: verify(otp, mfaSecret)
        alt OTP wrong
            S-->>API: CustomException 403 error.otp.incorrect
            API-->>FE: 403 ResultErrorInfo
        end
    else MFA not enabled and confirmation differs from user name
        S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.account.confirmationMismatch
        API-->>FE: 400 ResultErrorInfo
    end
    Note over S: verification passed
    S->>UR: save(status DEACTIVATED, deleted_at now, user_name deleted_user_id, password null, mfa cleared)
    UR->>DB: UPDATE users
    S->>WR: deleteAll(userId)
    WR->>DB: DELETE FROM watch_history
    S-->>API: void
    API-->>FE: 204 No Content
    FE->>FE: logout() then redirect to /
    opt error
        FE-->>U: error alert in modal
    end

docs.title: 4. Deactivated account cannot sign in
docs.text:
After deletion the account is rejected on the magic-link and MFA paths. UserServiceImpl.requireActive throws 403. The password login path also refuses deactivated users.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (MagicLinkHandler.jsx)
    participant API as UserController
    participant S as UserServiceImpl
    participant UR as UserRepo

    U->>FE: opens magic link
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/user/verify-magic?token=...
    API->>S: verify magic token
    S->>UR: findAllByUserName(email)
    UR-->>S: User with status DEACTIVATED
    S->>S: requireActive(user)
    S-->>API: CustomException 403 error.account.deactivated
    API-->>FE: 403 ResultErrorInfo, no JWT issued
    Note over FE,API: the same guard runs in verifyMfa (POST /user/mfa/verify)

docs.title: Notes: PRD/spec vs code
docs.text:
• The spec lists POST /user/join as guarded. As built, /user/join only sends a magic link via inviteService.inviteUser and does not check status. The guard is in UserServiceImpl (verify-magic and verifyMfa) and in PasswordLoginServiceImpl (/user/login).
  • The spec says editable fields are five. As built, locale (vi or en) is a sixth editable field (ADR-0020), and UpdateUserSettingsRequest.isLocaleProvided() lets the client send an explicit null.
  • The spec says toggles may revert on error. As built there is no optimistic update: the UI waits for the 200 and shows patchError on failure.
  • defaultQuality is stored and returned, but no player code in webapp/src reads it yet (only SettingsPage.jsx). Incognito is consumed by watch history (see sequence-watch-history-v2).
  • profilePrivate is stored only, no other feature reads it in the code searched.
  • The spec says the session or token is invalidated server-side on delete. In the code read, deleteAccount does not touch tokens: the client calls logout() and redirects. Not verified whether the JWT filter rejects deactivated users on later requests.

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Video Suggestions
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-video-suggestions
  • ADR: — (no ADR of its own. The PRD builds on 0019-admin-video-import and 0017-user-notifications)
  • Spec: — (plan: plan-video-suggestions. Later changes: plan-suggestion-transitions, plan-suggestion-rereview)
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

Notes (code vs PRD):

  • Base path for every endpoint is /v1/funny-app. In the diagrams :id stands for the path variable {id}. Suggestion endpoints are not in any public path list, so the JWT filter answers 401 for guests.
  • The PRD describes submit, duplicate (409) and daily limit (429, default 5 per 24 hours, app.video-suggestion.daily-limit). The code matches. The code also has features the PRD does not draw: POST /suggestions/{id}/rereview (max 2 per suggestion), POST /admin/video-suggestions/{id}/reopen, and a LIVE filter.
  • The quota is checked before the URL is resolved, so an over-quota user never triggers a network call to resolve a share link.
  • Approve reuses the import pipeline: it creates one video_import_jobs row through VideoImportService.createResolved. A video becomes live only after the Drive sync ingests the uploaded file (see the admin video import diagrams).

docs.title: 1. User submits a suggestion
docs.text:
A logged-in user taps "+" in AppShell.jsx, which opens SuggestVideoModal.jsx (admins go straight to the Import tab instead). The modal validates the URL locally, then posts to VideoSuggestionController.submit. The new row starts as PENDING.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (SuggestVideoModal.jsx, useSubmitSuggestion)
    participant API as VideoSuggestionController
    participant S as VideoSuggestionServiceImpl
    participant R as ImportUrlResolver
    participant REPO as VideoSuggestionRepository
    participant JR as VideoImportJobRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: paste URL, optional title and note, submit
    FE->>FE: validateSuggestionUrl(url) (shows a local error and stops when invalid)
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/suggestions (JWT, RateLimited 10)
    alt no JWT (guest)
        API-->>FE: 401 ResultErrorInfo
    else authenticated
        API->>API: currentUserId() (401 error.auth.required if none)
        API->>S: submit(userId, url, title, note)
        S->>REPO: countByUserIdAndCreatedAtAfter(userId, now minus 24h)
        alt count is at or above dailyLimit
            S-->>API: CustomException 429 error.suggestion.dailyLimit
        else under the limit
            S->>R: resolve(url)
            alt not a supported YouTube or Facebook URL
                S-->>API: CustomException 400 error.suggestion.invalidUrl
            else resolved
                S->>REPO: existsByNormalizedUrlAndStatus(url, PENDING)
                S->>JR: existsByNormalizedUrlAndStatusIn(url, ACTIVE plus DONE)
                alt pending suggestion or active or done import covers the URL
                    S-->>API: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.duplicate
                else free
                    S->>REPO: saveAndFlush(VideoSuggestion status PENDING)
                    REPO->>DB: INSERT video_suggestions
                    Note over S,DB: a lost race on the partial unique index on pending normalized_url is also mapped to 409 duplicate
                    S-->>API: SuggestionDto
                    API-->>FE: 201 ResultObjectInfo of SuggestionDto
                    FE->>FE: invalidate the suggestions mine and mine-infinite queries
                    FE-->>U: "submitted" message, link to the History page
                end
            end
        end
