    end
    API-->>FE: 4xx ResultErrorInfo with code
    FE-->>U: errorKeyFor(err.code) text, else err.message

docs.title: 2. Admin reviews: approve creates an import job
docs.text:
The Admin tab (AdminSuggestionTable.jsx, useAdminSuggestions.js) lists suggestions with pending first and polls pending-count every 60 s for the badge. Approve runs in one transaction under a row lock on the suggestion, creates exactly one import job scheduled now, and publishes SuggestionReviewedEvent. After commit the worker is woken again and the suggester is notified.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor A as Admin
    participant FE as Browser (AdminSuggestionTable.jsx, useAdminSuggestions.js)
    participant API as AdminVideoSuggestionController
    participant S as VideoSuggestionServiceImpl
    participant REPO as VideoSuggestionRepository
    participant IMP as VideoImportServiceImpl
    participant W as VideoImportWorker
    participant EV as SuggestionNotificationListener
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    loop every 60 s
        FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/video-suggestions/pending-count
        API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of Long (badge)
    end
    FE->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/video-suggestions?status&page&size
    API->>S: list(filter, page, size)
    S->>REPO: findAllPendingFirst or findAllLiveNewest or findAllByStatusNewest
    S-->>FE: 200 Page of SuggestionDto (suggesterName, importJobId, canReopen, live)
    A->>FE: click Approve (optional title override)
    FE->>API: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/video-suggestions/:id/approve (ADMIN, AuditLog)
    API->>S: approve(id, title, adminId)
    alt app.video-import.enabled is false
        S-->>API: CustomException 503 error.import.disabled
    else enabled
        S->>REPO: findByIdForUpdate(id) inside TransactionTemplate
        alt id unknown
            S-->>API: CustomException 404 error.suggestion.notFound
        else status is not PENDING
            S-->>API: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.notPending
        else pending
            S->>IMP: createResolved(ImportUrl from stored sourceUrl, title, adminId)
            IMP->>DB: INSERT video_import_jobs (PENDING, scheduled now)
            alt import line rejected (DUPLICATE_ACTIVE, INVALID_URL)
                S-->>API: CustomException 409 error.import.duplicateActive or error.import.invalidUrl
            else job created
                S->>REPO: save(status APPROVED, importJobId, reviewedBy, reviewedAt)
                S--)EV: publish SuggestionReviewedEvent(approved true)
                S-->>API: SuggestionDto (after commit)
                S->>W: wakeUp() (job is visible now)
                API-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of SuggestionDto
                FE->>FE: invalidate the admin suggestions and admin imports queries
            end
        end
    end
    EV->>EV: onReviewed() AFTER_COMMIT on async executor
    EV->>DB: notificationRepository.upsertGrouped(SUGGESTION_APPROVED, group suggestion:id:type)
    EV->>EV: publisher.unreadChanged(userId) (SSE hint)

docs.title: 3. Import finishes and the suggester is told the video is live
docs.text:
The import job downloads the video and uploads it to the Drive folder. The Drive sync (cron job sync-drive-videos or the admin force sync) later saves the video_sources row and publishes VideoIngestedEvent. The listener links the Drive file id back to the job, then to the approved suggestion, and notifies the suggester.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant W as VideoImportWorker
    participant GD as Google Drive folder
    participant J as Drive sync (AppScheduler.syncDriveVideos)
    participant VS as VideoStorageServiceImpl
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant EV as SuggestionNotificationListener
    participant SSE as InMemorySsePublisher
    participant FE as Browser (useNotifications.js, NotificationBell)
    actor U as Suggester

    W->>GD: upload title.mp4 (job DONE, driveFileId stored)
    J->>GD: list new files and download the new one
    J->>VS: saveInfo(fileId, title, thumbnailUrl)
    VS->>DB: INSERT video_sources (source_type google_drive, source_id = fileId)
    VS--)EV: publish VideoIngestedEvent(driveFileId, videoSourceId)
    Note over VS,EV: publish failures are only logged. fallbackExecution is on because the cron runs without a transaction
    EV->>DB: jobRepository.findFirstByDriveFileId(driveFileId)
    EV->>DB: suggestionRepository.findFirstByImportJobId(job.id)
    alt no linked suggestion or status is not APPROVED
        EV->>EV: nothing to do
    else approved suggestion found
        EV->>DB: userRepo.findById(userId)
        alt user missing or DEACTIVATED
            EV->>EV: skip
        else active user
            EV->>DB: notificationRepository.upsertGrouped(SUGGESTION_LIVE, videoId = videoSourceId)
            EV->>SSE: unreadChanged(userId)
            SSE--)FE: SSE event unread (GET /v1/funny-app/notifications/stream)
            FE->>FE: update unread badge
            FE-->>U: notification "your suggestion is live"
        end
    end
    Note over FE: the History tab shows the item as LIVE once findLiveRefs finds the video_sources row

docs.title: 4. Reject, re-review request and reopen
docs.text:
An admin rejects a pending suggestion with a reason (note is required for OTHER). The suggester can ask for a re-review at most MAX_REREVIEWS (2) times, which moves the suggestion back to pending. An admin can also reopen a rejected suggestion, or an approved one whose import ended FAILED or CANCELLED. All transitions are decided by SuggestionTransition and run under a row lock.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor A as Admin
    actor U as Suggester
    participant FE as Browser (AdminSuggestionTable, SuggestionCard.jsx)
    participant AAPI as AdminVideoSuggestionController
    participant UAPI as VideoSuggestionController
    participant S as VideoSuggestionServiceImpl
    participant T as SuggestionTransition
    participant REPO as VideoSuggestionRepository
    participant EV as SuggestionNotificationListener

    A->>FE: choose reject reason and optional note
    FE->>AAPI: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/video-suggestions/:id/reject (reason, note)
    AAPI->>S: reject(id, reason, note, adminId)
    alt reason OTHER without a note
        S-->>AAPI: CustomException 400 error.suggestion.noteRequired
    else valid
        S->>REPO: findByIdForUpdate(id)
        S->>T: REJECT.check(status)
        alt not PENDING
            S-->>AAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.notPending
        else pending
            S->>REPO: save(status REJECTED, rejectReason, rejectNote, reviewedBy)
            S--)EV: publish SuggestionReviewedEvent(approved false, reason)
            EV->>EV: onReviewed() creates SUGGESTION_REJECTED notification
            S-->>AAPI: SuggestionDto
            AAPI-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of SuggestionDto
        end
    end

    U->>FE: click "Ask for re-review" (optional message up to 300 chars)
    FE->>UAPI: POST /v1/funny-app/suggestions/:id/rereview (RateLimited 10)
    UAPI->>S: requestRereview(id, userId, message)
    S->>REPO: findByIdForUpdate(id) and owner check
    alt not found or not the owner
        S-->>UAPI: CustomException 404 error.suggestion.notFound
    else owner
        S->>T: REREVIEW.check(status, rereviewCount)
        alt status is not REJECTED
            S-->>UAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.notRejected
        else rereviewCount is 2 or more
            S-->>UAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.rereviewLimit
        else allowed
            S->>REPO: existsByNormalizedUrlAndStatus(url, PENDING) and import job check
            alt URL is covered again
                S-->>UAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.duplicate
            else free
                S->>REPO: requestRereview(id, userId, message, MAX_REREVIEWS, now) (guarded UPDATE back to PENDING)
                S-->>UAPI: SuggestionDto
                UAPI-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of SuggestionDto
                FE->>FE: invalidate the suggestions queries
            end
        end
    end

    A->>FE: click "Reopen"
    FE->>AAPI: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/video-suggestions/:id/reopen
    AAPI->>S: reopen(id, adminId)
    S->>REPO: findByIdForUpdate(id) and lock the linked import job row when APPROVED
    S->>T: REOPEN.check(status, jobStatus, rereviewCount)
    alt status is PENDING
        S-->>AAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.alreadyPending
    else APPROVED and job is not FAILED or CANCELLED
        S-->>AAPI: CustomException 409 error.suggestion.cannotReopen
    else allowed
        S->>S: requireNoDuplicate(url)
        S->>REPO: save(status PENDING, review fields and importJobId cleared)
        S-->>AAPI: SuggestionDto
        AAPI-->>FE: 200 ResultObjectInfo of SuggestionDto
    end

docs.title: Sequence Diagrams: Watch History v2
docs.text:
• PRD: PRD-watch-history-v2
  • ADR: 0021-watch-history
  • Spec: — (plan: plan-watch-history-v2)
  • Status: As-built (2026-10-21)

All endpoints are under /v1/funny-app. The user id always comes from the JWT (AppUtils.getCurrentUser()), never from the request. Writes are native SQL in WatchHistoryRepository (ADR-0021). In the diagrams :videoId stands for the path variable {videoId}.

docs.title: 1. Record a watch (view reported) and save resume position
docs.text:
A logged-in user plays a video. After 3 s of real, visible playback VideoPlayer.jsx calls the public view endpoint, which also upserts the history row. Later the player sends the resume point (update-only) on a 30 s tick (at most every 10 s), on pause, on end, on tab hidden, and on slide switch or unmount. The history write is best effort: a failure is logged and the view still returns 204.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (VideoPlayer.jsx)
    participant VC as VideoViewController
    participant VV as VideoViewService
    participant WC as WatchHistoryController
    participant WS as WatchHistoryServiceImpl
    participant US as UserSettingsRepository
    participant WR as WatchHistoryRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: plays video (3 s of real playback)
    FE->>VC: POST /v1/funny-app/videos/:videoId/view (viewsApi.record)
    VC->>VV: recordView(videoId, viewerKey)
    VV-->>VC: counted once per viewer per video per 30 min
    VC->>VC: recordHistory(videoId) - skipped for guests (no user id)
    VC->>WS: recordWatch(userId, videoId)
    WS->>US: findById(userId) - isIncognito
    US-->>WS: UserSettings or empty
    alt incognitoEnabled is true
        WS-->>VC: return, nothing written
    else not incognito
        WS->>WR: upsertWatched(userId, videoId)
        WR->>DB: INSERT SELECT FROM video_sources (PUBLISHED, not hidden) ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE watched_at
        DB-->>WR: rows affected (0 if video unknown or not public)
        opt rows affected greater than 0
            WS->>WR: trimToCap(userId, app.watch-history.max-entries = 500)
            WR->>DB: DELETE rows beyond the newest 500
        end
    end
    VC-->>FE: 204 No Content
    FE->>FE: invalidateQueries watchHistory (logged in only)

    loop while playing (30 s tick, at most every 10 s) and on pause, end, tab hidden, slide change, unmount
        FE->>FE: reportProgress(videoId) - only if view already sent and logged in
        FE->>WC: PUT /v1/funny-app/watch-history/:videoId/progress with positionSec and durationSec (keepalive, rate limit 120)
        WC->>WS: saveProgress(userId, videoId, positionSec, durationSec)
        alt value null, negative or not finite, or incognito
            WS-->>WC: return silently
        else valid
            WS->>WR: updateProgress(userId, videoId, pos, dur)
            WR->>DB: UPDATE watch_history SET position_sec, duration_sec (update-only, never inserts)
        end
        WC-->>FE: 204 No Content
    end

docs.title: 2. Browse, search, resume and manage history (History tab)
docs.text:
The user opens History, then the "Lich su xem" tab (WatchHistorySection.jsx). The list is newest first, grouped by day on the client, with a debounced title search (300 ms) and "load more" paging (page size 20). Clicking a card plays the video at the saved position unless it is completed.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (WatchHistorySection.jsx)
    participant HK as useWatchHistory.js (React Query)
    participant API as WatchHistoryController
    participant S as WatchHistoryServiceImpl
    participant R as WatchHistoryRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    U->>FE: opens History tab, types a search term
    FE->>HK: useWatchHistoryInfinite(q) after 300 ms debounce
    HK->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/watch-history?q=...&page=0&size=20 (rate limit 60)
    API->>API: currentUserId() from JWT (401 error.auth.required if missing)
    API->>S: list(userId, q, page, size)
    S->>S: clamp size to 1..50, trim q to 100 chars, escape LIKE wildcards
    S->>R: findPage(userId, pattern, PageRequest)
    R->>DB: SELECT join watch_history and video_sources (PUBLISHED, not hidden) ORDER BY watched_at DESC
    DB-->>R: page of HistoryRow
    R-->>S: Page of HistoryRow
    S-->>API: Page of WatchHistoryItemDto (completed = 90 percent or within 10 s of end)
    API-->>HK: 200 ResultObjectInfo with Page
    HK-->>FE: groups Today, Yesterday, Earlier
    U->>FE: clicks Load more
    FE->>HK: fetchNextPage
    HK->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/watch-history?page=1&size=20
    API-->>HK: 200 next page
    U->>FE: clicks a card
    FE->>FE: onPlayVideo(videoId, startAt = positionSec, or 0 when completed)
    Note over FE: VideoPlayer seeks only if startAt is over 5 s and not near the end

    alt remove one entry
        U->>FE: clicks remove on a card
        FE->>API: DELETE /v1/funny-app/watch-history/:videoId (useRemoveWatchEntry, rate limit 20)
        API->>S: remove(userId, videoId)
        S->>R: deleteOne(userId, videoId)
        R->>DB: DELETE one row (idempotent)
        API-->>FE: 204 No Content
        FE->>HK: invalidateQueries watchHistory
    else clear all
        U->>FE: clicks Clear all and confirms in dialog
        FE->>API: DELETE /v1/funny-app/watch-history (useClearWatchHistory, rate limit 20)
        API->>S: clear(userId)
        S->>R: deleteAll(userId)
        R->>DB: DELETE all rows of the user
        API-->>FE: 204 No Content
        FE->>HK: invalidateQueries watchHistory
    end

docs.title: 3. Pause history (incognito switch) and its effect
docs.text:
The "Tam dung lich su" switch on the History tab is the same flag as Settings, Incognito: user_settings.incognito_enabled (PRD OQ-4, one flag). While it is on, recordWatch and saveProgress return without writing. Existing entries stay visible and can still be removed.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant FE as Browser (WatchHistorySection.jsx)
    participant HK as useSettings.js
    participant SC as UserSettingsController
    participant SS as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant SR as UserSettingsRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant WS as WatchHistoryServiceImpl

    U->>FE: toggles Pause history
    FE->>HK: useUpdateSettings.mutate incognitoEnabled = true
    HK->>SC: PATCH /v1/funny-app/user/settings (JWT)
    SC->>SS: updateSettings(request)
    SS->>SR: findById(userId) or create defaults
    SS->>SR: save(settings with incognitoEnabled)
    SR->>DB: UPDATE user_settings
    SC-->>HK: 200 ResultObjectInfo with UserSettingsDto
    HK->>FE: setQueryData settings, then invalidateQueries settings
    FE-->>U: paused banner shown

    Note over U,WS: later, while paused
    U->>FE: watches a video
    FE->>WS: POST /view then PUT /watch-history/:videoId/progress
    WS->>SR: findById(userId) - isIncognito
    SR-->>WS: incognitoEnabled true
    WS-->>FE: 204, no insert and no update

docs.title: 4. Watched badges (summary) in feed and Explore
docs.text:
WatchedBadge.jsx uses useWatchHistorySummary(): one shared request (query key watchHistory, summary, stale time 60 s), only for logged-in users. Guests get an empty map and no request.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (WatchedBadge.jsx)
    participant HK as useWatchHistorySummary
    participant API as WatchHistoryController
    participant S as WatchHistoryServiceImpl
    participant R as WatchHistoryRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    FE->>HK: render badge for videoId
    alt guest (not logged in)
        HK-->>FE: empty Map, no request
    else logged in
        HK->>API: GET /v1/funny-app/watch-history/summary (rate limit 30)
        API->>S: summary(userId)
        S->>R: findSummary(userId, 500)
        R->>DB: SELECT video_id, position_sec, duration_sec ORDER BY watched_at DESC LIMIT 500
        DB-->>R: SummaryRow list
        S-->>API: list of WatchSummaryDto with completed flag
        API-->>HK: 200 ResultListInfo
        HK-->>FE: Map videoId to progress
        FE-->>FE: shows Watched badge or progress line
    end

docs.title: 5. Account deletion clears history
docs.text:
Soft-deleting the account (see sequence-user-settings) also removes all watch history rows.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant FE as Browser (DeleteAccountModal.jsx)
    participant SC as UserSettingsController
    participant SS as UserSettingsServiceImpl
    participant WR as WatchHistoryRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    FE->>SC: DELETE /v1/funny-app/user/account (after step-up check)
    SC->>SS: deleteAccount(request)
    SS->>DB: save user as DEACTIVATED and anonymized
    SS->>WR: deleteAll(userId)
    WR->>DB: DELETE FROM watch_history WHERE user_id
    SC-->>FE: 204 No Content

docs.title: Notes: PRD vs code
docs.text:
• PUT /watch-history/:videoId/progress is update-only and is only sent after the view has counted (viewSentRef), so a row always exists first.
  • POST /videos/:videoId/view is public. The history write is skipped for guests inside VideoViewController.recordHistory and never fails the view.
  • The history cap is configurable (app.watch-history.max-entries, env WATCH_HISTORY_MAX_ENTRIES, default 500), while the summary limit is a fixed 500 (WatchHistoryServiceImpl.SUMMARY_LIMIT).
  • List and search hide videos that are hidden or not PUBLISHED, but the summary query does not join video_sources, so those rows can still appear in the badge map.

docs.title: Feature Specifications
docs.text: Feature Specs define the exact behavior, API contract, and acceptance criteria for each feature.

docs.title: What is a Spec?
docs.text: A Spec is the bridge between an ADR (architectural decision) and a Plan (task breakdown). A developer can read a Spec and implement immediately — no ambiguity, no guesswork.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text: PRD → ADR → Spec → Plan → Implementation

docs.title: How to create a Spec
docs.text:
/spec docs/prd/PRD-{slug}.md docs/adr/NNNN-{slug}.md

Claude reads the PRD and ADR, asks clarifying questions one at a time (business rules, error cases, edge cases, performance targets), then writes the Spec.

docs.text: Feature File Status Watch History spec-watch-history.md 📋 Draft Bitwise Permissions spec-bitwise-permissions.md ✅ Implemented

docs.title: Metadata
docs.text:
Status: Implemented Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-06-02 Related PRD: N/A Related ADR: ADR-0015: Bitwise Permission System Related Plan: plan-permissions-bitwise

Documented retroactively (AS-BUILT) for tracking. Describes the behavior actually shipped.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The system provides fine-grained, method-level authorization on top of the existing role guard. Each capability is a single bit in a 32-bit mask; a user's granted capabilities are stored as one int column. Endpoints declare a required capability with @HasPermission(perm = Permission.X), and access is granted only when the user's bitmask contains that bit. Enforcement is gated by a feature flag and is permissive (no-op) by default.

docs.title: Rule 1
docs.text: A Permission is one bit: READ=1, WRITE=2, EXEC=4, DELETE=8, ADMIN=16 (1 << n). The permissions table seed (code, bit_value) must match the Permission enum exactly.

docs.title: Rule 2
docs.text: A user's granted permissions are a single int bitmask stored in users.permissions, defaulting to 0 (no permissions).

docs.title: Rule 3
docs.text: A single-permission check (hasPermission) grants access when (userBits & perm.bit) != 0.

docs.title: Rule 4
docs.text: When the feature flag permission_enforcement_enabled is OFF (the default), all permission checks return true — only the class-level role guard (hasRole('ADMIN')) applies. The permission layer is additive and never weakens an existing guard.

docs.title: Rule 5
docs.text: If the Harness FF backend is unreachable or the API key is blank, the flag resolves to its default (false) — the application continues to function with role-only authorization.

docs.title: FR-1: Declarative method guard
docs.text: The system must provide a @HasPermission(perm = Permission.X) annotation usable on a controller method or type. It is a meta-annotation over @PreAuthorize that calls permissionServiceImpl.hasPermission(principal.permissions, perm).

docs.title: FR-2: Permission resolution in SpEL
docs.text: authentication.principal.permissions must resolve to the user's int bitmask, and the bare enum identifier (e.g. ADMIN) in the expanded template expression must resolve to the corresponding Permission constant.

docs.title: FR-3: Single-permission check
docs.text: PermissionService.hasPermission(int userBits, Permission perm) must return true iff the flag is enforced AND (userBits & perm.getBit()) != 0. When the flag is off, it returns true unconditionally.

docs.title: FR-4: Multi-permission checks (available, not yet wired to annotation)
docs.text: hasAllPermissions(int, Permission[]) (AND) and hasAnyPermission(int, Permission[]) (OR) must be available on PermissionService for future use. Both short-circuit to true when the flag is off.

docs.title: FR-5: Principal carries permissions
docs.text: UserServiceImpl.loadUserByUsername() must return an AppUserDetails that wraps the User entity and exposes int getPermissions() and Long getId().

docs.title: FR-6: Feature-flag gate
docs.text: FeatureFlagService.isEnabled(String flag, boolean defaultValue) gates enforcement. PermissionServiceImpl must consult permission_enforcement_enabled (default false) before performing any bitwise check.

docs.title: FR-7: Demo enforcement
docs.text: GET /admin/stats must be annotated @HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN) to validate the path end-to-end.

docs.title: Backend
docs.text: Component File Role Permission enum enums/Permission.java Source of truth — bit per capability (int, 1 << n) @HasPermission aop/HasPermission.java Meta-@PreAuthorize; Permission perm() PermissionService / Impl service/PermissionService.java, service/impl/PermissionServiceImpl.java hasPermission / hasAllPermissions / hasAnyPermission; flag short-circuit AppUserDetails config/AppUserDetails.java Custom UserDetails exposing getPermissions() / getId() WebSecurityConfig filter/WebSecurityConfig.java AnnotationTemplateExpressionDefaults + PermissionEnumPropertyAccessor on a custom MethodSecurityExpressionHandler; @EnableMethodSecurity FeatureFlagService / Impl service/FeatureFlagService.java, service/impl/FeatureFlagServiceImpl.java Harness FF wrapper; no-op when key blank AppConstant.Flags utils/AppConstant.java PERMISSION_ENFORCEMENT flag key

docs.title: Annotation contract
docs.text:
@HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN)
public ResponseEntity<...> getStats() { ... }

Expands (via AnnotationTemplateExpressionDefaults) to:

@PreAuthorize("@permissionServiceImpl.hasPermission(authentication.principal.permissions, ADMIN)")

PermissionEnumPropertyAccessor.read(...) maps the bare ADMIN → Permission.ADMIN so SpEL can pass it to hasPermission.

docs.title: GET /admin/stats
docs.text:
Change: Added @HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN) (in addition to the existing class-level hasRole('ADMIN') guard).

Behavior:

Flag User bitmask has ADMIN bit (16)? Result OFF (default) — Allowed (role guard only) ON Yes Allowed ON No 403 Forbidden (AccessDeniedException)

No request/response body change. No new public endpoints introduced by this feature.

docs.title: Database Changes
docs.text:
-- Migration: db/changelog/sql/202605010001-init_permissions.sql

CREATE TABLE permissions (
    id          INT PRIMARY KEY,
    code        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    bit_value   INT          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    group_name  VARCHAR(50),
    is_active   BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP             DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO permissions (id, code, name, bit_value, description, group_name) VALUES
  (1, 'READ',   'Read',   1,  'Read data',         'GENERAL'),
  (2, 'WRITE',  'Write',  2,  'Modify data',       'GENERAL'),
  (3, 'EXEC',   'Exec',   4,  'Execute actions',   'GENERAL'),
  (4, 'DELETE', 'Delete', 8,  'Delete data',       'GENERAL'),
  (5, 'ADMIN',  'Admin',  16, 'Full admin access', 'ADMIN');

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN permissions INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

users.permissions is an additive INT column; existing rows default to 0.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Key Source Default Purpose harness.ff.api-key application.yaml ← ${FF_API_KEY:} empty Harness FF SDK key; blank ⇒ FeatureFlagService is a no-op permission_enforcement_enabled Harness FF false Master switch for bitwise enforcement

New dependency: io.harness:ff-java-server-sdk.

docs.title: Security Requirements
docs.text:
• Additive only: The permission layer must never weaken the existing class-level hasRole('ADMIN') guard. With the flag off, authorization behavior is identical to before.
  • Principal source: Permission bits come from the authenticated AppUserDetails, populated at loadUserByUsername() — never from request input.
  • Fail-safe default: Unreachable flag backend ⇒ false ⇒ role-only authorization (no lockout, no silent allow of newly-guarded endpoints since enforcement simply stays off).
  • No secrets in code: FF_API_KEY is supplied via environment, not hardcoded.

docs.title: EC-1: User with permissions = 0, flag ON, accesses @HasPermission(perm = ADMIN) endpoint
docs.text: (0 & 16) == 0 → denied → 403. (Role guard may still allow if it is the only annotation; here both apply, the stricter wins.)

docs.title: EC-2: Flag OFF
docs.text: hasPermission returns true immediately; bitwise check never runs. Logged as "permission check skipped (flag off)".

docs.title: EC-3: Harness key blank (local/test)
docs.text: FeatureFlagServiceImpl is a no-op and returns the supplied default (false). App runs without a flag backend.

docs.title: EC-4: Bare enum name not a valid Permission
docs.text: PermissionEnumPropertyAccessor.canRead returns false (catches IllegalArgumentException) → SpEL falls through; only valid Permission names resolve.

docs.title: EC-5: Multiple bits set (e.g. user has READ|WRITE|ADMIN = 19)
docs.text: 19 & 16 = 16 ≠ 0 → ADMIN check passes; unrelated bits do not interfere.

docs.title: Acceptance Criteria
docs.text:
• [x] SQL seed bit_value matches Permission enum exactly
  • [x] Permission enum uses int with 1 << n
  • [x] PermissionService/Impl use int for all permission params
  • [x] User.java has an int permissions field mapped to the permissions column
  • [x] AppUserDetails wraps User and exposes int getPermissions()
  • [x] loadUserByUsername() returns AppUserDetails
  • [x] authentication.principal.permissions resolves in SpEL
  • [x] Permission.ADMIN resolves to the enum constant via PermissionEnumPropertyAccessor
  • [x] @HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN) enforces access on getStats() when flag ON
  • [x] Flag OFF → all checks return true; existing role guard unaffected
  • [x] FF backend unreachable / key blank → defaults to false, app functions
  • [x] ./unittest.sh / mvn verify passes

docs.title: Open Questions
docs.text:
• [ ] Resolved: int vs long → int (32 bits, ADR-0015 D1)
  • [ ] Resolved: array vs single perm on annotation → single perm (ADR-0015 D3); array service methods retained for future
  • [ ] Future: wire hasAllPermissions / hasAnyPermission to a multi-permission annotation variant if an endpoint needs AND/OR semantics

docs.title: Feature Specification: Contributor Role and Autopilot Permissions for Reports
Metadata
docs.text: Status: Implemented (2026-10-23) Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-23 Related PRD: PRD-contributor-autopilot-permissions Related ADR: ADR-0030 (amends ADR-0026) Sequence diagrams: sequence-contributor-autopilot-permissions

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The system gets a new role, CONTRIBUTOR, that can use only the in-app Report. It also gets two permission bits that the SUPER_ADMIN grants per account (CONTRIBUTOR or ADMIN). These bits let the holder put autopilot:auto-merge or autopilot:auto on the GitHub issue a report creates. Every rule is enforced in the server against the user row in the DB. The headless autopilot workflow is unchanged.

docs.title: BR-1: Role rank
docs.text: UserRole order becomes USER < CONTRIBUTOR < ADMIN < SUPER_ADMIN. CONTRIBUTOR.defaultPermissions() is 0.

docs.title: BR-2: Contributor access
docs.text: A CONTRIBUTOR may call only the three report endpoints (create, list, retry) under /v1/funny-app/admin/reports. Every other /v1/funny-app/admin/** endpoint returns 403 to a CONTRIBUTOR.

docs.title: BR-3: Who may assign CONTRIBUTOR
docs.text: The SUPER_ADMIN and ADMINs may set a USER to CONTRIBUTOR and a CONTRIBUTOR to USER. This follows the existing rank rule: the actor must outrank both the target's current role and the new role (AdminAccountServiceImpl.java:46,105).

docs.title: BR-4: Autopilot bits
docs.text: AUTOPILOT_AUTO_MERGE = 1 << 5 (32) and AUTOPILOT_AUTO = 1 << 6 (64). They are not part of ALL_BITS (stays 0b11111 = 31). AUTOPILOT_BITS = 32 | 64 = 96. A valid mask is a subset of ALL_BITS | AUTOPILOT_BITS (127).

docs.title: BR-5: Who may change autopilot bits
docs.text: Only the SUPER_ADMIN. When a non-SUPER_ADMIN calls PATCH /admin/accounts/{id}/permissions with a mask whose AUTOPILOT_BITS differ from the target's current ones, the call gets 403. Changes to the other five bits follow today's rules.

docs.title: BR-6: Which accounts may hold autopilot bits
docs.text: Only CONTRIBUTOR and ADMIN accounts. Setting any autopilot bit on a USER returns 400. The bits on the SUPER_ADMIN account are never read (BR-8). No migration and no default grants them.

docs.title: BR-7: Role change
docs.text:
updateRole sets role.defaultPermissions(), then:

  • if the new role is CONTRIBUTOR or ADMIN, ORs back the target's previous AUTOPILOT_BITS;
  • if the new role is USER, the autopilot bits are cleared.

Session revocation (credentials_version + 1) is unchanged.

docs.title: BR-8: Allowed auto labels
docs.text:
Caller AUTO_MERGE AUTO SUPER_ADMIN yes yes has AUTOPILOT_AUTO yes yes has only AUTOPILOT_AUTO_MERGE yes no no autopilot bit no no

The caller's bits are read from the user row loaded by currentUser(), never from the JWT and never through @HasPermission.

docs.title: BR-9: Create with a label the caller may not use
docs.text: POST /admin/reports with an autoLabel not allowed by BR-8 returns 403 error.report.autoLabelForbidden, and no row is saved.

docs.title: BR-10: Retry downgrades, never refuses, on labels
docs.text:
A retry applies the stored auto_label capped to what the current caller may use (BR-8):

  • AUTO falls to AUTO_MERGE when the caller holds only AUTOPILOT_AUTO_MERGE;
  • any label falls to none when the caller holds no autopilot bit.

A retry is never refused because of the label. The stored auto_label is not changed; only the issue labels reflect the downgrade.

docs.title: BR-11: Shared daily cap
docs.text: At most 10 reports with autopilot from non-SUPER_ADMIN reporters (ADMIN and CONTRIBUTOR together) in a rolling 24 h. The count is of rows with status = 'CREATED' AND autopilot AND reporter_role IN ('ADMIN','CONTRIBUTOR') and created_at within the window. Over the cap, the issue is created with the type label only: no autopilot, no auto label. SUPER_ADMIN reports are never capped.

docs.title: BR-12: Issue body role line
docs.text: "Reported in-app by" is followed by the SUPER_ADMIN, an ADMIN or a CONTRIBUTOR, from the stored reporter_role. Still no email, user name or id.

docs.title: BR-13: Report list
docs.text: Every caller allowed on the endpoint (CONTRIBUTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN) sees every report, as today.

docs.title: BR-14: Report-closed notification
docs.text: A CONTRIBUTOR gets REPORT_CLOSED for their own reports, as an ADMIN does today, and sees it under the Admin tab of the notification dropdown. A click opens the Report page.

docs.title: FR-1: Role enum
docs.text: UserRole must declare USER, CONTRIBUTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN in that order. roleHierarchy() must derive ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_CONTRIBUTOR > ROLE_USER from it with no hand-written change. Nothing may persist or compare ordinal().

docs.title: FR-2: Security matchers
docs.text: WebSecurityConfig.securityFilterChain must register /v1/funny-app/admin/reports/** with hasAnyRole("CONTRIBUTOR","ADMIN","SUPER_ADMIN") before /v1/funny-app/admin/** with hasAnyRole("ADMIN","SUPER_ADMIN"). The bare path /v1/funny-app/admin/reports must be covered too, because /** already matches it in Spring's PathPattern.

docs.title: FR-3: Report controller
docs.text: AdminReportController must use @PreAuthorize("hasRole('CONTRIBUTOR')") at class level and must drop @HasPermission(perm = Permission.ADMIN) from create, list and retry (owner decision, 2026-10-23). @AuditLog and @RateLimited stay as they are: 5/h for create and retry, 60/min for list.

docs.title: FR-4: Permission enum
docs.text: Permission must add AUTOPILOT_AUTO_MERGE(1 << 5) and AUTOPILOT_AUTO(1 << 6), keep ALL_BITS = 0b11111, and add AUTOPILOT_BITS = 0b1100000. A helper Permission.allowsAutoLabel(int mask, ReportAutoLabel label) must implement BR-8 for non-SA callers.

docs.title: FR-5: Account service
docs.text:
AdminAccountServiceImpl must:

  • updatePermissions: reject bits outside ALL_BITS | AUTOPILOT_BITS (400, as today), reject an autopilot change by a non-SUPER_ADMIN (403, BR-5), and reject any autopilot bit on a USER target (400, BR-6);
  • updateRole: apply BR-7.

docs.title: FR-6: Report service
docs.text:
ReportServiceImpl must:

  • create: replace the SUPER_ADMIN-only check (ReportServiceImpl.java:103) with BR-8/BR-9;
  • callGitHub: replace callerRole == SUPER_ADMIN ? row.getAutoLabel() : null (:163) with the BR-10 cap, passing the caller's User (role + permissions) instead of only the role;
  • isCapped: count with BR-11 (repository method takes a collection of roles).

docs.title: FR-7: Repository
docs.text: AppReportRepository must replace countByStatusAndAutopilotTrueAndReporterRoleAndCreatedAtAfter(status, role, since) with countByStatusAndAutopilotTrueAndReporterRoleInAndCreatedAtAfter(status, Collection<UserRole> roles, since).

docs.title: FR-8: Issue content
docs.text: ReportIssueContent.body must render BR-12.

docs.title: FR-9: Notifications
docs.text: No backend change: REPORT_CLOSED already goes to the reporter by id. Frontend: the Admin tab and notificationNav(n, …) must use "can report" (CONTRIBUTOR or above) instead of isAdmin for REPORT_CLOSED (BR-14).

docs.title: FR-10: Messages
docs.text: error.report.autoLabelForbidden text changes in messages.properties and messages_vi.properties (see API Changes).

docs.title: New Endpoints
docs.text: None.

docs.title: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports
docs.text:
Change: CONTRIBUTOR may call it. autoLabel is checked against the caller's bits (BR-8) instead of the SUPER_ADMIN role. The request and response bodies are unchanged.

Auth: Required (JWT). Role CONTRIBUTOR or above. No permission bit needed. Rate limit: 5 per hour per user (unchanged)

Request (unchanged)

{
  "type": "BUG",
  "title": "Player stalls on seek",
  "description": "…",
  "autoLabel": "AUTO_MERGE",
  "context": { "page": "explore", "path": "/explore", "appVersion": "1.4.2", "userAgent": "…", "screenWidth": 390 }
}

Response — Success (unchanged shape)

{
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "data": {
    "id": "6f1c…",
    "type": "BUG",
    "title": "Player stalls on seek",
    "status": "CREATED",
    "issueNumber": 71,

docs.title: Feature Specification: HLS Streaming for Selected Videos
Metadata
docs.text: Status: Approved Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-24 Related PRD: PRD-hls-streaming Related ADR: ADR-0031 Sequence diagrams: sequence-hls-streaming

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
• Opt-in per video: the SUPER_ADMIN turns HLS on or off for one Drive video at a time.
  • Transcoding: an in-process worker stream-copies the video's .full file into video-cache/hls/{fileId}/, one job at a time.
  • Playback:
    • Video DTOs carry hlsUrl only when the Harness flag hls_streaming_enabled is on and the rendition is READY.
    • The player uses hlsUrl when it is set and falls back to the existing Range URL (embedLink) on any failure.
    • Range playback, the Guava cache and the download paths keep working as today.

docs.title: BR-1: Drive videos only
docs.text:
• HLS can be turned on only for VideoSource rows with source_type = 'google_drive'.
  • Every other row keeps hls_status = NONE and its admin DTO shows hlsStatus = null.

docs.title: BR-2: SUPER_ADMIN only
docs.text:
• Only the SUPER_ADMIN can turn HLS on or off.
  • ADMIN can see the status but cannot change it.

docs.title: BR-3: Status machine
docs.text:
hls_status moves only along these edges. Any other change is a bug.

From To Trigger NONE, ERROR PENDING PUT (turn on / retry) PENDING PROCESSING Worker claims the job (atomic UPDATE … WHERE hls_status = 'PENDING') PROCESSING READY FFmpeg exit 0, playlist exists, temp directory renamed PROCESSING ERROR Any failure listed in BR-9 PROCESSING PENDING Startup recovery (BR-11) READY, ERROR PENDING .full replaced by a new download (BR-10) READY ERROR Startup check finds the output directory missing (BR-11) any NONE DELETE (turn off)

docs.title: BR-4: One job at a time
docs.text:
• At most one FFmpeg or ffprobe process runs at any moment (Semaphore(1)).
  • Jobs are taken oldest first, ordered by updated_at.

docs.title: BR-5: Codec allowlist
docs.text:
• ffprobe must report video codec h264.
  • Audio must be aac or mp3, or there must be no audio stream.
  • Anything else ends the job with UNSUPPORTED_CODEC. No re-encoding is done.

docs.title: BR-6: Disk guard
docs.text:
• Before FFmpeg starts, the usable space on the video-cache file store must be at least size(.full) + app.hls.min-free-disk-bytes. The default reserve is 1 GB.
  • If it is lower, the job ends with DISK_FULL.

docs.title: BR-7: Output and timeout
docs.text:
• FFmpeg runs with -c copy -f hls -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod -hls_segment_filename seg_%d.ts and writes into video-cache/hls/{fileId}.tmp/.
  • The job is READY only after all of these:
    • FFmpeg exits 0;
    • playlist.m3u8 exists;
    • the directory has been renamed to video-cache/hls/{fileId}/.
  • A run longer than app.hls.timeout (default 10 min) is killed and ends with TIMEOUT.

docs.title: BR-8: hlsUrl offer rule
docs.text:
• hlsUrl is set when both hold:
    • FeatureFlagService.isEnabled("hls_streaming_enabled", false) is true;
    • hls_status = READY.
  • Otherwise it is null.
  • The flag is read once per request.
  • The rule applies to every place that builds a feed-shaped DTO (Converter.toVideoDto): the feed list, video detail and public collection videos.

docs.title: BR-9: Error codes
docs.text:
hls_error holds one of these codes. It is null unless the status is ERROR.

Code Condition SOURCE_MISSING video-cache/{fileId}.full does not exist when the job starts FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND ffprobe or ffmpeg cannot be started UNSUPPORTED_CODEC BR-5 fails DISK_FULL BR-6 fails TIMEOUT BR-7 timeout FFMPEG_FAILED Non-zero exit code, or no playlist after exit 0 OUTPUT_MISSING Startup check: READY but the directory is gone

docs.title: BR-10: Source replaced
docs.text:
When DriveVideoDownloaderImpl writes a new .full, still holding the file lock, it:

  • always deletes video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ if it exists;
  • if the status was READY or ERROR, sets it to PENDING and wakes the worker.

docs.title: BR-11: Startup recovery
docs.text:
On ApplicationReadyEvent, the worker:

  1. sets every PROCESSING row to PENDING;
  2. deletes every video-cache/hls/*.tmp/ directory;
  3. sets every READY row whose directory is missing to ERROR OUTPUT_MISSING;
  4. deletes every video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ directory whose row is missing or not READY (orphans left by a DELETE that ran while a download held the lock);
  5. then wakes up.

docs.title: BR-12: Cleanup
docs.text:
video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ is deleted in each of these cases:

  • DELETE on the HLS endpoint;
  • admin video delete (AdminVideoServiceImpl.deleteVideo, always, whatever the deleteLocalFile flag);
  • BR-10.

The deletion runs under DriveFileLocks. The .full file is touched only by the existing delete-local-file option.

docs.title: BR-13: Public serving
docs.text:
• Playlist: served only when all of these hold:
    • status READY;
    • video PUBLISHED;
    • video not hidden;
    • the file exists.
  • Segment: served when the name is valid and the file exists in the READY directory. There is no DB lookup per segment.

docs.title: FR-1: Schema
docs.text: video_sources must get the columns hls_status and hls_error (see Database Changes). The VideoSource entity must map them with a new HlsStatus enum.

docs.title: FR-2: Admin toggle endpoints
docs.text:
The system must expose PUT and DELETE /v1/funny-app/admin/videos/{id}/hls, as described in API Changes.

  • Both are idempotent.
  • Both are annotated with @AuditLog("enableVideoHls") and @AuditLog("disableVideoHls").
  • A PUT that sets PENDING must call HlsTranscodeWorker.wakeUp().

docs.title: FR-3: Worker
docs.text:
HlsTranscodeWorker must follow VideoImportWorker:

  • wakeUp() on a virtual thread;
  • a @Scheduled(cron = "0 */5 * * * *") poll;
  • startup recovery (BR-11);
  • Semaphore(1).

For each job it must take these steps in this order:

  1. claim the file lock in DriveFileLocks; if the file is busy, leave the job PENDING;
  2. claim the DB row;
  3. check that the source exists;
  4. run ffprobe;
  5. run the disk guard;
  6. run FFmpeg;
  7. re-read the status;
  8. publish, or clean up;
  9. release the lock.

Every command must be built with ProcessBuilder(List<String>), never a shell string. fileId must pass the existing safe-id check before any path is built.

docs.title: FR-4: Publish guard
docs.text:
After FFmpeg exits, the worker must re-read the row.

  • If the status is no longer PROCESSING (the owner turned it off, or the video was deleted), it must delete the temp directory and not publish.
  • It must never overwrite NONE with READY.

docs.title: FR-5: Public HLS endpoints
docs.text:
VideoStreamController must serve the playlist and the segments (see API Changes). It must:

  • validate path variables before touching the file system;
  • check that the resolved path stays inside video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ (CWE-22).

docs.title: FR-6: DTO field
docs.text:
• VideoDto must get hlsUrl (String, nullable).
  • The value is https://canh-labs.com/api/v1/funny-app/video-stream/hls/{fileId}/playlist.m3u8, the same host and prefix as embedLink, built in Converter.
  • Converter.toVideoDto must take the request's flag value as a parameter. It must not read the flag itself, per video.

docs.title: FR-7: Admin DTO
docs.text: AdminVideoDto must get hlsStatus (HlsStatus, null for non-Drive videos) and hlsError (String).

docs.title: FR-8: Source replaced hook
docs.text: DriveVideoDownloaderImpl must apply BR-10 after it moves a new .full into place. This covers both the scheduler and the force sync, because both go through it.

docs.title: FR-9: Player
docs.text:
VideoPlayer must keep its single <video> element.

  • When video.hlsUrl is set:
    • If canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl') is non-empty (Safari/iOS), it sets src = hlsUrl.
    • Otherwise, it loads hls.js with import('hls.js'), checks Hls.isSupported(), and attaches it.
    • If HLS is not supported, it uses the Range URL.
  • On a fatal HLS error, or a native error event while on HLS: it destroys the instance, sets src to the Range URL, and on loadedmetadata restores the last currentTime and the play state.
  • It destroys the instance on unmount and whenever the video changes.
  • Resume (startAt), view counting and watch-history progress keep using the same element, with no other change.

docs.title: FR-10: Swiper preload
docs.text:
VideoSwiper must not render the hidden Range preload <video> for upcoming videos that have hlsUrl.

Assumption: preloading the .full bytes for an HLS video wastes bandwidth. hls.js starts quickly enough from the playlist.

docs.title: FR-11: Admin table
docs.text:
AdminVideoTable must add an HLS column for Drive videos:

  • a status badge (NONE, PENDING, PROCESSING, READY, ERROR);
  • the localized error reason as a tooltip on ERROR;
  • for the SUPER_ADMIN only (isSuperAdmin(role)), a toggle (on = PUT, off = DELETE).

While any row on the page is PENDING or PROCESSING, the admin videos query refetches every 5 s.

docs.title: FR-12: Config
docs.text:
AppProperties must get an Hls section:

  • app.hls.min-free-disk-bytes, default 1073741824;
  • app.hls.timeout, default 10m.

Both are bound in application.yaml with env overrides HLS_MIN_FREE_DISK_BYTES and HLS_TIMEOUT.

docs.title: FR-13: Tech strategy
docs.text: Add hls.js (exact version pinned in webapp/package.json) to the JavaScript table in .claude/rules/tech-strategy.md, citing ADR-0031.

docs.title: PUT /v1/funny-app/admin/videos/{id}/hls
docs.text:
Auth JWT; @PreAuthorize("hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN') and @permissionServiceImpl.hasPermission(authentication.details.permissions, ADMIN)") (same as AdminDriveSyncController.java:55) Body none Effect NONE or ERROR → PENDING (clears hls_error) and wakes the worker. PENDING, PROCESSING or READY → no change

Response 200: 

{ "status": "SUCCESS", "data": { "id": 42, "hlsStatus": "PENDING", "hlsError": null } }

Status Code Condition 400 error.hls.notDriveVideo The row's source_type is not google_drive 401 — No or invalid JWT 403 — Caller is not SUPER_ADMIN, or lacks the ADMIN bit while enforcement is on 404 error.video.notFound No video_sources row with this id (CustomException with NOT_FOUND)

docs.text:
Auth Same as PUT Effect Any status → NONE, hls_error = null. If DriveFileLocks.tryClaim(fileId) succeeds, deletes video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ and releases the lock. If the lock is held, the holder cleans up: a running job discards its output (FR-4), and a running download deletes the directory (BR-10). A running job is not killed

Response 200: { "status": "SUCCESS", "data": { "id": 42, "hlsStatus": "NONE", "hlsError": null } }

Status Code Condition 400 error.hls.notDriveVideo Not a Drive video 401 / 403 — As for PUT 404 error.video.notFound Unknown id

docs.title: Modified Tables
docs.text:
api/src/main/resources/db/changelog/sql/202610240001-video-source-hls.sql (picked up by includeAll):

-- HLS rendition state per video (ADR-0031). NONE until the SUPER_ADMIN turns HLS on.
ALTER TABLE video_sources
    ADD COLUMN hls_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE',
    ADD COLUMN hls_error  VARCHAR(40);

ALTER TABLE video_sources
    ADD CONSTRAINT chk_video_sources_hls_status
        CHECK (hls_status IN ('NONE', 'PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'READY', 'ERROR'));

-- Worker queue lookups touch only the few in-flight rows.
CREATE INDEX idx_video_sources_hls_queue
    ON video_sources (updated_at)
    WHERE hls_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING');

The ALTER TABLE with a constant default is a metadata-only change in PostgreSQL 11+ (no table rewrite).

docs.title: Authentication

• The toggle endpoints need a valid JWT.

docs.title: Authorization

  • GET /admin/videos keeps its ADMIN+ access.

docs.title: Data Validation
docs.text:
• fileId must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$ and segment must match ^seg_\d{1,5}\.ts$.
  • After resolving, the path must still start with the normalized video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ (CWE-22).
  • FFmpeg and ffprobe arguments are a fixed list; only the validated path is inserted (CWE-78).
  • Toggles are written to the audit log (@AuditLog).

docs.title: Caching Impact

HLS requests do not record cache hits or misses HTTP / browser Segments are immutable for a year. The playlist uses no-cache, so a re-transcode (BR-10) is picked up Harness SDK The flag is evaluated through the SDK's local cache, with no network call per request

docs.title: Domain Events
docs.text: None. The worker is woken by a direct wakeUp() call from the admin service and the downloader.

docs.title: Scheduled Jobs
docs.text: Job Schedule Behaviour HlsTranscodeWorker.poll() 0 */5 * * * * Drains PENDING jobs one by one (BR-4). It is a fallback for a missed wakeUp() or a job left PENDING because its file was locked HlsTranscodeWorker.onApplicationReady() Once at startup BR-11 recovery, then wakeUp()

docs.title: Performance
docs.text: Operation Target Transcode, 500 MB H.264 on the prod VM < 30 s end to end (probe + guard + copy + rename) Playlist request p95 < 50 ms (one indexed row read + static file) Segment request, time to first byte p95 < 50 ms (static file, no DB) Feed list with the flag +< 5 ms vs today (one SDK evaluation per request) PUT / DELETE toggle p95 < 200 ms (excludes the transcode itself)

docs.title: Availability
docs.text:
• Range playback never depends on HLS. The flag off, ERROR, a missing file or an unsupported browser all lead to Range.
  • A Harness outage means the flag reads false, so everyone plays through Range.

docs.title: Scalability
docs.text:
• One job at a time on one instance; this is a single-replica app (HPA 1–1).
  • Disk is the limit, and the owner controls it per video. There is no automatic growth.

docs.title: EC-1: .full missing
docs.text: PUT on a video whose .full has not been downloaded, or was deleted, results in PENDING, then ERROR SOURCE_MISSING. Playback stays Range.

docs.title: EC-2: READY but the directory is gone
docs.text:
• The playlist returns 404, so the player falls back to Range.
  • At the next startup the row becomes ERROR OUTPUT_MISSING.
  • There is no self-healing: the owner retries with PUT.

docs.title: EC-3: Hidden or unpublished video
docs.text:
• PUT is allowed.
  • The feed already leaves the video out, and the playlist returns 404 while it is hidden or not PUBLISHED.
  • Unhiding it makes the existing READY rendition available again with no re-transcode.

docs.title: EC-4: Force sync or scheduler replaces .full
docs.text:
• Any old directory is deleted.
  • For a READY or ERROR row, the status becomes PENDING and the worker is woken (BR-10).
  • For NONE, PENDING or PROCESSING, the status does not change.

docs.title: EC-5: PUT while PENDING, PROCESSING or READY
docs.text: 200 with the current status; there is no second job.

docs.title: EC-6: DELETE while PROCESSING
docs.text:
• The status becomes NONE at once.
  • FFmpeg runs to the end or to the timeout. FR-4 then deletes .tmp and does not publish.
  • The final status stays NONE.

docs.title: EC-7: File locked when the worker picks a job
docs.text: The download or delete holds DriveFileLocks, so the job stays PENDING and is retried at the next wake-up or poll.

docs.title: EC-8: Two concurrent PUTs
docs.text: Both return 200 PENDING. The atomic claim UPDATE … WHERE hls_status = 'PENDING' lets exactly one worker run move it to PROCESSING.

docs.title: EC-9: Restart during PROCESSING
docs.text: BR-11: the row goes back to PENDING, the leftover .tmp is deleted, and the job runs again.

docs.title: EC-10: Flag turned off while someone is watching
docs.text:
• The current playback continues, because files are still served.
  • The next list fetch returns hlsUrl = null, so that client uses Range from then on.

docs.title: EC-11: Harness unreachable
docs.text: isEnabled returns the default false, so hlsUrl is null everywhere.

docs.title: EC-12: Fatal HLS error during playback
docs.text: The player switches to the Range URL and resumes at the last currentTime. If it was playing, it keeps playing.

docs.title: EC-13: Path traversal and bad names
docs.text: fileId with .., /, %2F or other characters outside the regex, or a segment like ../x.ts or seg_1.m3u8, returns 400 with no file system access.

docs.title: EC-14: Video without an audio stream
docs.text: Allowed by BR-5. FFmpeg copies the video stream only.

docs.title: EC-15: FFmpeg or ffprobe missing (e.g. K8s image)
docs.text: ERROR FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND; Range keeps working.

docs.title: EC-16: Delete a video with an HLS rendition
docs.text: deleteVideo always removes video-cache/hls/{fileId}/ (BR-12), even when deleteLocalFile = false, so no orphan directory is left.

docs.title: Acceptance Criteria
docs.text:
• [ ] Changeset 202610240001-video-source-hls.sql applies on an existing DB. Every existing row reads hls_status = 'NONE', hls_error = NULL.
  • [ ] PUT as SUPER_ADMIN on a Drive video with status NONE → 200 PENDING. The worker runs, and the status reaches READY with video-cache/hls/{fileId}/playlist.m3u8 + seg_*.ts.
  • [ ] PUT as ADMIN → 403. PUT on a non-Drive row → 400 error.hls.notDriveVideo. PUT on an unknown id → 404.
  • [ ] PUT on ERROR → PENDING with hls_error cleared. PUT on PENDING, PROCESSING or READY → 200, unchanged.
  • [ ] DELETE → NONE and the directory is gone. DELETE during PROCESSING → the final status is NONE and no directory is published. DELETE never returns 409.
  • [ ] HEVC source → ERROR UNSUPPORTED_CODEC. Low disk (reserve set above free space in a test) → ERROR DISK_FULL, and FFmpeg is not started.
  • [ ] A timeout (set to 1 s in a test with a stub process) kills the process → ERROR TIMEOUT, and .tmp is removed.
  • [ ] Only one FFmpeg process at a time, with 3 videos queued.
  • [ ] Restart with a PROCESSING row → it becomes PENDING, then READY. A READY row with a deleted directory → ERROR OUTPUT_MISSING.
  • [ ] Re-download of a READY video's .full → the status becomes PENDING and the old segments are deleted.
  • [ ] Flag on + READY → hlsUrl is set in the list, the detail and the collection videos. Flag off, or not READY → hlsUrl is null.
  • [ ] Playlist for a hidden or unpublished READY video → 404. Segment with .. → 400. Segment response has video/mp2t and the immutable Cache-Control.
  • [ ] Chrome desktop: an HLS video plays through hls.js (network shows .m3u8 + .ts, no /stream/). Safari/iOS: native HLS plays.
  • [ ] Forcing a fatal HLS error (e.g. deleting a segment mid-play) → playback continues through Range at about the same time.
  • [ ] Resume (startAt) and watch-history progress work for an HLS video like for a Range video.
  • [ ] hls.js is in a separate chunk. The main bundle size is unchanged (±1 KB).
  • [ ] Admin table: SUPER_ADMIN sees the toggle and ADMIN sees only the badge. The status refreshes on its own until READY or ERROR. Error reasons appear in EN and VI.
  • [ ] mvn verify green with coverage ≥ the threshold. npm run test and npm run lint green.

docs.title: Open Questions
docs.text:
None. All PRD and ADR questions are closed. Decisions from the spec Q&A (2026-10-24):

  • the toggles are idempotent, and PUT on ERROR retries;
  • the app.hls.* config is separate from video-import;
  • the four edge cases EC-1..EC-4 are confirmed;
  • @AuditLog on the toggles;
  • the playlist is served only for PUBLISHED, non-hidden videos.

Assumption: there is no app.hls.enabled kill switch for the worker. The Harness flag controls playback, and the owner controls transcoding per video.

docs.title: Metadata
docs.text: Status: Draft Author: nguyenhuuca Date: 2026-10-20 Related PRD: PRD-in-app-report Related ADR: ADR-0026

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN users get a Report page, placed just above Settings. From there they send a bug, an enhancement or an issue. The server stores the report and creates a GitHub issue in nguyenhuuca/assessment through the GitHub REST API, labelled autopilot plus a type label. That issue starts headless autopilot (ADR-0022). The page also lists every stored report with its GitHub state and offers a retry for reports whose issue could not be created.

docs.title: BR-1: Who can use it
docs.text: Only ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN can create, list or retry reports. USER gets 403 on every endpoint and does not see the menu.

docs.title: BR-2: Type and type label
docs.text:
The type is exactly one of three values, each with a fixed type label:

type Type label BUG bug ENHANCEMENT enhancement ISSUE report

docs.title: BR-3: Autopilot label and the daily cap
docs.text:
• Default: every issue gets autopilot, unless the daily cap applies.
  • The cap: when the reporter is an ADMIN, the server counts the stored reports with status = CREATED, autopilot = true, reporter_role = ADMIN and created_at in the last 24 hours.
    • If the count is ≥ 10, the issue is created without autopilot, and the response has capReached = true.
    • Reports from a SUPER_ADMIN are neither limited nor counted.
  • When it is checked: each time the server calls GitHub, so on create and on every retry. FAILED reports never count.

docs.title: BR-4: Auto labels
docs.text:
• autoLabel is one of null, AUTO_MERGE (adds autopilot:auto-merge) or AUTO (adds autopilot:auto). At most one can be sent; the field holds a single value.
  • Only a SUPER_ADMIN may send a non-null autoLabel. An ADMIN who sends one gets 403 error.report.autoLabelForbidden, and nothing is stored.
  • An auto label is only added together with autopilot. A SUPER_ADMIN is never capped (BR-3), so in practice it is always added.

docs.title: BR-5: Per-user rate limit
docs.text:
• Create is limited to 5 calls per 3,600 s per user: @RateLimited(permit = 5, windowInSeconds = 3600).
  • Retry has the same annotation. Because the limiter keys by URI (aop/RateLimitAspect.java:33-36), the retry limit is per user per report.
  • Over the limit, the response is 429 from the existing RateLimitExceededException.

docs.title: BR-6: Retry
docs.text:
• Ownership is checked first: only the original reporter or a SUPER_ADMIN may retry. Anyone else gets 403 error.report.retryForbidden, whatever the report status.
  • Only a report with status = FAILED can be retried. Retrying a CREATED report returns 409 error.report.alreadyCreated (after the ownership check).
  • A retry reuses the stored type, title, description and context. It re-applies BR-3 and BR-4, and the auto label and cap follow the caller's current role on retry (read from the database, not the stored reporterRole): the stored autoLabel is sent only when the caller is a SUPER_ADMIN; any other caller sends no auto label and is capped like an ADMIN.

docs.title: BR-7: Public issue content
docs.text:
The issue title is the report title as typed. The issue body is, in order:

  1. the description as typed;
  2. a ### Context section with the following lines; a missing value is printed as unknown:
    • Page: <page>
    • Path: <path>
    • App: <appVersion>
    • Browser: <userAgent>
    • Screen: <screenWidth>px
  3. a footer: Reported in-app by an ADMIN · report <first 8 chars of id> (or the SUPER_ADMIN);
  4. a final line: <!-- app-report:<id> -->.

Rules for the body:

  • No email, user name or user id appears in the issue.
  • No query string or fragment in the path. The server removes everything from the first ? or #, even if the client already did.

Assumption: The PRD said "display name". User has no display-name field, only id and userName (entity/User.java:33-36), and userName may be an email, so the footer names the role instead.

docs.title: BR-8: Reporter deleted
docs.text: reporter_id is set to NULL when the user is deleted (FK ON DELETE SET NULL). The report stays in the list as "Deleted user", and only a SUPER_ADMIN can retry it.

docs.title: BR-9: GitHub state: stored first, read-through as fallback
docs.text:
• The list shows githubState: OPEN, CLOSED or UNKNOWN, plus githubStateReason (completed, not_planned, duplicate, reopened or null).
  • A CREATED row with a stored github_state (BR-10) uses it; no GitHub call.
  • A CREATED row without one is fetched from GitHub and cached for 5 minutes, as before; githubStateReason is then null. The read-through result is not stored.
  • FAILED rows have githubState = null and githubStateReason = null.
  • No background refresh.

docs.title: BR-10: Webhook stores the state (ADR-0026 D7)
docs.text:
• POST /v1/funny-app/webhooks/github accepts a delivery only when X-Hub-Signature-256 equals sha256= + hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, compared in constant time.
  • Only X-GitHub-Event: issues with action closed or reopened changes anything. It sets github_state from issue.state (open → OPEN, closed → CLOSED), github_state_reason from issue.state_reason (only completed, not_planned, duplicate or reopened; any other value is stored as null), and github_state_at from issue.updated_at, on the CREATED report whose issue_number = issue.number.
  • The update applies only when issue.updated_at is after the stored github_state_at (or none is stored), so an older delivery that arrives late cannot overwrite a newer state.
  • The repository in the payload (repository.full_name) must equal the configured owner/repo; otherwise nothing changes.

docs.title: FR-1: Navigation entry
docs.text:
• Desktop: a report nav item (icon bug_report, label navReport) placed just above the Settings button in the sidebar (webapp/src/components/layout/AppShell.jsx:321-328).
  • Mobile: the same item placed just above settings in the mobile menu (AppShell.jsx:150-152).
  • Visibility: shown only when the user is ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN (isAdminRole, webapp/src/utils/roles.js:2).

docs.title: FR-2: Create a report
docs.text:
The form must have three inputs:

  • type, as a segmented control: Bug / Enhancement / Issue;
  • title, required, 1–120 characters after trimming;
  • description, required, 1–5,000 characters after trimming.

A SUPER_ADMIN must also see an "Autopilot" select: None / Auto-merge / Full auto. An ADMIN must not see it.

Beside the form, the page must show the context it will send, read-only:

  • page: the nav key the user was on before opening Report;
  • path: window.location.pathname;
  • appVersion: the build id, see FE;
  • userAgent: navigator.userAgent;
  • screenWidth: window.innerWidth.

The page must show the public-repo warning (PRD FR-10). On submit, the client calls POST /admin/reports, then:

  • CREATED: shows "Issue #N created" with a link that opens in a new tab;
  • capReached: adds "Autopilot quota reached for today; the owner can add the label";
  • FAILED: shows the error and a Retry button.

docs.title: FR-3: Store, then call GitHub
docs.text:
The server must:

  1. validate the request (Security → Data Validation);
  2. insert the app_report row with status = FAILED and error = 'pending';
  3. compute the labels (BR-2 to BR-4);
  4. call POST https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues with {title, body, labels};
  5. on a 201 response, update the row with status = CREATED, issue_number, issue_url (the html_url from the response), labels and autopilot, and clear error;
  6. on any failure, keep FAILED with a short error code (EC-1, EC-2);
  7. return the stored report.

docs.title: FR-4: List reports
docs.text: GET /admin/reports?page&size must return the reports newest first, paged with a default size of 20 and a maximum of 50. Each row has the reporter's userName, which is shown in the app only and never sent to GitHub, plus the githubState from BR-9.

docs.title: FR-5: Retry
docs.text: POST /admin/reports/{id}/retry must repeat FR-3 steps 3 to 7 for the stored row, after the checks in BR-6.

docs.title: FR-6: GitHub client
docs.text:
A GitHubIssueClient interface in client, implemented with java.net.http.HttpClient. It must:

  • send Authorization: Bearer <token>, Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28;
  • use a 5 s connect timeout and a 10 s request timeout;
  • never log the token or the response body.

It has two methods:

  • create(title, body, labels) returns the issue number and html_url;
  • state(number) returns OPEN, CLOSED or UNKNOWN. It maps any non-200 response or exception to UNKNOWN.

docs.title: FR-8: Webhook receiver
docs.text:
The webhook endpoint must:

  • read the body as raw bytes and verify the signature before parsing JSON;
  • return 503 when GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is blank, 401 on a missing or wrong signature, 400 on unparseable JSON from a valid signature, and 204 otherwise (applied or ignored);
  • log the delivery id, event, action, issue number and outcome (applied, ignored, stale, unknown-issue) at INFO; never log the secret, the signature or the body;
  • finish without any outbound call (GitHub expects an answer within 10 s).

docs.title: FR-7: Configuration
docs.text:
AppProperties.github has three fields:

  • token, from env GITHUB_REPORT_TOKEN, no default;
  • owner, default nguyenhuuca;
  • repo, default assessment.

A blank token means "not configured" (EC-1). The app must start either way.

docs.title: New Endpoints
docs.text: All endpoints are under /v1/funny-app/admin/reports, in a new AdminReportController with a class-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") (the same pattern as web/AdminJobController.java:32). Responses use the project wrappers.

docs.title: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports
docs.text:
Description: Store a report and create its GitHub issue.

Auth: Required (JWT Bearer), role ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Rate limit: 5 per 3,600 s per user (BR-5). @AuditLog.

Request

{
  "type": "BUG",
  "title": "Video Vault title wraps on mobile",
  "description": "Long titles break the row on a 390 px screen…",
  "autoLabel": null,
  "context": {
    "page": "admin",
    "path": "/",
    "appVersion": "a1b2c3d",
    "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0 …",
    "screenWidth": 390
  }
}

Response — Success (HTTP 200, ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>). The report was stored; check status.

{
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "data": {
    "id": "6f1c2b0e-…",
    "type": "BUG",
    "title": "Video Vault title wraps on mobile",
    "status": "CREATED",
    "issueNumber": 41,
    "issueUrl": "https://github.com/nguyenhuuca/assessment/issues/41",
    "labels": ["autopilot", "bug"],
    "autopilot": true,
    "autoLabel": null,
    "capReached": false,
    "error": null,
    "reporter": "admin@example.com",
    "githubState": "OPEN",
    "createdAt": "2026-10-20T12:00:00Z"
  }
}

When GitHub fails, the response is the same with "status": "FAILED", issueNumber and issueUrl set to null, and error holding a short code such as "github.notConfigured", "github.timeout" or "github.http.502".

Response — Error

HTTP Status Code (i18n key) Message (en) Condition 400 error.report.invalidType Type must be BUG, ENHANCEMENT or ISSUE type missing or not one of the three 400 error.report.invalidTitle Title is required (at most 120 characters) title blank after trim, or longer than 120 400 error.report.invalidDescription Description is required (at most 5,000 characters) description blank after trim, or longer than 5,000 400 error.report.invalidContext Invalid page context path not starting with / or longer than 300; page longer than 32; appVersion longer than 40; userAgent longer than 300; screenWidth outside 1–10,000 400 error.report.invalidAutoLabel Unknown autopilot option autoLabel not null, AUTO or AUTO_MERGE 401 — — Missing or invalid JWT 403 — Access denied Role USER 403 error.report.autoLabelForbidden Only the SUPER_ADMIN can choose an autopilot option ADMIN sends a non-null autoLabel 429 (existing RateLimitExceededException) Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later. BR-5

docs.title: GET /v1/funny-app/admin/reports
docs.text:
Description: List reports, newest first, with the GitHub state.

Auth: Required, role ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Rate limit: @RateLimited(permit = 60) (60 per 60 s per user).

Request: query page (default 0, at least 0) and size (default 20, from 1 to 50).

Response — Success (ResultObjectInfo<Page<ReportDto>> with Pageable, the same shape as the existing admin lists in web/AdminController.java:75-79): data.content is an array of ReportDto, and data carries the Spring Page fields (totalElements, totalPages, number, size). githubState is OPEN, CLOSED or UNKNOWN for CREATED rows, and null for FAILED rows. reporter is null when the user was deleted.

Response — Error

HTTP Status Code Message Condition 400 error.report.invalidPage Invalid page or size page < 0, or size outside 1–50 401 — — Missing or invalid JWT 403 — Access denied Role USER

docs.title: POST /v1/funny-app/admin/reports/{id}/retry
docs.text:
Description: Retry the GitHub call for a FAILED report.

Auth: Required, role ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, and BR-6 must hold. Rate limit: 5 per 3,600 s per user per report (BR-5). @AuditLog.

Response — Success: ResultObjectInfo<ReportDto>, as for create.

Response — Error

HTTP Status Code Message Condition 401 — — Missing or invalid JWT 403 — Access denied Role USER 403 error.report.retryForbidden Only the reporter or the SUPER_ADMIN can retry this report Caller is neither the reporter nor the SUPER_ADMIN 404 error.report.notFound Report not found Unknown id, or id not a UUID 409 error.report.alreadyCreated This report already has a GitHub issue status = CREATED 429 (existing) Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later. BR-5

docs.title: POST /v1/funny-app/webhooks/github
docs.text:
Description: GitHub repo webhook for the "Issues" event (BR-10, FR-8).

Auth: No JWT (listed in WHITE_LIST_PATH, utils/AppConstant.java:45). HMAC signature with GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Rate limit: none (no user; the signature check comes first and is cheap).

Request: headers X-GitHub-Event, X-GitHub-Delivery, X-Hub-Signature-256; JSON body from GitHub. Fields read: action, issue.number, issue.state, issue.state_reason, issue.updated_at, repository.full_name.

Response — Success: 204, empty body, for applied and for ignored deliveries.

Response — Error

Status Condition 400 Valid signature, body is not JSON or lacks issue.number for an issues event 401 X-Hub-Signature-256 missing, not sha256=<hex>, or wrong 413 Body larger than 1 MiB (checked before the signature) 503 GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET not configured

docs.title: Modified Endpoints
docs.text: • GET /v1/funny-app/admin/reports: ReportDto gains githubStateReason (string or null); githubState follows BR-9.

docs.title: New Tables
docs.text:
-- In-app reports turned into GitHub issues (ADR-0026).
CREATE TABLE app_report
(
    id            UUID         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    reporter_id   BIGINT       REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    reporter_role VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    type          VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('BUG', 'ENHANCEMENT', 'ISSUE')),
    title         VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    description   TEXT         NOT NULL,
    page          VARCHAR(32),
    page_path     VARCHAR(300),
    app_version   VARCHAR(40),
    user_agent    VARCHAR(300),
    screen_width  INT,
    auto_label    VARCHAR(16)  CHECK (auto_label IN ('AUTO', 'AUTO_MERGE')),
    autopilot     BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    labels        VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('CREATED', 'FAILED')),
    issue_number  INT,
    issue_url     VARCHAR(300),
    error         VARCHAR(64),
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_app_report_created_at ON app_report (created_at DESC);
-- BR-3 cap count
CREATE INDEX idx_app_report_autopilot_cap ON app_report (created_at)
    WHERE status = 'CREATED' AND autopilot AND reporter_role = 'ADMIN';

Migration file: api/src/main/resources/db/changelog/sql/202610200001-create-app-report.sql. The latest file today is 202610190002-create-scheduled-job.sql.

  • reporter_role is stored when the report is created, so the cap and the footer do not change if the user's role changes later.
  • labels is a comma-separated copy of what was sent to GitHub.

docs.title: Modified Tables
docs.text:
-- Issue state pushed by the GitHub webhook (ADR-0026 D7).
ALTER TABLE app_report
    ADD COLUMN github_state        VARCHAR(10) CHECK (github_state IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED')),
    ADD COLUMN github_state_reason VARCHAR(16),
    ADD COLUMN github_state_at     TIMESTAMPTZ;
CREATE INDEX idx_app_report_issue_number ON app_report (issue_number) WHERE issue_number IS NOT NULL;

Migration file: api/src/main/resources/db/changelog/sql/202610210001-app-report-github-state.sql. All columns are nullable, so existing rows keep working through the read-through path.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: The three admin endpoints require a JWT. The webhook endpoint is public and is authenticated only by its HMAC signature (BR-10); GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is a separate secret from GITHUB_REPORT_TOKEN, set in the server's env file, never logged and never returned.

docs.title: Authorization
docs.text:
• Class level: @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"). The role hierarchy lets SUPER_ADMIN through (filter/WebSecurityConfig.java:81-88).
  • Service checks:
    • an ADMIN sending a non-null autoLabel is rejected (BR-4);
    • a retry by someone other than the reporter or the SUPER_ADMIN is rejected (BR-6).
  • Future CONTRIBUTOR (ADR-0026 D6): the class annotation becomes hasRole('CONTRIBUTOR'). The service checks stay as they are.

docs.title: Data Validation
docs.text:
Field Rule Error type required; one of BUG, ENHANCEMENT, ISSUE error.report.invalidType title trimmed; 1–120 chars error.report.invalidTitle description trimmed; 1–5,000 chars error.report.invalidDescription autoLabel null, AUTO or AUTO_MERGE error.report.invalidAutoLabel context.page optional; ≤ 32 chars error.report.invalidContext context.path optional; starts with /; ≤ 300 chars; query and fragment stripped by the server error.report.invalidContext context.appVersion optional; ≤ 40 chars error.report.invalidContext context.userAgent optional; ≤ 300 chars error.report.invalidContext context.screenWidth optional; 1–10,000 error.report.invalidContext

All text goes to GitHub as JSON string values from Jackson, never through string concatenation into a command or URL. The issue number in state(number) is an int.

docs.title: Sensitive Data
docs.text:
• The GitHub token must never appear in logs, @AuditLog output, exceptions, error or any response.
  • Audit logging: @AuditLog records the request DTO as the user sent it; it has no secret fields.
  • Reporter identity: the reporter's userName is returned only by the admin API. It is never in the issue (BR-7).
  • Outbound data: documented per .claude/rules/security.md "Data Routing". Only the issue title, the body of BR-7 and the labels leave the system, to api.github.com.

docs.title: Caching Impact
docs.text:
Cache Impact Action New GitHubIssueStateCache (Guava, expireAfterWrite 5 min, maximumSize 500, like cache/CredentialsVersionCache.java:24-25) Read and write Key: issue number; value: OPEN/CLOSED. UNKNOWN is not cached, so the next list tries again.

No existing cache is affected.
